title: Associate Creative Director
description:
**About Remedy Edge Spain:**



Welcome to Remedy Edge Spain. We activate potential, amplify with creativity, and accelerate outcomes. Remedy Edge brings strategic thinking and bold communications to healthcare — cutting through the noise to move people and change results. We don't do comfortable. We do cutting edge. Join us and GET THE EDGE.


**About the role:**



We are looking for an experienced **Associate Creative Director (ACD)** to join our creative international team. In this role, you will lead the development of integrated healthcare campaigns, partnering with cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative, high\-quality creative solutions from concept through execution.


**Key responsibilities:**


* Develop strong creative concepts and integrated campaigns across multiple channels and formats.
* Lead the creative development of projects from initial concept through final execution, ensuring excellence in both visual and verbal communication.
* Transform complex healthcare and scientific information into clear, engaging, and impactful creative solutions.
* Partner with Creative Directors to define and maintain the creative vision and quality of the work.
* Lead, inspire and mentor creative teams, including art directors, copywriters and designers.
* Provide clear, constructive creative feedback that elevates the overall quality of the work.
* Collaborate closely with Strategy, Account, Medical and Production teams.
* Present and defend creative ideas confidently to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines without compromising creative standards.
* Take ownership of projects, proactively identify challenges and help drive work forward efficiently.


**About you:**



A **creative leader first and foremost**: someone with exceptional conceptual thinking, strong creative instincts, and the ability to recognize, develop and elevate great ideas.



Whether your roots are in **Art, Copy, or both**, you should be comfortable overseeing and guiding all aspects of the creative process, inspiring multidisciplinary teams and taking ownership of projects from concept to execution.



We're looking for someone with the ambition to push the work forward, the creative craft to make it exceptional, and the leadership skills to bring teams along the journey and deliver outstanding results.


**Skills \& Experience**


* **7\-8 years of creative experience in healthcare communications.**
* Strong background in either **Art Direction, Copywriting, or both**, with a portfolio demonstrating outstanding conceptual thinking and creative craft.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns across a variety of channels and touchpoints.
* Strong experience working with pharmaceutical, biotech, medical or health\-related brands.
* **Native\-level English is essential.**
* **Proven ability to lead creative teams and projects.**
* Excellent conceptual thinking, communication and presentation skills.
* Strong expertise in visual storytelling, narrative development, creative strategy and content creation.
* Ability to understand complex scientific information and translate it into compelling creative communications.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Good understanding of healthcare regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Collaborative, proactive and solution\-oriented mindset.

  


*Omnicom Health is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we're focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

**Who we are**
--------------


Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.


### **Job Description**


Job Ref ID: JR0085668

**YOUR MISSION**


As the Head of Product Strategy \& Operations for Brands Ads, you are the strategy and scaling engine behind Glovo's fastest\-growing revenue stream. Your core challenge over the next 12\-18 months is to anchor the Go\-to\-Market roadmap between Glovo and Delivery Hero, launch best\-in\-class ad placements globally, and define the automated tools and infrastructure required to optimize campaigns at scale.

**THE JOURNEY**

* Product Roadmap Influence: Anchor the GTM roadmap between Glovo and Delivery Hero Product teams. Identify gaps, prioritize local market needs with Local Heads, and launch 2\+ new ad placements globally.
* Ad Operations \& Tool Definition: Lead a specialized team (4 direct reports) and partner with 2 dotted\-line data analysts to define and build automated tools that support campaign operations and optimize performance across all regions.
* Ads Strategy \& Pricing: Define scalable pricing logic and develop comprehensive GTM toolkits, ensuring Regional Ad Ops (ES, ITSEE) and local teams are trained to scale ad adoption.
* Cross\-Functional \& Matrix Leadership: Act as the primary business owner for Salesforce and lead the financial Mid\-Term/Business Planning (MP/BP) processes, driving consensus across Data, Product, and Commercial leaders.
* Data Roadmap Prioritization: Own the data roadmap for Brands Ads, accurately identifying, measuring, and prioritizing the most impactful data projects and tools for both HQ and local teams.


### **Qualifications**


**WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE**

**Must have:**

* 7\+ years of deep, specialized experience in AdTech, Digital Ads, or a marketplace advertising network.
* Elite stakeholder management skills; capable of aligning Delivery Hero Product, Glovo Product, Data, and Local Heads in a highly matrixed environment.
* Proven ability to define operational tools and scalable processes for campaign optimization, paired with strong financial planning/modeling skills.
* Experience managing hybrid teams (direct and dotted\-line reporting lines) to execute complex, cross\-functional strategic goals.

**Nice to have:**

* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce as a business owner.


Individuals representing diverse profiles, **and abilities,** encompassing various genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds, are less likely to apply for this role if they do not possess solid experience in 100% of these areas. * An enticing equity plan.
* Top\-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.
* Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings!
* Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses or office\-based nursery.
* Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.

title: Social Art Director & Videographer - Madrid
description:
**¿Quiénes somos?**
-------------------


Somos una consultora internacional especializada en impulsar la evolución de los modelos de negocio de grandes y medianas empresas. Ayudamos a nuestros clientes a mejorar su competitividad conectando estrategia, comunicación, diseño, tecnología y datos, siempre con un enfoque práctico y orientado a generar impacto.


Contamos con un equipo de más de 2\.000 profesionales distribuidos en distintos países y trabajamos en proyectos end\-to\-end, acompañando a nuestros clientes desde la definición estratégica hasta la implementación, la medición y la optimización continua. Nuestro objetivo es transformar los datos en decisiones de negocio que generen resultados reales.


En esta ocasión, estamos colaborando con **Cosmic**, una empresa del grupo, en la búsqueda de talento para incorporar a su equipo y cubrir esta posición.

**¿Qué es Cosmic?**
-------------------

**Cosmic** es una agencia especializada en **Short Vertical Video**, el formato que domina plataformas como TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts. Como primer partner creativo de TikTok en Europa, ayuda a las marcas a conectar con sus audiencias a través de contenidos nativos, creativos y diseñados para maximizar su impacto.


Su equipo se encarga de diseñar, producir y optimizar contenidos que destacan en las plataformas donde hoy se generan las conversaciones y las tendencias, combinando creatividad, estrategia y un profundo conocimiento del ecosistema digital.

### **¿Qué buscamos?**

**¿Sabes que un buen TikTok no es un spot de 30 segundos puesto en vertical?**


Buscamos un/a **Social Art Director \& Videographer** con un ojo creativo brutal y una sensibilidad especial por el lenguaje de cada plataforma. Alguien que entienda qué hace que una idea funcione en social y que sea capaz de llevarla de principio a fin: **conceptualizarla, grabarla, editarla y convertirla en contenido que la gente quiera ver y compartir.**


No buscamos solo a alguien que sepa hacer vídeos bonitos. Buscamos a alguien que **entienda el lenguaje de internet, tenga criterio visual y sepa convertir una buena idea en contenido que funcione.**

### **Eres perfecto/a si**

* **Tienes 3\+ años de experiencia** en dirección de arte, diseño creativo o creación audiovisual, idealmente en agencia creativa, digital, productora o entorno social\-first.
* **Tu portfolio habla por ti.** Demuestra criterio visual, buenas ideas y, sobre todo, capacidad real para llevarlas a ejecución.
* **Tienes obsesión por el detalle.** Composición, fotografía, tipografía, color, ritmo… sabes que son los pequeños detalles los que hacen que una pieza pase de correcta a memorable.
* **Piensas en movimiento desde el principio.** No diseñas primero una pieza gráfica para convertirla después en vídeo: piensas en imagen, cámara, ritmo y narrativa desde el minuto uno.
* **Entiendes el lenguaje de cada plataforma.** Sabes que lo que funciona en TikTok no necesariamente funciona en Instagram o YouTube, y adaptas la idea sin perder su esencia.
* **Te mueves bien entre lo grande y lo rápido.** Puedes trabajar en una producción con todos los recursos o sacar adelante una pieza que tiene que estar publicada mañana.
* **Eres resourceful.** No necesitas una gran producción para hacer algo bueno: sabes sacar partido a un móvil, un equipo pequeño y los recursos que tengas a mano.
* **Eres proactivo/a.** Traes referencias, detectas tendencias, propones formatos y encuentras oportunidades incluso cuando nadie te ha dado todavía un brief.

### **¿Qué harás?**

* **Convertir ideas en contenido.** Conceptualizar y desarrollar ideas visuales y audiovisuales para campañas, contenido always\-on y oportunidades culturales en social.
* **Marcar la dirección visual.** Definir el look \& feel de contenidos y activaciones, construyendo una identidad reconocible sin caer en fórmulas o plantillas repetitivas.
* **Dar forma a las ideas.** Crear tratamientos visuales, referencias, moodboards, storyboards y planteamientos de realización que hagan que una idea cobre vida antes de llegar a producción.
* **Grabar y producir.** Coger una cámara o un smartphone y sacar adelante una pieza de principio a fin, adaptando los recursos a lo que necesita cada idea.
* **Resolver en modo social\-first.** Desde entrevistas y producto hasta creators, coberturas, contenido reactivo y formatos que necesitan salir rápido. Sabes moverte con soltura cuando el contexto cambia.
* **Editar y llevar las piezas hasta el final.** Montaje, ritmo, grafismo, motion, sonido y color, cuidando tanto el conjunto como cada detalle.
* **Pensar en cada plataforma.** Adaptar conceptos y piezas para TikTok, Reels, Stories, Shorts, YouTube, LinkedIn y otros formatos digitales, entendiendo qué funciona en cada entorno.
* **Trabajar pegado al equipo de contenido.** Colaborar con Content Manager y Social Intelligence para convertir tendencias, insights y oportunidades editoriales en ideas visuales que merezca la pena producir.
* **Experimentar con IA.** Incorporar herramientas generativas en tu proceso de ideación, preproducción y exploración visual, trabajando junto al AI Content Producer cuando la pieza requiera workflows más complejos.
* **Sacar lo mejor de los creators.** Dirigir a personas delante de cámara de forma natural, ágil y sin convertir cada grabación en un rodaje de película.
* **Defender tus ideas.** Presentar y argumentar conceptos y decisiones visuales ante equipos internos y clientes, sabiendo explicar no solo qué propones, sino por qué funciona.

### **Lo que tienes que dominar**

* **Portfolio con criterio.** Experiencia demostrable en creatividad social y audiovisual, con piezas que demuestren tanto buen ojo como capacidad de ejecución.
* **Cámara y móvil.** Capacidad profesional para grabar con cámara y smartphone, sabiendo elegir el equipo y el enfoque según lo que necesite cada pieza.
* **Lenguaje audiovisual.** Conocimientos sólidos de fotografía, composición, iluminación, encuadre, movimiento y narrativa audiovisual.
* **Herramientas de creación.** Dominio de Adobe Creative Cloud —Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere y After Effects— y soltura con herramientas ágiles como CapCut.
* **Código social.** Conocimiento profundo de formatos, duraciones, hooks, ritmo y códigos visuales y narrativos de TikTok, Instagram/Reels y YouTube/Shorts.
* **IA aplicada a la creatividad.** Familiaridad con herramientas de IA generativa y criterio para incorporarlas en la ideación, preproducción y producción audiovisual cuando realmente aporten valor.

**Cómo trabajas**
-----------------

* **Piensas y haces a la vez.** Te gusta conceptualizar, pero también coger la cámara, probar, grabar y resolver. No eres de los que se quedan en la idea.
* **Sabes que manda la plataforma.** Entiendes sus códigos, su ritmo y lo que hace que una pieza funcione en cada canal. No haces “un vídeo y luego lo adaptas”: piensas nativamente para cada plataforma.
* **Encuentras el equilibrio.** Sabes mantener la identidad de marca sin perder relevancia cultural ni convertir cada contenido en una pieza demasiado corporativa.
* **Eres proactivo/a.** Traes referencias, detectas tendencias, propones formatos y encuentras oportunidades sin esperar a que llegue un brief perfectamente cerrado.

**¿Te gustaría crecer con nosotros/as?**
----------------------------------------


Si buscas un entorno donde la creatividad, la comunicación y la estrategia se unen para generar un impacto real en el negocio, esta puede ser tu oportunidad.


En esta ocasión, te incorporarás a **Cosmic**, una empresa del grupo, donde formarás parte de un equipo que está redefiniendo la forma en la que las marcas conectan con sus audiencias a través del contenido en plataformas como TikTok, Instagram Reels y YouTube Shorts.


Si te apasionan los retos, la innovación y el entorno digital, ¡queremos conocerte!


En línea con nuestro compromiso con la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión, animamos a todas las personas a presentar su candidatura, especialmente a quienes forman parte de colectivos tradicionalmente infrarrepresentados, como las personas LGTBIQ\+ o las personas con discapacidad.

title: Creative Director
description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI\-native, full\-stack, multi\-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer\-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.
   

  

 Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer\-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built\-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real\-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM\-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.
   

  

 Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.
   

  

 We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Applying to Render**
 We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.
   

  

 We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.
   

  

 Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Render's mission is to eliminate the undifferentiated work that goes into building software products by offering an easy\-to\-use, powerful cloud platform for developer teams of all sizes. As we grow into the place to deploy AI\-native apps and agents, our brand needs to match the company we're becoming: production\-grade, not prototype\-grade, and unmistakably ours across every surface a developer touches.
   

  

 We're entering a deliberate brand evolution at Render. The work is maturing what already works, aligning it to where the company and our audience are headed (from solo developers to fast\-scaling teams and enterprises), and codifying it into systems that hold as we scale. We're looking for a Creative Director to lead that evolution end\-to\-end and to support the brand team behind it.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership role for a player/coach. We are looking for someone who can set the creative vision, hold the quality bar, and still go deep on the work when it matters. You'll lead a founding brand team through a defining stretch of work. You'll inherit a strong foundation and a talented founding team. Your mission is to provide strategic direction, elevate our creative standards, and guide us through this next phase of growth. This role is built for a leader who drives impact through craft and clarity, rather than just oversight.
   

  

**You Will**
* Own Render's brand strategy and positioning. Partner with the Head of Design, product marketing, and executive stakeholders to lock positioning, brand attributes, and messaging architecture. title: Art Director, Clash of Clans
description:
**Clash of Clans is one of the most recognisable games ever made. We want to keep it that way, and then some.**
 Clash is growing beyond the game, showing up in trailers, campaigns, toys, and collaborations. The visual identity has to stretch to cover all of it, stay true to what players love, and still feel fresh. We're also modernising how we make things: pipelines are evolving, our content production is scaling, and we're working more closely with external partners than ever before.
   

  

 We need someone who can own this at a strategic level. Someone who sets the vision, builds the conditions for great work, and steers the IP with confidence across every surface it touches.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Define and evolve the visual direction of Clash across the game, cosmetics, and wherever else the IP lives. True to its DNA, but never frozen in time.
* Set the standard for style and brand fit across in\-game art, marketing, trailers, toy lines, campaigns, and entertainment partners, and empower the team to uphold it.
* Partner with game design, product, and marketing leadership to ensure art strategy supports gameplay clarity, player understanding, and long\-term brand health.
* Mentor and support Clash artists, help them do the best work of their careers while staying aligned on the IP.
* Shape the roadmap for modernising Clash pipelines (2D to 3D, audio, tooling, and emerging technologies), championing approaches that give artists more time for the work only they can do.
* Represent art at a senior level across the business: outsourcing partners, Entertainment and Partnerships, marketing, and franchise collaborators.


 What You Have
   

  

* A strong track record leading art direction on stylised games. Mobile and live\-service experience is a big plus.
* Deep IP and brand instincts, the ability to define what's on\-brand vs off and build the frameworks that help a whole team make that call consistently.
* Leadership experience on a highly collaborative senior art teams: setting vision, developing artists, and making the culture as strong as the output.
* Strategic experience managing outsourcing pipelines and external partners at scale, balancing quality ambitions with the realities of live\-game timelines and budgets.
* Comfort operating in a low\-process, high\-trust environment where you own the outcomes, not just the opinions.
* A self\-starter approach to use AI. You've found ways to use it in your day\-to\-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.


 Would Be Nice if You Also Have
   

  

* Experience with cosmetics economies or large seasonal content pipelines.
* Experience bridging game art strategy and marketing/UA: key art, trailers, social.
* Familiarity with Clash (as a player or from prior work) and a feel for how it's evolved.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

 This role can be based either in Helsinki or London. Clash of Clans team members are located in both our Helsinki and London Studios however most of our Artists are located in Helsinki!
   

  

 To be successful, you'll be expected to travel regularly in this role especially if based out of London.
   

  

 –––
   

  

*That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.*
*Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.*
*–––*
**About Supercell**
 Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of
 *Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars* 
 . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.
   

  

 So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.
   

  

 Hey, You Might Love It Here!
   

  

 Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.
   

  

 You Are Not Your Job Title ™
   

  

 Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.
   

  

**Benefits And Compensation**
 Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.
   

  

 Relocation? Yes!
   

  

 No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!
   

  

 Not Sure if You Should Apply?
   

  

 Many candidates with great skills and experience second\-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.
   

  

 Wishing you all the best,
   

  

 The Supercell Recruitment team

title: Head of Design, AI-First
description:
**Own the design function for a $1Billion\+ brand. Transform how we build with AI.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $181,500 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path** 
 from here is VP Design → Chief Design Officer. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere can happen in 1\-2 years here for high performers.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every design proposal ships with an AI review link, and Figma AI runs in our live production pipeline, shipping real work. You'd start where most teams are still trying to get.
 



  





*This position is remote, with the option to work from our Dubai office (with 0% income tax), if preferred (relocation and visa sponsorship support available).* 




  





**Role Overview** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Head of Design to turn our end\-to\-end web design from a sequential production queue into a fast, AI\-native operation. You will build on our existing AI adoption by establishing consistent workflows, prompt infrastructure, quality controls and system governance that let high\-quality design work ship at volume without extending timelines. While you own the visual and structural execution of the site, you will partner closely with the CRO team, which owns experimentation, including test hypotheses and the conversion roadmap.
 



  





**The Career Accelerator** 




 You will have the rare opportunity to take on a broad scope of work with unmatched autonomy.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce:** 
 very few Heads of Design get simultaneous ownership over the design system, the AI toolchain, the design roadmap and accessibility standards while leading a team of three as a hands\-on player coach and reporting directly to the VP, Digital Experience \& Conversion. This is not a role where you just review other people's mockups and forward them to engineering. Instead, you are building the operating system for the entire design function.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 rebuild the design workflow from sequential to agile, with kickoff huddles and a 40% reduction in time from design concept to development handoff. Build the prompt library and review workflow covering product copy, FAQs, size/fit guidance, policy explainers, and localized variants. Design the UI patterns for conversational search, guided finders, and PDP Q\&A alongside engineering. Own the recommendation surfaces — placements, card density, "why this" microcopy — and validate them with staged rollouts. Evolve the design system so tokens and components absorb AI\-generated variants without brand drift or PageSpeed cost. Bake WCAG 2\.2 into the system and pair AI\-assisted audits with manual review. Feed the experimentation roadmap with design variants that the CRO team can test at pace, and turn winning patterns into reusable standards across the design system. Shape the future of design at Puffy, where the site is the entire storefront and every conversion point runs through your team.



  





**What Is In It For You** 




 This isn't just another design management role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Design Function and the Toolchain It Runs On** 




 You set the standard, build the workflow, and own what ships.
 


* You design the operating model for the whole function: how work enters the queue, how AI\-generated variants get validated, where human QA sits, and how a spec reaches Dev Mode without losing intent. You own IA, wireframes, high\-fidelity comps, prototypes, and motion specs across Home, PLP, PDP, Cart/Checkout, editorial, and paid\-media landing pages. You decide what the design system tolerates and what it rejects.
* You hold the line on WCAG 2\.2, PageSpeed, and brand consistency while the volume goes up. You’re accountable for design quality, delivery speed, and the design team's contribution to conversion lift. You report to the VP, Digital Experience \& Conversion, present quarterly design roadmap reviews and translate design decisions \& experiment results into a narrative that the business acts on.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 




 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
 



 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
 



 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space or our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Design Leader Other Brands Come Looking For** 




 In most companies, design leaders inherit a workflow somebody else built and spend their tenure defending its timelines in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides what ships next quarter, your design roadmap is the input to that decision, not a status report on it afterwards. You'll leave with an AI\-native design operation you designed end to end — and the handoff\-time and conversion numbers proving quality held while volume went up, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than a versioning queue in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need** 



* 7\+ years in web design for e\-commerce, including 4\+ years leading, mentoring, and managing the operations of a design team.
* A portfolio that shows shipped PDP/PLP/Checkout improvements tied to clear business metrics.
* Expert in Figma (components, variables, Dev Mode); strong visual/motion craft and responsive design sensibility.
* Proven experience implementing GenAI tools into a professional design pipeline, with a clear understanding of prompt engineering, quality control, and brand governance.
* Familiarity with AI\-shaped UX patterns: conversational search, assistant UI, recommendation modules, and their measurement.
* Comfort collaborating on experiments (A/B vs multi\-armed bandits) with the CRO team; understands trade\-offs between optimization speed and causal certainty.
* Working knowledge of WCAG 2\.2 and SEO fundamentals for structured content and schema on e\-commerce sites.



  





**Good\-to\-Have** 



* Experience designing chat or guided\-selling flows



  





**The Puffy DNA:** 




 We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast\-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
 


* **Be the Owner:** 
 We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* **Execute with Urgency:** 
 We thrive in high\-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* **Demand Excellence:** 
 We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* **Be AI\-First:** 
 Daily multi\-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
* **Go All\-In:** 
 When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.



  





**✨ Your Total Compensation \& Benefits** 




  





**💰 Compensation:** 



* Total Annual Package: Up to USD $181,500 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)
* Annual salary review every January



  





**🏥 Health \& Protection:** 




 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (based on country of hire)
 



  





**🌴 Time Off:** 




 Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) \+ Public holidays
 



  





**💼 Work Environment:** 



* AI\-First organization with access to AI\-native tool stack
* Remote First: Work from the comfort of your home office
* Learning \& development opportunities
* International team collaboration across 16\+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.



  





**🏆 Rewards \& Recognition:** 



* Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
* Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company\-wide celebration for exceptional contributions



  





**Ready to Shape Your Story?** 




 Click "Apply" and take the first step.

title: Art Director - RuneScape

**Can you give one of gaming's longest\-running worlds a clear visual voice—and lead the team shaping its next era?**
 RuneScape has welcomed more than 300 million player accounts across 25 years. As the game progresses along its
 **Road to Restoration** 
 , we're looking for an Art Director to define and champion the visual direction behind its next chapter.
   

  

 You'll take ownership of RuneScape's artistic vision across environments, characters, creatures, UI, VFX, lighting and cinematics, bringing greater quality, consistency and clarity to the experience across PC and mobile. You'll lead a large multidisciplinary art team, setting a clear creative direction while staying close to the day\-to\-day realities of live game development.
   

  

 You'll have genuine autonomy to assess how the team operates, evolve its structure and raise the quality bar across the game. Your work will directly influence player experience, the desirability of cosmetic content and the long\-term visual strategy of one of the world's most established MMORPGs.
   

  

**What you'll be doing:**
* Own and evolve RuneScape's visual direction, creating a cohesive artistic vision across environments, characters, creatures, UI, VFX, lighting and cinematics while respecting the game's established identity.
* Lead and develop a large multidisciplinary art team, assessing its structure, capabilities and craft standards to ensure it is set up to deliver at the required quality and pace.
* Establish and maintain a clear quality bar, reviewing work throughout development and providing actionable direction that improves visual consistency and in\-game execution.
* Drive end\-to\-end improvements to RuneScape's cosmetic content, increasing its quality, consistency and player\-perceived value while supporting an important commercial area of the game.
* Partner with the Creative, Development and Product Directors, aligning artistic priorities with gameplay goals, production requirements and the wider Road to Restoration.
* Work closely with Technical Art and Engineering, improving pipelines, tools and workflows while balancing creative ambition with the technical realities of a live game across PC and mobile.
* Champion accessibility, readability and player experience, ensuring visual decisions support clear gameplay and remain effective across platforms.
* Represent the art discipline across RuneScape and the wider studio, contributing to recruitment, talent development and the game's long\-term creative strategy.


**What we're looking for:**
* Significant, demonstrable experience in Art Direction or senior art leadership within the games industry, gained on shipped or live titles.
* A proven track record of taking artistic direction from initial vision through to in\-game execution, balancing creative ambition with live\-service schedules, technical limitations and production realities.
* Proven experience leading a sizeable multidisciplinary art team, including managing performance, developing artists and navigating structural or organisational change.
* A strong professional background directing stylised or stylised\-realistic 3D art, supported by demonstrable knowledge of 3D pipelines, production tools, optimisation and technical constraints.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating artistic vision, visual problem\-solving and the ability to establish a consistent quality bar across multiple art disciplines.
* Proven experience joining and improving an established or live game, rather than only defining the direction of new projects from their earliest stages is desired.


**What we offer:**
 When you join Jagex you can look forward to a generous Perks \& Benefits package including:
   

  

* Private Healthcare, including Dental Plan.
* Discretionary annual performance bonus.
* Minimum 6% Pension contributions.
* Life Insurance.
* Enhanced family leave policies from day 1\.
* Flexible working hours.
* 25 days annual leave \+ Bank holidays \& the option to buy/sell holidays \+ so much more!


**Inclusion \& Accessibility** 
**Statement**
 We are committed to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and we recruit, develop, and promote based on merit and ability.
   

  

 If you require any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please let us know when you're invited to interview.
   

  

**About Jagex**
 We are Jagex: The RuneScape Company. Home to one of gaming's most enduring success stories. We create deep, community\-powered games with worlds that evolve, inspire, and endure. Our flagship MMORPG franchise, RuneScape, has welcomed over 300 million player accounts, inspiring generations of players across PC and mobile for 25 years.
   

  

 As we begin our 26th year, we are accelerating our strategy to expand RuneScape into a broader ecosystem of forever games and connected experiences, grounded in a renewed commitment to integrity and fair play. This includes the reduction of monetisation mechanics, as well as the launch of RuneScape: DragonWilds into Steam Early Access in 2025, representing a major step in building a multi\-genre future for the RuneScape universe. We remain focused on building enduring worlds, empowering player\-led innovation, and laying the foundations for the boldest era in RuneScape's history. For more information, visit https://www.jagex.com/ .
   

  

 Headquartered in Cambridge, United Kingdom, we are home to passionate creators, storytellers, engineers, and even a few dreamers, all united by a single mission to shape the future of online worlds and empower players to make them their own. We're looking for people to join us who share our ambitions and values. We foster an inclusive workplace built on trust, autonomy, and a shared passion for creating experiences that inspire our communities.
   

  

 Our values guide everything we do: We Embrace Fellowship by collaborating and sharing openly. We Hone our Craft by always learning and improving; We Honour our Vows by being honest and transparent; We are our Customers' Heroes by striving to understand our team \& player needs, and We Seize The Day by making the most of every opportunity.
   

  

 Join us. The next era of RuneScape and the next chapter of Jagex: The RuneScape Company starts now.

 Around half your time will be spent on a global sports brand moving into brand\-first, social\-first campaign work — brand guidelines, campaign toolkits, and regional and global rollouts. title: Senior Brand Creative Lead
description:
**About Korrus**


Korrus is transforming the way people interact with light. We are the leader in human\-centric lighting, built on more than 500 patents in spectral and circadian technology, and pioneers in Human Light Interaction, the next frontier in human health and wellness.


That work runs on three fronts:

* **Ecosense.** A globally known and respected leader in architectural and commercial lighting, and the business now bringing circadian technology into the spaces where people work, heal, learn, and gather.
* **OIO.** Our consumer brand, bringing circadian lighting into the home: biologically aligned light, the right spectrum at the right time of day, to support how people wake, focus, and rest.
* **Everything else in Human Light Interaction.** We are pushing the limits of what light can do for human health and performance, and we own the intellectual property to do it.

**The Role**
------------


This role owns the creative output of the brand end to end: the story it tells, the words that carry it, and the finished assets that bring it to life, at the speed the consumer business now requires. It is responsible for all creative.


It is a deliberate combination of skill sets that usually live in two or three people. We need the narrative instinct of a creative director, the writing ability of a copywriter, and the hands\-on production craft of a senior designer who can build the work to a high standard. One person who can find the story, write it, and make it.


This is an individual contributor role. The person in this seat does the work, not just directs it. They report directly to the CEO on an interim basis and operate with a high degree of creative autonomy. There is no CMO or CXO layer above them. They are the creative function.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

**1\. Brand Story and Narrative**

* Discover and shape the core stories that explain what motivates our customers and what makes our products and intellectual property distinct.
* Develop narrative frameworks and unifying themes that can carry campaigns, launches, and content over time, not one\-off concepts.
* Own the brand's voice and point of view, keeping emotional resonance and coherence consistent across every touchpoint.
* Translate science, product capability, and strategy into stories people can feel, remember, and repeat.

**2\. Copywriting and Messaging**

* Write all brand copy across advertising, organic social, website, email, product, and packaging, in both long and short form.
* Craft headlines, taglines, scripts, and body copy that carry a consistent brand voice and move the reader to act.
* Own the brand's written voice and enforce consistency across every channel and touchpoint.
* Edit, sharpen, and elevate copy produced by other contributors and external partners.

**3\. Design and Production Craft**

* Lead concept development and design execution across digital campaigns, organic social content, and print collateral for new product launches.
* Produce finished, on\-brand creative yourself, balancing visual sophistication with functional clarity.
* Support and evolve the Korrus and OIO visual identity systems, keeping consistency while pushing the work forward.
* Prepare final files to vendor specification and manage vendor sourcing and delivery when production requires it.
* Maintain visual continuity across digital, print, packaging, website, and social content.

**4\. Campaign and Content Production**

* Turn high\-level narrative into concrete creative direction, then execute against it.
* Build organic social content and ad creative for the consumer business, adapting by channel and audience while protecting the core story.
* Manage multiple projects at once, tracking deliverables, approvals, and timelines without sacrificing quality.

**5\. Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with the other creatives on the XDM team, the VP of Strategic Initiatives, the CEO, product, and external partners to synthesize insight into a coherent creative direction.
* Present creative rationale and visual direction to leadership, incorporating strategic and technical input.
* Direct freelancers, contractors, or external agencies when volume requires additional hands, holding the quality bar.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* A storyteller and writer first, with a strong point of view and the ability to make complexity feel clear and human.
* A genuine maker, equally comfortable shaping a narrative and sitting down to write the copy and build the asset yourself.
* Comfortable moving fast, deciding with imperfect information, and raising the creative bar in a dynamic environment.
* Self\-directed, able to own the creative function without a layer of creative management above you.
* A rare profile: someone who can write, design, and produce finished brand work end to end.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Six or more years in brand creative, design, or creative direction, with demonstrated work across branding, product, and campaign creative.
* A professional writing or copywriting background, with published or shipped copy across advertising and social.
* Highly proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and collaborative tools such as Figma.
* Working proficiency with current AI creative tools. Candidates will be tested on this during the selection process.
* A strong digital and video portfolio, showing narrative thinking, visual craft, and attention to hierarchy, typography, and composition.
* Proven success delivering compelling creative in fast\-paced, multi\-stakeholder environments.
* Familiarity with HTML and CSS and digital design systems.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience supporting consumer brands in wellness, technology, or lifestyle.
* Familiarity with industrial design integration.
* Understanding of responsive web layouts and mobile\-first visual systems.

**Portfolio Requirement**
-------------------------


Candidates must submit a portfolio that demonstrates all three dimensions of the role: narrative and brand storytelling, writing and copywriting, and hands\-on design and production craft. Include finished campaign, social, and product work, with writing samples that show range across long and short form. Strong copy that lacks visual craft, and strong craft with weak writing, will both fall short for this role.

**What This Role Is Not**
-------------------------

* Not a pure visual designer who waits for direction. This person originates the story and writes the copy.
* Not a pure strategist who hands off execution. This person builds the work.
* Not a writer who cannot design, or a designer who cannot write. This role requires both.

**Selection Process**
---------------------


As part of the selection process, candidates will be asked to demonstrate proficiency with a range of AI creative tools. Shortlisted candidates may also be invited to participate in a paid test project.

**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------


Story is not a layer added at the end. It is the intellectual and emotional infrastructure of the brand. This role exists to discover and shape the narratives that define how customers relate to the company, to write the words that carry them, and to produce the work that brings them into the world, at the speed and scale the consumer business now demands. Story is why any of it matters, and this is the person who owns it end to end.


Korrus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Engine**
 Engine is the all\-in\-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K\+ businesses and groups representing 1\.8M\+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, one of the fastest\-growing companies in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI\-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.
   

  

 That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025\), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026\), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026\).
   

  

 We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high\-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
   

  

 Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
   

  

**Your Mission**
 Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in\-product moments, and beyond.
   

  

 You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high\-performing, on\-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
   

  

 This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
 **build as much as they lead** 
 shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* **The AI\-assisted creative engine.** 
 Design the end\-to\-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.** 
 Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open\-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.** 
 Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high\-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.** 
 Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In\-person and experiential creative.** 
 Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.
* **Brand\-distinctive, entertainment\-first work.** 
 Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.
* **Testing velocity.** 
 Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.
* **The creative team.** 
 Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.


**How We'll Measure Success**
 Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test\-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in\-person moments.
   

  

 Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.
* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance\-driven digital work.
* Hands\-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct\-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems\-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast\-moving, AI\-forward environment.


*We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.*
**Compensation**
 Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.
   

  

 Base Pay Range
   

  

 $157,505—$218,000 USD
   

  

**The Engine Edge: Perks \& Compensation**
 We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:
   

  

* **Compensation:** 
 Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
* **Benefits:** 
 Check out our full list at engine.com/culture
* **Environments for Success:** 
 Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid\-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.


*Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more*

title: Creative Director, Brand Studio
description:
**About GitHub**
 GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.
   

  

**Locations**
 In this role you can work from Remote, United States
   

  

**Overview**
 GitHub is looking for a Creative Director to lead our Brand Studio, our world class creative design team responsible for shaping how GitHub shows up in the world.
   

  

 This team creates the visual identity and creative systems behind GitHub’s most important marketing moments, from global events and product launches to executive presentations, social content, blog storytelling, motion, illustration, and beyond. The work is highly visible, deeply cross\-functional, and central to how developers, customers, and Hubbers experience the GitHub brand.
   

  

 We’re looking for a creative leader who can guide a world\-class team without over\-directing it. Someone who understands how to translate executive priorities, brand strategy, product narratives, and business needs into clear creative direction. The ideal candidate will protect focus, raise the bar, and help the team do its best work, not by getting into every pixel, but by creating the conditions for great creative to happen.
   

  

 This role reports to the VP of Global Brand \& Marketing and will lead a tight\-knit, high\-functioning team of brand designers, motion designers, illustrators, and presentation designers.
   

  

 What success looks like:
   

  

 The right Creative Director will help GitHub’s Brand Studio continue to operate at a world\-class level while giving the team sharper focus, stronger connective tissue, and clearer creative direction.
   

  

 They will not be expected to reinvent a high\-functioning team from scratch. Instead, they will help the studio scale its impact: interpreting the needs of the business, protecting the craft, strengthening the brand system, and ensuring GitHub’s creative work feels unmistakably GitHub—whether it appears on a keynote stage, in a campaign, on social, in a product launch, or inside a deck for our most senior leaders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead GitHub’s Brand Studio team, providing clear creative direction, strong people leadership, and thoughtful prioritization across a broad range of marketing and brand work.
* Translate business, brand, product, and executive signals into compelling creative strategy and actionable direction for the team.
* Partner closely with Brand Strategy \& Narrative, Integrated Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, Events, Communications, Social, Web, Brand Experience, and executive stakeholders to ensure the GitHub brand is showing up with clarity, consistency, and creative excellence.
* Guide the development of visual systems for campaigns, events, launches, executive storytelling, social moments, editorial content, presentations, and other high\-impact brand experiences.
* Protect the team’s focus by helping sort signal from noise, clarify priorities, manage stakeholder expectations, and ensure the studio is working on the highest\-value creative opportunities.
* Champion the GitHub visual identity, ensuring the brand remains distinct, modern, developer\-authentic, and creatively ambitious.
* Evolve scalable creative systems, templates, guidelines, and design practices that allow the brand to travel consistently across teams, channels, and regions.
* Maintain the team’s culture grounded in trust, craft, collaboration, experimentation, and high standards.
* Coach and develop a talented team of creative specialists, helping each person grow their impact while preserving the autonomy and creative energy that make the studio special.
* Partner with external agencies, freelancers, and production partners when needed, ensuring outside work meets GitHub’s creative bar and brand standards.
* Work closely with the Brand Experience (site) team to ensure the brand is clear, cohesive, and compelling across all web and product surfaces.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* 12\+ years experience in product or brand design
+ OR Bachelor's Degree in Industrial, Graphic or Motion Design, Product Design, Human Computer Interaction, or related field AND 10\+ years experience in product or brand design
+ OR Master's Degree in Industrial, Graphic or Motion Design, Product Design, Human Computer Interaction, or related field AND 8\+ years experience in product or brand design
+ OR Doctorate in Industrial, Graphic or Motion Design, Product Design, Human Computer Interaction, or related field AND 6\+ years experience in product or brand design
+ OR equivalent experience.

* 5\+ years designing brand systems, visual identity, creative production, and how design scales across marketing channels and organizational needs.
* 5\+ years people management experience


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* A genuine curiosity about developers, software, AI, open source, and GitHub’s role in shaping the future of how the world builds.
* Strong stakeholder management instincts, including the ability to push back with diplomacy, protect creative quality, and keep teams focused.
* Experience partnering across marketing, product, events, communications, web, and executive teams.
* Proven ability to lead senior creative talent without micromanaging. Setting direction, sharpening ideas, and raising the bar while giving teams room to do their best work.
* Ability to balance creative ambition with business realities, timelines, resources, and operational constraints.


**Compensation Range**
 The base salary range for this job is USD $140,400\.00 \- USD $372,300\.00 /Yr.
   

  

 These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

**GitHub values**
* Customer\-obsessed
* Ship to learn
* Growth mindset
* Own the outcome
* Better together
* Diverse and inclusive


**Manager fundamentals**
* Model
* Coach
* Care


**Leadership principles**
* Create clarity
* Generate energy
* Deliver success


**Who We Are**
 GitHub is the world’s leading AI\-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open\-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open\-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
   

  

 Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote\-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
   

  

 Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

description:

 Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Where And How You Can Work**
 Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals. While we support flexible, remote\-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Mexico City so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.
   

  

 This role is a 12 month engagement, working full time hours per week.
   

  

**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
 As Creative Strategist for Mexico, you’ll be the creative performance engine behind Canva’s paid marketing in the region.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Growth, and Data \- combining cultural insight, analytical depth, and creative instinct to continuously improve our performance marketing output. You won’t be running bids day\-to\-day \- you’ll be driving the creative strategy that makes those campaigns win.
   

  

 If you love decoding what makes a hook scroll\-stopping, turning insights into structured testing, and raising the creative bar sprint after sprint, this role is for you.
   

  

**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**
* Leading the full creative cycle \- research, briefing, production, and performance review — running weekly sprint cycles that balance quick\-win iterations with bigger creative swings, and feeding learnings back to the broader team after every sprint
* Digging into performance dashboards to spot winning patterns, diagnose underperformance, and translate insights into clear, actionable creative direction that drives the next round of concepts
* Directing and collaborating with video editors, designers, writers, and local creators to produce high\-quality work across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels \- briefing and reviewing content to keep it on\-brand, culturally relevant, and platform\-optimised
* Bringing deep cultural fluency to every brief \- identifying Mexican audience behaviours, regional trends, and platform dynamics that shape compelling, locally resonant storytelling
* Working closely with media buyers, data science, and the LatAm Growth Marketing Lead to make sure creative insights translate into measurable business outcomes
* Driving CRO initiatives that improve acquisition journeys and lift conversion efficiency across key touchpoints
* Using AI tools to accelerate ideation, research, asset generation, and analysis \- and staying across emerging formats and creative tech that give the team an edge


**You’re Probably a Match If**
* You have solid experience in growth or performance marketing with a strong focus on creative strategy \- and you've worked hands\-on across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube
* You can lead structured creative testing and sprint frameworks, analyse what's working, and turn those learnings into clear briefs for the next cycle
* You have strong creative instinct \- you know what makes a hook scroll\-stopping, a format compelling, and a concept scalable across channels
* You're fluent in Spanish and English, with a sharp eye for tone, nuance, and cultural resonance for Mexican audiences
* You have experience briefing, directing, and iterating with creative talent — video editors, designers, writers, and creators \- coaching them to produce performance\-driven work
* You're confident using dashboards and analytics tools to inform decisions and optimise creative at scale

1\.1 The Creative Director is the custodian of EVA Interiors’ creative vision, design quality, and aesthetic integrity across all interior design, architectural, and FF\&E outputs.
 



 1\.2 The role exists to institutionalize creativity at EVA Interiors by transforming creative vision into clear standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks, ensuring consistency, excellence, and repeatable quality at scale.
 



 1\.3 The Creative Director ensures that EVA’s creative output reflects a luxury positioning that is innovative, disciplined, commercially viable, and execution\-ready, while continuously evolving to remain relevant and distinctive in the market.
 



  





**2\.1 Creative Vision, Guidelines \& Governance** 



* The Creative Director defines, documents, and continuously refines EVA Interiors’ creative philosophy and design language, ensuring that spatial principles, material hierarchy, detailing standards, colour strategies, and FF\&E integration are formalised within approved governance frameworks.
* The role ensures that all creative outputs demonstrably comply with documented standards, and that any deviation is formally identified, evaluated, and addressed through structured corrective governance mechanisms rather than informal tolerance.
* The Creative Director maintains executive oversight of all design\-related SOPs to ensure sustained alignment between creative integrity, structured workflows, and disciplined project execution.
* Creative standards shall be applied consistently across all projects and shall be subject to continuous refinement informed by documented review outcomes, performance analysis, and institutional learning.



**2\.2 Measurable Creative Output \& First Time\-Right Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative leadership translates into measurable, predictable, and disciplined quality outcomes.
* A minimum first\-submission approval rate of (80%) shall be maintained across formal design reviews, unless deviations are supported by documented root cause analysis and clearly defined corrective action plans.
* Review cycles shall remain within agreed revision thresholds. Recurrent rework patterns shall trigger structured evaluation, accountability review, and systemic improvement measures rather than normalization.
* All scheduled creative reviews constitute mandatory leadership obligations. Attendance shall be maintained consistently. In cases of unavoidable absence, formal delegation of documented decision authority shall be established in advance. Any missed review shall require written explanation and rescheduling within (24\) hours.
* Approvals, rejections, and required design modifications shall be communicated within agreed review timelines to prevent avoidable production delays or adverse impact on project revenue realization, forecast integrity, or client confidence.
* Review feedback and formal approval decisions shall be issued within (24\) hours of the review session unless otherwise formally justified in writing.
* Creative authority within EVA shall operate as a performance accelerator and governance safeguard, never as a constraint on disciplined production.



**2\.3 Structured Review Cadence \& Institutional Discipline** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for maintaining a defined, documented, and consistently executed creative governance rhythm across the organization.
* At minimum, one structured Creative Review session shall be led weekly, and one formal Quality Retrospective shall be conducted monthly. Each session shall produce documented minutes, clearly assigned accountability, and tracked follow\-up actions.
* Recurring quality deviations, review inefficiencies, or creative inconsistencies shall be translated into updated guidelines, strengthened enforcement protocols, or revised governance standards.
* Creative governance within EVA shall be cyclical, documented, and continuously reinforced to ensure institutional maturity and sustained quality performance.



**2\.4 Commercial Alignment \& Revenue Protection** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative decisions are aligned with approved project timelines, revenue realization schedules, forecast commitments, and overall project profitability.
* The Creative Director shall collaborate with Planning and Operations to ensure that creative timelines and review cycles are realistically reflected in revenue forecasts, milestone commitments, and execution sequencing.
* Creative refinement shall not introduce avoidable delays that negatively affect revenue progression, cash flow timing, forecast accuracy, or client confidence.
* Where creative ambition presents potential timeline, cost, or commercial exposure, such implications shall be proactively identified, formally evaluated, and resolved in coordination with project leadership and Executive Management.
* Design excellence within EVA is expected to unlock commercial value while preserving disciplined control over schedule, cost, and revenue integrity.



**2\.5 Escalation \& Risk Management Obligation** 



* Any creative, quality, review\-related, or design governance issue that may materially impact project timelines, revenue realization, client confidence, or brand reputation shall be escalated to Executive Management within (24\) hours.
* Escalation shall include a documented impact assessment, root cause analysis, and proposed mitigation strategy.
* No material creative risk shall remain unaddressed, undocumented, or without executive visibility.



**2\.6 Enforcement Authority \& Team Performance Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for enforcing compliance with approved design standards, governance frameworks, and review discipline across all design personnel.
* Where repeated non\-compliance, quality deviation, review absence, or execution inconsistency occurs, the Creative Director shall initiate structured corrective action in coordination with Executive Management and Human Resources.
* Delegation of responsibilities does not eliminate accountability for creative outcomes. Enforcement authority is inherent to the role and integral to its seniority, Sustained failure to meet defined governance cadence, revision thresholds, escalation timelines, or documented enforcement obligations shall constitute performance non\-compliance and shall be subject to formal performance review in accordance with company policy.



**2\.7 Innovation \& Strategic Creative Development** 



* The Creative Director leads structured innovation initiatives designed to enhance differentiation, strengthen quality standards, and improve execution efficiency.
* Innovation must be practical, buildable, commercially responsible, and clearly linked to brand positioning or project value.
* Creative experimentation must be governed, documented, and selectively integrated into live projects where appropriate.



**2\.8 FF\&E Library Governance \& Design Asset Control** 



* The Creative Director holds strategic ownership of EVA’s FF\&E Library and ensures that it remains curated, quality\-controlled, commercially viable, and aligned with EVA’s luxury positioning.
* All additions shall meet defined standards of originality, feasibility, execution readiness, and brand coherence.
* The FF\&E Library shall function as an active production, quality\-control, and creative governance asset supporting consistency and efficiency across projects.



**2\.9 Leadership Presence \& Accessibility** 



* The Creative Director is expected to maintain consistent on\-site leadership presence during critical review cycles, high\-visibility project phases, and production\-intensive periods.
* Leadership availability and accessibility are structural expectations of the role. Remote work arrangements shall not compromise review cadence, enforcement discipline, team accessibility, or executive responsiveness and require formal approval in accordance with company policy.
* Creative leadership within EVA requires visible authority, sustained engagement, and operational presence commensurate with the seniority of the role.
