title: Art Director/Graphic Designer
description:
SEEN is looking for an **Art Director** with graphic design skills to help define, evolve, and express the SEEN brand.

SEEN operates at the intersection of outdoor media, music, art, fashion, culture, and the streets. We’ve built a physical business with a distinct point of view, and we want the brand around it to be just as distinctive.

We believe the physical world still matters, the cities we love, the streets that give them their character, and the people who bring them to life. Great work should live in those places, become part of the landscape, and be experienced in the real world, not simply scrolled past on a screen.

**THE ROLE**

The Art Director will own the visual expression of SEEN across the brand, from major brand initiatives and presentations to social content, digital, print, apparel, events, and everything in between.

You’ll help establish a consistent visual language for SEEN while also doing a substantial amount of the actual design work.

You should have strong creative instincts and excellent taste, but also be the person who can sit down at a computer and make the thing.

This is a role for someone who can move comfortably between big\-picture creative thinking and detailed execution.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Help define and evolve the visual identity and creative direction of SEEN
* Develop the visual language, aesthetic, and overall creative point of view of the brand
* Design a wide range of materials across digital, print, social, presentations, environmental, editorial, and physical applications
* Lead the design and development of SEEN's brand presentations, sales materials, decks, case studies, marketing materials, and internal communications
* Develop creative concepts and visual storytelling around the SEEN brand, its spaces, people, projects, and history
* Help shape how SEEN shows up across its website, social channels, events, physical spaces, apparel, and other brand touchpoints
* Work closely with leadership to translate ideas, stories, and business objectives into compelling creative
* Bring consistency across the SEEN brand and related initiatives, while allowing each to have its own character
* Build creative systems and templates that allow the team to move quickly without everything feeling templated
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously and take work from initial concept through final production

**YOU SHOULD BE**

**A designer first.** You have a strong command of typography, layout, composition, image\-making, branding, presentation design, and visual storytelling.

**Highly hands\-on.** You’re comfortable doing the work yourself and can handle a significant design workload without needing a designer underneath you to execute your ideas.

**Conceptually strong.** You can step back from the individual piece and think about the larger story, visual identity, and point of view behind it.

**Someone with taste.** You know the difference between something that is genuinely interesting and something that is simply trying to look cool.

**Culturally aware.** You have a natural understanding of music, art, fashion, street culture, photography, architecture, and contemporary visual culture.

**Resourceful.** You can take a loose idea and turn it into something tangible. You don't need a 20\-page brief to get started.

**Detail\-oriented.** You care about the last 5%, the typography, spacing, image selection, crop, paper, scale, and all the other details that separate good work from great work.

**Comfortable with ambiguity.** SEEN is growing and evolving. This isn't a role where everything has already been defined for you.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* 5\+ years of professional experience in art direction, graphic design, branding, or a related creative field
* A **strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional graphic design and art direction**
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and the tools you use to do your best work
* Strong typography, layout, branding, presentation, and visual storytelling skills
* Experience taking projects from concept through execution
* Experience directing photography or other visual content is a plus
* Experience in music, fashion, art, media, advertising, editorial, or culture is highly relevant
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Ability to manage a high volume of work while maintaining a high creative standard

**MOST IMPORTANTLY**

We already know who SEEN is. We’ve built the brand, the business, and the point of view. What we’re looking for is someone who can refine, sharpen, and evolve it as we move into our next chapter.

You’ll help us identify where the brand can be stronger, more cohesive, and more distinctive, and then bring those ideas to life across everything SEEN puts into the world.

This is not a purely conceptual role. **You need to be a highly capable designer who can execute.** There will be a significant amount of hands\-on design work, from decks and presentations to brand materials, digital, social, and new brand initiatives.

We’re looking for someone with strong creative instincts and exceptional taste who can think strategically about the brand, but is equally comfortable opening Illustrator, InDesign, or Photoshop and doing the work themselves.

description:
**Client Partner (CBS)**  

We are looking for an experienced Enterprise Client Partner to accelerate our growth across Consumer \& Business Services (CBS) enterprise accounts. As a wholly owned subsidiary of TCS, one of the world’s largest global IT consultancies, Coastal combines high\-touch boutique agility with unmatched enterprise scale, credibility, and reach.  

  

This is a hybrid "seller\-doer" executive role: you will own net\-new enterprise logo pursuits and major account expansion across CBS while remaining part\-billable (typically 25%–35% target utilization) as a strategic executive advisor and steering committee lead on key customer engagements. You will not simply close deals and hand them over; you will partner closely with TCS and Salesforce leadership to win transformative programs and stay strategically embedded post\-sale to drive high\-value advisory roadmaps, executive governance, and long\-term customer lifetime value.  

  

The ideal candidate possesses deep roots in the Salesforce ecosystem, deep understanding of the CBS sector (including Retail, Consumer Packaged Goods, Hospitality, Travel, and Professional/Business Services), and familiarity with adjacent enterprise architectures (such as ERP, Snowflake, MuleSoft, and Tableau). You understand that winning and retaining Tier\-1 CBS enterprise accounts requires a blend of industry credibility, commercial rigor, C\-suite relationship building, and hands\-on consulting leadership.
  

**Role Responsibilities:**
  

**Commercial Growth \& Co\-Selling Motion (\~65%–75% Focus)**
* **Drive Enterprise Bookings:** Own and execute go\-to\-market pursuit strategies across Tier\-1 CBS enterprise accounts (Retail, CPG, Travel/Hospitality, Logistics, and Professional/Business Services), managing complex, multi\-million\-dollar, multi\-year digital transformation pursuits.
* **TCS \& Salesforce Alignment:** Co\-sell closely with Salesforce leadership (Enterprise RVPs, AEs, and Industry Solution Advisors across Commerce Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Revenue Cloud, and Service Cloud) and align in a joint, paired\-coverage model (“two\-in\-a\-box”) with TCS Client Partners to position Coastal as the dedicated Salesforce Center of Excellence.
* **Whitespace Origination:** Leverage TCS’s vast global footprint to identify and capture Salesforce and data transformation whitespace within established CBS enterprise accounts.
* **Commercial Deal Structuring:** Lead pursuit strategy, proposal development, commercial modeling, and SOW architecture in close collaboration with Pre\-Sales and Delivery Leadership, ensuring deal economics reflect delivery realities and margin targets.
* **Pipeline \& Forecasting:** Maintain disciplined pipeline management within Salesforce, accurately forecasting long\-cycle enterprise pursuits, software influence, and professional services revenue.
* **Executive Relationship Building:** Establish and nurture relationships with C\-level stakeholders (CIOs, CTOs, CROs, CMOs) across CBS enterprises, guiding them through strategic decision\-making and digital transformation roadmaps.

**Billable Delivery \& Executive Advisory (\~25%–35% Target Utilization)**
* **Lead Paid Strategic Roadmaps \& Discovery:** Lead billable, paid advisory engagements (e.g., 4\- to 6\-week "True North" roadmaps, enterprise operating model assessments, Lead\-to\-Cash and omnichannel fulfillment process optimizations, unified commerce roadmaps, and platform rationalization studies) ahead of large\-scale implementations.
* **Executive Steering Committee Governance:** Serve as the named, billable Executive Sponsor / Engagement Director on high\-stakes programs, leading monthly and quarterly executive steering committees with client executives.
* **Delivery\-to\-Expansion Continuity:** Maintain regular, billable strategic advisory check\-ins with client sponsors during implementation to bridge pre\-sales commitments with actual delivery execution, protecting project health and identifying Phase 2\+ expansion opportunities.
* **C\-Suite Advisory:** Serve as an embedded, trusted transformation advisor for client executives navigating enterprise\-scale platform consolidation, AI\-driven workflows (Agentforce), and data modernizations across modern omnichannel, direct\-to\-consumer, and B2B service business models.

**Experience/Skills Required:**
* **15\+ years of enterprise consulting \& commercial leadership** within the Salesforce ecosystem or enterprise IT services, with deep domain experience in Consumer \& Business Services (CBS) (Retail, CPG, Travel/Hospitality, or Professional/Business Services) and a proven track record of closing and governing multi\-million\-dollar, multi\-year programs.
* **Demonstrated "Seller\-Doer":** Proven experience in a hybrid role (Client Partner, Managing Director, Practice Lead, or Principal) where you carried accountability for both an enterprise bookings quota and billable client utilization.
* **Enterprise Platform \& Multi\-Cloud Fluency**: Strong architectural understanding of enterprise\-grade Salesforce solutions (Core Cloud, Revenue Cloud/CPQ, Commerce Cloud, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Service Cloud) and adjacent ecosystem platforms (Snowflake, MuleSoft, Tableau, and core ERP integrations like SAP/Oracle).
* **GSI \& Ecosystem Co\-Selling:** Proven track record operating within or alongside a Global Systems Integrator (GSI) like TCS, navigating matrixed pursuit teams and structured co\-sell motions with enterprise software partners.
* **Executive Polish \& C\-Suite Presence**: Seasoned facilitator and communicator capable of commanding boardrooms, leading RFP orals, and running C\-level executive steering committees.
* **Travel:** Willingness to travel (up to approximately 50\-75%, including potential international travel for key accounts) for high\-impact pursuit pitches, key steering committees, and client executive sessions.
* **Work Authorization:** Must have full\-time permanent US work authorization.

**Additional Preferred Experience/Skills:**
* Prior foundational background as a hands\-on Management Consultant, Solution Architect, or Delivery Director prior to transitioning into commercial account leadership.
* Experience running structured enterprise discovery methodologies (such as Salesforce "True North," design thinking workshops, or capability maturity assessments).
* Hands\-on or advisory experience within the Salesforce ecosystem. Experience with Agentforce and other AI\-driven implementations strongly preferred.
* Prior quota\-carrying experience within a GSI\-affiliated or partner\-ecosystem sales organization.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Why Coastal, and what we offer:**
* Flexible working hours with an emphasis on a life\-work balance (in that order!)
* Unlimited Paid Time Off (RTO), 401K with Company Match, and Medical, Vision, \& Dental coverage
* Competitive quarterly bonus opportunities
* Continuing education and certification reimbursements, specifically within the Salesforce and Snowflake ecosystems; plus occasional in\-house competitions with spot bonuses
* Monthly All\-Hands calls to bring the company together, and an open\-door leadership policy with access to mentorship and guidance
* Opportunities for accelerated growth, networking, and career guidance and support
* Trust, transparency and respect across all levels of the company

description:
**About The Role**
 We’re hiring a Design Director to lead Product Design across our Spending, Savings, and Investing experiences. You’ll shape how millions of members interact with their money every day—from the experiences they rely on most often to the ones that help them build toward what’s next.
   

  

 This role calls for a leader who pairs exceptional visual craft with strong product thinking. You’ll set a high bar for how our products look, feel, and work; build a clear design vision across a connected portfolio; and lead a talented team of designers in turning complex financial experiences into products that feel simple, intuitive, and distinctly Chime. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Data, and Brand to make that vision real.
   

  

 The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $242,000 and up to $335,000\. Full\-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
   

  

 In this role, you can expect to
   

  

* Set the design vision and quality bar across our Spending, Savings, and Investing experiences, creating products that feel cohesive, intuitive, and unmistakably Chime.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of product designers, helping them strengthen their craft, expand their impact, and do the best work of their careers.
* Bring a strong point of view on visual and interaction design, using your craft expertise to push the work from good to exceptional while empowering designers to own the solutions.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, identify the highest\-impact opportunities, and translate ambitious ideas into compelling member experiences.
* Think across individual features and journeys to create a connected product experience, balancing immediate member needs with a longer\-term design vision.
* Use research, customer insights, data, and experimentation to understand what matters to our members and guide design decisions.
* Champion design excellence across Chime, contributing to the evolution of our product language, design systems, critique culture, and broader design practice.


 To thrive in this role, you have
   

  

* Experience leading and developing high\-performing product design teams responsible for complex, consumer\-facing digital products.
* A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates exceptional visual and interaction design craft, alongside the ability to translate that standard into the work of a broader team.
* A track record of creating and delivering compelling design visions across multiple products, journeys, or interconnected experiences.
* Deep product design expertise and the judgment to move comfortably between high\-level strategy and the details that make an experience exceptional.
* Experience partnering with senior Product and Engineering leaders to influence product strategy and deliver meaningful customer and business outcomes.
* Experience building strong design teams through coaching, feedback, critique, and talent development.
* The ability to communicate a clear design point of view, bring people along with your thinking, and create clarity in complex or ambiguous spaces.


**A Little About Us**
 At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank\*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user\-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.
   

  

 We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out\-hustle and out\-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.
   

  

 We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.
   

  

 We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.
   

  

 Because if we don't—who will?
   

  

* Chime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A., Members FDIC.


**What We Offer For Our Full\-time, Regular Employees**
* 🏢 Our in\-office work policy is designed to keep you connected \- with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company\-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.
* 💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
* ✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
* 🏝 Generous vacation policy and company\-wide paid days off
* 🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
* 👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
* 👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non\-birthing parents
* 👪 Access to family planning reimbursement
* 💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress


 We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.
   

  

 Chime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Cook County Ordinance, NYC Fair Chance Act, and the LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and consistent with Canadian provincial and federal laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact: accommodations@chime.com.

title: Visual Design Director
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a visionary leader to define the visual aesthetic of the Nutanix product portfolio and transform the way our Visual Design team operates in the age of AI. As the Visual Design Director, you will hold a high\-impact leadership role within the User Experience Design organization. Your mission is to elevate our brand within the product experience, leading the evolution of our comprehensive design system, illustration library, motion design, and overall aesthetic strategy. You and your team will transform complex technical concepts into intuitive, beautiful, and world\-class digital experiences that set the industry standard for enterprise software.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will join a global, multidisciplinary design organization that includes Visual Designers, UX Designers, UX Researchers, UX Engineers and more. We are a passionate group of creators dedicated to bringing elegance and simplicity to powerful, technically complex systems. At Nutanix, we make cloud computing simple, and we achieve this through relentless focus on the user and a commitment to delivering high quality, consumer\-grade design.
   

  

 In this role, you will report to the Senior Director of Design, a leader who values a strong design acumen, people centric leadership, and effective cross functional collaboration. Our team operates with a strong bias for action, valuing "doing" over "saying," and we pride ourselves on driving ambitious projects to closure.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Build and scale a high\-performing, inclusive, and diverse visual design team that spans across multiple geographies.
* Reimagine our visual design practice with the latest AI technologies and tooling.
* Deliver a scalable and accessible design system in close partnership with engineering.
* Craft and execute a long\-term vision for the Visual Design function that aligns with business objectives.
* Drive a compelling visual vision that brings clarity, usability, and competitive differentiation to Nutanix products.
* Lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team (visual, illustration, motion) to reach new heights of creativity.
* Advocate for the value of visual design at all levels of the organization.
* Apply up\-to\-date knowledge of current design trends and emerging technologies to keep Nutanix at the forefront of the industry.
* Engage meaningfully with engineering teams on implementation feasibility within a highly technical environment.
* Elevate design quality across the Nutanix product portfolio.
* Partner with Marketing to ensure a seamless "one\-brand" experience.
* Establish a strong team identity and culture that attracts top\-tier talent.
* Mentor and develop designers to succeed in enterprise environments, fostering both technical proficiency and soft skills.
* Exhibit a high "say vs. do" ratio; removing roadblocks and resolving cross\-functional dependencies to drive projects to conclusion.


**What You Will Bring**
* Design Expertise: A strong design sensibility with a professional background in Visual Design, Graphic Design, or a related creative field.
* Proven Leadership: Extensive experience leading, managing and scaling teams of creative professionals in a fast\-paced environment.
* Mastery of UI design, typography, color theory, layout, hierarchy, etc.
* Deep experience producing, managing, and scaling enterprise\-grade design systems.
* An obsession with detail and a passion for high\-fidelity execution.
* A mature leadership style with the ability to drive alignment across diverse engineering, product, and executive stakeholders.
* Inclusivity: Strong experience with web accessibility (WCAG) and inclusive design principles.
* Enterprise Experience: Familiarity with cloud computing or similarly complex technical domains is a significant plus.


**Work Arrangement**
 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.
   

  

 The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $243,000 and USD $486,000 per year.
   

  

 However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign\-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
   

  

 If hired, employee will be in an “at\-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.

title: HR Director
description:
Eterniti is the leading operator of vacation rentals in iconic holiday destinations, led by a passion for excellence, authentic adventures, and hospitality. With over €2 billion in assets under management, we operate 800\+ chalets, villas and apartments under 3 consumer brands: Emerald Stay (our 4\* brand), Bo House (our 5\* brand) and Verbier Exclusive (our Palace brand). Our guests can discover our properties in more than 25 exceptional destinations across Europe and North America. We are a fast\-growing company generating around €100M in annual revenue, backed by more than €50M raised from top\-tier investors. Join us at a pivotal moment, with the ambition and the means to keep raising the bar.  

  

We are looking for a talented **part\-time People Director (50\-60%)** to join our dynamic team, at our Barcelona office. In this role, you will be exposed to an international group spanning various business units, where your ability to protect and nurture our culture and to excel at recruitment will be absolutely key to your success.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES**  

  

**Strategic HR \& business partnering**

* Act as HR Business Partner for all companies in the group.
* Ensure HR monitoring and compliance.
* Be accountable for the OKRs process, together with our Chief of Staff.
* Run the annual employee survey and propose an annual HR plan based on the results.
* Own, monitor and act on the people dashboards to steer performance across destinations.
* Prepare the people slides for our board meetings.

**Culture, communication \& engagement**

* Be the guardian of our group's culture.
* Lead HR and internal communication projects (internal newsletters, AI trainings, Learning \& Development, etc.).
* Organise and host our annual offsite for the Eterniti and Emerald Stay team.

**Talent acquisition \& development**

* Oversee recruitment and training.
* Participate in team members' onboardings and offboardings.
* Deliver individual training sessions (e.g. presentation or communication skills).
* Help managers develop their coaching and mentoring skills.

**Team management, entities \& tools**

* Manage two HR team members.
* Complete the HR integration with the Jewels (acquired companies).
* Handle key individual HR matters and HR situations that escalate.
* Be accountable for our HR tools: JazzHR and Skello.


Depending on priorities as well as your bandwidth, skills and interest, you may be involved in other projects, in line with your qualifications.

 **KEY INFORMATION**

* Employment start: as soon as possible.
* Reporting to the CEO (Maxime Friess) and COO (Laurent Lacourt).
* Position based in Barcelona.
* Occasional travel across our entities and destinations, as needed
* Permanent contract (indefinite Spanish contract)
* Part\-time position: 20 to 24 hours / week (i.e 50%\-60%). Workdays will be Tuesdays and Wednesdays (at the office), plus another half\-day or weekday to be confirmed (home office possible).
* The application journey has 5 key steps:
	+ Step 1: screening call for selected candidates.
	+ Step 2: case study.
	+ Step 3: video interview with our Chief People Officer and our HR Manager.
	+ Step 4: video interview with our COO.
	+ Step 5: video interview with our CEO.
	+ Step 6: references check.

 **ABOUT YOU**

**We’d love to hear from you if…**

* You have solid senior HR / People experience, ideally across several entities or countries: at least 5 years.
* You are an entrepreneur at heart and have prior experience at a fast\-growing startup \- we expect you to be proactive and constructive at all times; you thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* You combine strategic HR business partnering with a hands\-on, get\-things\-done approach.
* You are a natural people leader who builds trust and handles confidential matters with discretion.
* You have a good working knowledge of labour and employment frameworks (France and Spain a plus).
* You are comfortable steering with data, dashboards and KPIs, and strong with digital tools.
* You speak (and write) French and English fluently; Spanish is a plus.
* You can work in the EU without visa sponsorship.

**ABOUT US**


We offer a work environment that values and empowers people while fostering personal development. Our culture is dictated by the following values :

* **Make Mistakes** \- We foster a creative environment where the best ideas win, where it is okay to make mistakes and unacceptable not to learn from them.
* **Question** \- We don't accept the status quo and look for ways to leverage technology while empowering people.
* **Speak Up** \- We are true people who give honest feedback, who are not afraid to share opinions and who don't talk behind one's back.
* **Think Big** \- While staying humble, we aim for the stars and work towards established goals and metrics.
* **Don’t Compromise** \- We are obsessed with quality, like a Swiss watchmaker.
* **Care** \- We care about our team members, our partners and our clients, and make our passion and our work one and the same.


We are demanding \- everyone really counts at Eterniti. But keep in mind that we value hard work and give growth opportunities to those who deserve it. We want you to grow with the company.  

  

*We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to any characteristic unrelated to their skills and experience.*

**Oh, we’ve got perks...**

* **Flexible work environment**: we have a flexible home office policy; you'll work at the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, the rest of the time, it's up to you. Feeling like working with another view? We offer 15 days yearly of remote work from wherever you’d like
* **Flexible benefits**: you’ll get a card to spend on what matters most to you: food, transport, or health insurance to optimize your net income
* **Discount on Emerald stays**, during specific periods, on selected properties
* **Regular team outings and events**: because work is fun when you’re part of an awesome team
* **External coaching**: for supervisor level and above \- we believe and invest in you
* **Anniversary perks**

 **Ready to join?**

### **If you're willing to bring your creativity, passion for service, and high\-energy vibe to Eterniti, we want to hear from you. Apply today and let's start this exciting journey together!**

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.  

  

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7\-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.  

  

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organization. You'll set and execute the strategy for how we build revenue analytics across Salesforce and Looker, run insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business, partner closely with revenue leadership on the full range of topics they face, and, as you ramp up, take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.


This is a generalist role by design: analytics is the foundation, especially in your first two quarters, and the role broadens from there to include business partnering and forecasting. What matters most is the versatility to move across all three, not depth in any single one.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.
* First 180 days: Build a highly automated revenue insights engine using AI, while establishing yourself as the business partner revenue leadership.
* First 12 months: Broaden into leading and supporting the forecasting cadence.

**What Will You Be Doing?**
---------------------------

**Revenue Analytics \& Insights**

* Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.
* Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.
* Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider revenue leadership team rely on.
* Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.
* Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

**Business Partnership to Revenue leadership**

* Become the go\-to Revenue Operations partner for revenue leadership, covering reporting, insights, and the broader range of topics that come up in running a sales organization.
* Translate revenue leadership's open questions into structured analysis and clear, actionable recommendations.
* Represent revenue's priorities into the Revenue Operations roadmap, and vice versa.
* Support revenue leaders in business reviews, planning moments, and ad hoc requests with credible, fast turnaround.

**Forecasting**

* Run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders alongside the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking.
* Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion.
* Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.

**What Will You Need to Succeed?**
----------------------------------

* 5\+ years of experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.
* Exposure to Account Executive (AE) or similarly quota\-carrying organization.
* Strong Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business\-first approach to data.
* A genuine generalist mindset — as comfortable building a dashboard or an insights report, as running a forecasting call.
* A track record of setting direction and quality bar for analytical work.
* Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to work with and influence sales leadership and revenue executives.
* Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end: framing the question, choosing the method, landing the recommendation.
* Excellent written communication — the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role.
* Experience partnering with global or multi\-region teams is a plus.

**What we Offer**
-----------------

* Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk.
* Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays.
* Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance.
* Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen.
* Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party.
* Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market\-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.
* Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan.
* Focus on your family with 17 weeks' paid parental leave during your child's first year.
* Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes.
* Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year.
* Nurture your language skills with real\-life English, Spanish, and Catalan lessons.
* Follow your passions and take a four\-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years.
* Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support.

 **AI at Perk**  

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day\-to\-day are AI\-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work \- the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do \- so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

**How We Work**


At Perk, we take an IRL\-first approach to work, where our team works together in\-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.


For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.


Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

**Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams**


All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security \[at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager — GenAI & Agentic Systems
description:
**About the opportunity**
=========================



We are seeking a seasoned Senior Product Manager to join the "Intelligent Operations Platforms" (IOP) segment. In this role, you will drive the development of AI solutions \- spanning both Machine Learning and Generative AI \- that empower our teams and help N26 lead the financial industry through technology.



Our AI Products team acts as a central hub of innovation. We don't just build features; we build and manage AI capabilities that allow every other part of the bank \- from Financial Crime and Risk to Growth and Marketing \- to become smarter. You will work at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and real\-world banking, turning sophisticated models into scalable products that improve efficiency, compliance and the customer experience.


### **In this role, you will:**


* **Partner Strategically with Senior Product Leadership:** Work closely with cross\-functional PM leads to shape and align your domain roadmap with N26's broader company\-wide AI strategy, maintaining full autonomy over complex, high\-stakes workstreams.
* **Drive Measurable Business Impact:** Focus on high\-impact areas, including automating back\-office Operations, enhancing real\-time fraud and AML detection (FinCrime), and personalizing B2C customer growth and marketing journeys.
* **Own the Production AI Lifecycle:** Lead end to end delivery for complex Machine Learning and GenAI initiatives—moving from initial hypothesis, data scoping, and model evaluation harnesses to production deployment and post\-launch monitoring.
* **Bridge Engineering and Business Strategy:** Act as the technical sparring partner for Data Scientists and ML Engineers, translating business constraints into model requirements and ensuring technical architectures solve real consumer and operational problems.
* **Balance Velocity with Banking Rigor:** Manage day\-to\-day delivery, maintaining a healthy balance between launching innovative AI capabilities and upholding the strict security, auditability, data privacy, and reliability standards expected of a regulated bank.
* **Empower Autonomous AI Adoption:** Act as an AI evangelist and platform owner by defining standards, blueprints, and self\-service toolkits that allow product squads across N26 to integrate AI capabilities into their own features safely and independently.

### **What you need to be successful:**


#### **Background:**


* 5\+ years of Product Management experience in a technology\-driven environment, with a proven track record of owning and shipping production\-grade AI/ML capabilities.
* **Real\-World GenAI \& Agentic Systems Production Experience:** Hands\-on experience taking GenAI products from concept to live production. You must have direct experience building with concepts like Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic workflows (ReAct framework, state/memory management, function\-calling), and multi\-agent orchestration systems. (Note: Utilizing off\-the\-shelf AI productivity tools is not sufficient; we require a track record of building customer\-facing or platform products powered by AI).
* **B2C Domain Scale (Technical Background Preferred):** Experience working within high\-volume, highly scalable technical domains (such as B2C FinTech, E\-Commerce, or high\-traffic consumer tech). Note: Pure B2B background with low customer scale does not fit the high\-volume requirements of this role.
* **Full AI/ML Specialization:** Comprehensive expertise navigating the full AI product lifecycle, including problem scoping, target metric definition, data ingestion/labeling, model training/fine\-tuning, evaluation framework design, deployment, latency optimization, and continuous retraining.

#### **Skills:**


* **Traditional ML Foundation \+ GenAI Evolution:** A background grounded in traditional Machine Learning methodologies (classification, regression, ranking/recommendation engines) paired with hands\-on expertise in modern LLM architecture.
* **Deep Technical Literacy \& Architecture Evaluation:** Strong grasp of AI technical fundamentals, with the ability to evaluate trade\-offs between Large Language Models (LLMs) and deterministic ML/rule\-based logic across cost, inference latency, explainability, and accuracy.
* **Data\-Driven \& Model Evaluation Mindset:** Proficiency in defining, tracking, and translating offline model evaluation metrics (precision, recall, F1, confidence thresholds, hallucination rates) into tangible business KPIs and operational ROI.
* **Cross\-Functional \& Regulatory Awareness:** Strong collaboration skills within Agile environments, coupled with an understanding of financial services constraints (GDPR, data residency, EU AI Act, risk governance, and security controls).

#### **Traits:**


* **Pragmatic Action Bias:** A focus on high\-velocity execution and value creation, knowing how to balance model perfection with pragmatic, incremental shipping in a fast\-paced environment.
* **Production Reliability:** Uncompromising standards for system resiliency, ensuring all AI\-driven platform features are robust enough for a global banking infrastructure.
* **Technical Collaboration:** Comfortable speaking the same technical language as Principal Data Scientists and Platform Engineers while translating complex model behavior into clear updates for non\-technical leadership.

### **What's in it for you:**


* Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe's most talked about disruptors.
* Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness \& wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
* As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
* Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
* A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies \- all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and backgrounds.
* A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

### **Who we are**



N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.



We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.



We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500\-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.


**Sounds good? Apply now for this position.**


### **Equal Opportunities:**



We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.



We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26\.com.



Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, \& Inclusion at N26\.

title: Course Content Manager
description:
**Application deadline: 24 September 2026 at 17:00 (Barcelona time)**  

  

**Who are we?**  

  

EIT Urban Mobility is an initiative of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), a body of the European Union and Europe's largest network for transport innovation in cities.

  

Our mission is to accelerate change towards a sustainable model of urban mobility and liveable urban spaces. We connect public and private actors and provide them with access to markets, talent, finance and knowledge.

  

Using cities as living labs, our industry, research and university partners will demonstrate how new technologies can work to solve real problems in real cities by transporting people, goods and waste in smarter ways.

 **About EIT Urban Mobility Academy:**

  

Our EIT Urban Mobility Academy is a collaborative arena for lifelong learning, helping to build critical capabilities for innovation and transformation. We are training the next generation of urban mobility practitioners, needed by the urban mobility ecosystem of the future. The webpage of EIT Urban Mobility Academy is:  

https://www.eiturbanmobility.eu/academy/

  

Within the Academy, Urban Mobility Explained (UMX) offers a variety of training programmes and experiences on hot topics in urban mobility and transport for professionals and organisations around Europe. In close collaboration with universities, business schools, consultancies and mobility experts, this lifelong learning initiative uses different formats including light online material in a YouTube channel, online courses (asynchronous), and face\-to\-face (F2F) courses (on\-site, online synchronous and blended). More information on UMX: https://urbanmobilityexplained.eu/

 **Be part of a team where:**  

  

The **Course Content Manager** will play a pivotal role in shaping the present and future of UMX. Reporting to the Head of Professional Education, you will support the UMX team in maintaining operational excellence, ensuring full compliance, and successfully delivering UMX courses in compliance with EIT Urban Mobility and EIT requirements.

  

You will help shape the future development of the UMX portfolio by identifying emerging topics, sourcing expertise, converting knowledge into high\-impact learning experiences, and ensuring our content remains aligned with the evolving needs of cities, public authorities, mobility operators and industry stakeholders across Europe.

  

You will support EIT Urban Mobility's long\-term strategy by developing high\-impact courses that generate independent value and revenue within our five Priority Domains: (1\) shared and public transport (2\) urban logistics, (3\) mobility AI and data management, (4\) electrification and alternative fuels, and (5\) health and mobility.

  

As part of this role, you will support the development of EIT Urban Mobility's Autonomous Mobility Academy initiative. Working alongside internal and external subject\-matter experts, you will contribute to programme design, ecosystem building, expert sourcing, content governance, funding opportunities and project development activities.  

  

**Key responsibilities:**

  

* Strategic Content Development \& KPI Compliance: Support the delivery and continuous improvement of UMX courses, ensuring they meet revenue, KPI and compliance requirements. Identify emerging mobility trends and strategic topics, and transform research, project outputs and thought leadership into new learning products, use cases and educational assets. Support the definition of content priorities and future portfolio growth opportunities.
* Expert Sourcing, Network Building \& Knowledge Management: Build and maintain a high\-quality network of urban mobility and transport experts across Europe and beyond. Develop and manage a centralised expert database, identify and engage contributors for learning activities, and establish processes that ensure the quality, relevance and transferability of expertise across the organisation.
* Autonomous Vehicles Academy Development \& Project Management: Act as the primary operational lead supporting the development of EIT Urban Mobility's Autonomous Mobility Academy Initiative. Coordinate stakeholders, partnerships and project development activities, while supporting funding opportunities, ecosystem engagement and programme planning. Work closely with internal and external experts to ensure activities remain aligned with organisational priorities and market needs.
* Content Governance, Review \& Quality Assurance: Act as content owner for a portfolio of UMX learning activities. Review and challenge content to ensure it is accurate, practical and relevant for target audiences, while working closely with subject\-matter experts and internal teams to maintain high quality standards and continuously improve the learner experience.
* Knowledge Intelligence \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Monitor developments across the mobility ecosystem and identify reports, studies, project outputs and market insights that can be transformed into learning assets and new course opportunities. Collaborate with marketing, business development, learning and other EIT Urban Mobility teams, while contributing to wider organisational initiatives, events and thought leadership activities.

  

  

**What you will bring along the way:**  

  

**Must\-haves**

  

* 7\+ years of professional experience in urban mobility, transport innovation, mobility technology, innovation ecosystems or closely related sectors, including experience working with experts, knowledge products, training programmes or thought leadership initiatives.
* 3\+ years working experience(s) in managing/producing education or learning activities and trainings, preferably in a blended format (partly online, partly on\-site), ideally for a professional or lifelong learning audience.
* Strong interest in mobility innovation, emerging technologies, transport digitalisation and the future of urban mobility.
* Proven ability to identify, assess and engage subject\-matter experts and build professional networks across complex stakeholder ecosystems.
* Ability to translate research findings, project outputs and technical knowledge into practical learning materials and educational products.
* Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to assess content quality, challenge assumptions and work effectively with senior experts.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills in English (C1 level or above), both written and spoken.
* Committed, proactive, trustworthy, accurate, and respectful of timelines and deadlines.
* A positive 'can\-do' and hands\-on mindset, curious and fast digital learner capable of adapting to digital tools like Netsuite and WordPress.

  


**Nice\-to\-haves**

  

* Experience working in or with an EU institution or EU\-funded programme or organisation.
* Experience working in or with public/private partnerships.
* Demonstrable experience, project involvement and/or an active professional network in autonomous mobility.
* Any additional EU language is a plus.

  

  

**What's in it for you:**

  

* Work in an international environment with a company culture focused on empowerment, thriving and continuous growth.
* Join a creative and diverse team of highly driven individuals that take out\-of\-the\-box thinking to another level.
* Strike the right work\-life balance: on top of the flexible hours and remote working options and facilities, you will be granted 27 days of paid time\-off to rest and re\-energize.

title: Director Of Revenue Operations
description:
**Director Of Revenue Operations \| Based in Barcelona**  

  

Kantox is a Barcelona\-based fintech acquired by BNP Paribas in 2022\. As Director of Revenue Operations, you will sit at the intersection of internal commercial execution and parent company alignment, reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer.


This is not a coordination role. You will own the RevOps function, lead the relationship with BNP Paribas commercial leadership, and drive the commercial initiatives that determine how Kantox scales.

**What you will work on**


Strategic Leadership

* Working hand in hand with the Chief Commercial Officer
* Building strategic reviews and recommendations for key meetings including Strategic Reviews with BNP, Kantox Board meetings, and Quarterly Commercial meetings
* Ensuring all decisions made in the Commercial leadership team are executed seamlessly, in collaboration with Sales Team Managers
* Orchestrating the work of all teams represented in the commercial organisation: Business Development, Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, and Marketing
* Managing partnerships with third parties: animating those partnerships to extract the best of them, defining and executing processes to work efficiently with partners, and leading the training of the commercial team around those partnerships


People Leadership

* Leading the Revenue Operations team (current organisation: 1 Sales Operations Specialist, 1 Implementation and Customer Specialist, 1 Marketing Specialist, 2 Quality Assurance Specialists, and 2 Salesforce Developers)
* Building and developing your Revenue Operations team: establishing clear career pathways, identifying skill gaps, and driving upskilling in areas like CRM, analytics, and process design
* Fostering career development and internal mobility: identifying high\-potential team members, creating stretch assignments and mentoring opportunities, and supporting movement across the commercial function
* Driving team engagement and culture: celebrating wins and ensuring your team understands how their work connects to commercial and organisational strategy


BNP Paribas Commercial Relations

* Representing the commercial organisation in recurrent BNPP stakeholder meetings: preparing agendas, presenting KPIs, deal status, and pipeline intelligence
* Coordinating efforts across local markets with Kantox and BNP local sales to ensure execution of the priorities defined in regular Kantox/BNPP meetings
* Managing BNP compliance and risk requests related to the commercial organisation including process improvement and executing internal audit recommendations


AI and Productivity

* Recommending new workflows for Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, and Revenue Operations leveraging AI
* Making the best of our tech stack using the AI capabilities of our providers
* Increasing sales closing ratio by enhancing the sales cycle with AI


Key Commercial Meetings

* Owning the organisation and content of key internal commercial meetings: sales kickoffs, quarterly commercial committee, and weekly Sales meetings
* Acting as a speaker at those events to give a clear vision of the commercial organisation's direction


Budget, Targets, and Compensation

* Participating in budget preparation with Finance and Senior Sales Management
* Designing commission plans with the CCO and following their proper execution
* Leveraging and administering SPIFF programs


Revenue Operations

* Being fully responsible for the reliability of all reporting for Senior Management, mainly Power BI and Salesforce dashboards, with the support of our Power BI specialists
* Overseeing the full RevOps tech stack including CRM, sales tools, and analytics, alongside team development and process optimisation
* Designing and driving revenue operations initiatives across sales process improvement, continuous training, forecasting accuracy, pricing strategies, and operational efficiency
* Ensuring the forecasting process is followed diligently across the commercial organisation, with clear accountability at every stage of the pipeline
* Driving continuous improvement across all key sales velocity metrics: pipeline size, average deal size, closing ratio, and sales cycle length
* Aligning Sales, Customer Success, and Implementation to ensure seamless handoffs, successful client onboarding, and consistent commercial execution
* Making data\-driven recommendations to evolve the sales cycle based on the evolution of the product, market, and competitive landscape

**The setup**


You will be based in our Barcelona office, working in a hybrid model and reporting directly to the CCO. You will lead a high\-performing Revenue Operations team and work closely with senior stakeholders both inside Kantox and within BNP Paribas. This is a role with real strategic weight and direct influence on how Kantox grows.

 **Who you are**


You have deep experience in revenue operations or commercial planning, and you know how to manage complex stakeholder relationships at C\-Level. You are equally comfortable presenting forecasts to senior leadership and getting into the detail of a CRM process improvement. You lead teams with clarity, build cross\-functional alignment, and operate effectively inside structured governance environments.


Concretely:

* 7\+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or commercial planning, preferably in SaaS
* Outstanding reliability: anything going through you will be properly executed by your team
* Proven experience managing strategic relationships with C\-Level stakeholders
* Strong financial acumen across budget planning, forecasting, revenue recognition, and KPI analysis
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable engaging senior executives and speaking in public forums
* Proven hands\-on experience with Salesforce
* Experience leading teams and driving cross\-functional initiatives in a scaling organisation
* Highly organised with strong attention to detail and comfort with complex governance structures
* Fluent in English

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in fintech, banking, or financial services
* Familiarity with large financial institutions such as banking groups or asset managers
* Background in FX, treasury, or trade finance operations

**What we offer**

* Competitive base salary and bonus
* Sponsored learning and development budget
* Free private health insurance
* Free language lessons (Spanish, English and French)
* Relocation package if required
* Flexible working hours and short Fridays
* Hybrid working model (4 office, 1 home)
* 36 days of annual leave
* Gym discounts and free sports activities
* Restaurant Ticket with monthly credit and regular cross\-team lunches
* Fresh fruit and unlimited coffee
* Pizza Fridays
* Barcelona office with 360° views of the city

**About Kantox**


We are a 200\-person fintech and a BNP Paribas company, with offices in London and Barcelona. We built a product that handles real financial complexity for clients who depend on it every day. As we deepen our integration with BNP Paribas and scale our commercial operations globally, this role sits at the centre of that ambition.

**Kantox is an equal opportunity employer.** We hire on merit and welcome applicants regardless of background, nationality, gender, age, sexual orientation, or disability status.

description:
**SENIOR AFFILIATE MANAGER — EUROPE, MENA \& ASIA**  

**DFO Performance**  

**Remote — Europe / MENA / Asia**  

International travel required

 **BEFORE YOU APPLY**  

This is a **senior revenue\-producing affiliate role.**

  

We are not hiring someone who wants to become a senior Affiliate Manager. We are hiring someone who already is one.

 **You must be able to answer YES to every question below. If you cannot, do not apply.**

  

1\. Have you personally managed an affiliate portfolio generating **$1M\+ USD in revenue in a single month**?



2\. Have you personally recruited or developed at least **3 affiliates that each reached $100K\+ USD in monthly revenue**?



3\. Do you personally know at least **10 serious affiliates, publishers, media buyers or networks across Europe, MENA or Asia** that you could contact about a new offer during your first 30 days?



4\. Have you personally owned decisions involving **payouts, caps, EPC, CPA, CVR, profitability, traffic quality and scaling**?



5\. Have you personally owned a monthly affiliate **revenue and profit targe**t and been accountable for beating or missing it?

 **If the answer is not YES to all five, do not apply.**

 **THE OPPORTUNITY**  

DFO Performance is a global performance marketing company built around one thing: **profitable scale.**

  

Your job is simple:



Find serious affiliates. Get them live. Make them successful. Scale the winners. Own the revenue and profit.


**This is not an account\-management or coordination role. It is a commercial performance role.**

 **WHAT YOU WILL OWN**


**Affiliate Recruitment**  

Recruit high\-volume affiliates, publishers, media buyers, networks and performance partners across Europe, MENA and Asia.



You should arrive with relationships. Cold outreach is still part of the job, but we are not hiring someone to build their first network.

 **Revenue**



You will be accountable for:


* Monthly affiliate revenue
* Incremental new revenue
* Revenue from affiliates you personally recruit
* Revenue growth from existing affiliates
* Revenue by GEO and offer

  

  

**Profit**  

Revenue without profit does not count.



You must understand and actively manage:


* Gross profit
* Contribution margin
* CPA
* EPC
* CVR
* AOV
* Approval rates
* Refunds
* Chargebacks
* Payout economics
* Traffic quality

  



If an affiliate asks for a higher payout, you should know whether DFO should say yes or no and why.

 **Scale**  

You should be capable of building toward:


* **10\+ meaningful active producing affiliates**
* Multiple affiliates exceeding **$100K/month**
* **$500K\-$1M\+ per month in incremental affiliate revenue**
* Ultimately owning a **multi\-million\-dollar monthly affiliate portfolio**

  


**Speed**  

Strong opportunities should move quickly:


**Conversation**  **Agreement**  **Tracking**  **Live Traffic**  **Scale**

  

Traffic Quality  

You will identify and act on:


* Fraud
* Fake orders
* Incentivized traffic
* Unauthorized brand bidding
* Coupon abuse
* Self\-referrals
* Poor customer quality
* Misleading advertising
* Compliance problems
* Abnormal refunds
* Abnormal chargebacks

  



You must be willing to shut off revenue when the traffic is wrong.

 **Commercial Intelligence**  

You should know:


* What competitors are paying
* Which offers affiliates want
* Why an affiliate increased volume
* Why an affiliate stopped
* Where conversion is breaking
* Which creatives are working
* Which GEOs are emerging
* What payout or funnel changes would unlock additional profitable volume

  

  

You will work directly with DFO’s sales, media, creative, CRO, analytics, technology, finance, compliance and operations teams.

 **YOUR SCORECARD**  

You will be measured on:

 **Recruitment**

  

* New qualified affiliates
* New affiliates launched
* New producing affiliates

  


**Revenue**

  

* Monthly affiliate revenue
* New affiliate revenue
* Revenue growth
* Revenue per affiliate

  


**Scale**

  

* Affiliates exceeding $50K/month
* Affiliates exceeding $100K/month
* Top\-partner growth
* Successful cap and payout increases

  

  

**Profitability**

  

* Gross profit
* Contribution margin
* CPA efficiency
* Refund\-adjusted revenue
* Chargeback\-adjusted revenue

  

  

**Execution**

  

* Time to launch
* Time to first conversion
* Time to meaningful scale
* Forecast accuracy
* Speed resolving partner issues

  

  

**Quality**

  

* Refund rate
* Chargeback rate
* Fraud rate
* Traffic\-quality incidents
* Compliance incidents

  


**COMPENSATION**  

We want a serious person, so we will pay like we want a serious person.



The package should include:


* **Top\-of\-market base compensation**
* **Meaningful commission or performance bonus tied to profitable affiliate revenue**
* Accelerators for exceeding revenue and profit targets
* Additional bonuses for major new affiliate relationships
* Additional incentives for exceptional annual performance
* International travel to major affiliate and performance\-marketing events

  

  

**Exceptional performance should not be artificially capped.** If someone builds a major profitable affiliate business for DFO, their compensation should reflect it.

 **WHO WE WANT**  

**Likely backgrounds:**


* Senior Affiliate Manager
* Head of Affiliates
* Affiliate Director
* Senior Partnerships Manager

**Requirements:**

**DO NOT APPLY IF**  

Do not apply if your background is primarily:


* Influencer marketing
* Brand partnerships

Also do not apply if you cannot quantify:


* Largest affiliate portfolio personally managed

**HOW TO APPLY**

title: Senior Concept Artist
description:
**Company Description** **Join The Game!**


Leader in the development and publishing of games, Gameloft® has established itself as a pioneer in the industry, creating innovative gaming experiences for over 20 years. Gameloft creates games for all digital platforms, from mobile to cross\-platform titles for PC and consoles. Gameloft operates its own established franchises such as Asphalt®, Dragon Mania Legends, Modern Combat and Dungeon Hunter and also partners with major rights holders including LEGO®, Universal, Illumination Entertainment, Hasbro®, Fox Digital Entertainment, Mattel®, Lamborghini®, and Ferrari®. Gameloft distributes its games in over 100 countries and employs 3,000 people worldwide. Every month, 55 million unique users can be reached by advertisers in Gameloft games with Gameloft for brands, a leading B2B offering dedicated to brands and agencies. Gameloft is a Vivendi company.

 **Job Description** **WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON**

**Main** **challenge**


We are looking for a Concept Artist to support the pre\-production and visual development of our core game titles, creating concepts and artistic references that help align production teams around a clear visual direction. The role focuses on projects inspired by the visual standards of Disney Speedstorm and Asphalt Legends.

**What it means** **on a daily basis**

* **Visual Concept Generation:** Create character designs and illustrations, including line art and 3D blockouts, in line with project requirements and the distinct visual styles of Hyperdrive, Asphalt, and Disney.
* **Creative Ideation:** Generate and develop artistic ideas while maintaining each game's unique visual identity.
* **Collaborative Design:** Collaborate with fellow artists and designers to develop and enhance the game's visual style.
* **Feedback Integration:** Work under the Studio Art Director's guidance, iterate on designs based on feedback, and deliver work in line with project goals and timelines.
* **Art Asset Planning:** Plan the creation of art assets for characters, environments, and props, and clearly communicate the approach and requirements to the relevant team members.

**What** **success will look like**


After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the projects visual directions and production workflows. After 6 months, you will independently deliver concepts and references that support production decisions. You will also contribute consistently to the evolution of the games' visual identity and support effective collaboration across art and design teams.

**Who you would be working with**


You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with concept artists, artists, designers, and production teams. Your concepts and visual references will support local and international collaborators throughout the production process.

**Your recruitment** **journey**

* HR Screen Call: An initial conversation with our HR team.
* First Interview: A 20\-minute interview with the Hiring Manager to discuss your previous projects and experience.
* Test: You will have one week to complete a practical test.
* Second Interview: A discussion with the Hiring Manager to review your test, explore your approach in more detail, and share feedback.
* Final Interview: A meeting with the Studio Manager to discuss alignment and answer any remaining questions.

**Where this role can take you**


This role can offer opportunities to deepen your expertise in concept art, explore broader artistic responsibilities, and access development opportunities, mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility depending on business and individual opportunities

 **Qualifications** **WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Demonstrated advanced expertise in concept art or a related discipline, supported by a strong portfolio
* Advanced proficiency in Photoshop for digital art creation and proficiency with Blender or similar 3D software for concept development.
* Solid ability to produce clear and efficient sketches and develop concepts for characters, environments, and props.
* Ability to manage assigned work independently while collaborating closely with artists, designers, and production teams
* Fluent professional English, written and spoken, for collaboration in an international environment.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* You are comfortable developing ideas and adapting them based on feedback.
* You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different team members.
* You can manage your work independently while contributing to a collaborative creative process.

 **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU**

* Permanent contract, full\-time job with excellent Social Benefits.
* 25 vacation days per year
* Private medical health insurance
* Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card

**Benefits**

* Flexible work from home hybrid model
* Free language courses
* Birthday day off!
* 1 month of remote work
* Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
* Career\-development opportunities.
* Excellent local working conditions (quality of offices, geographical location of office in the centre of Barcelona).
* ... and Thursday afterwork beers!

 **Apply now !**
