title: Head of Research & Editorial
description:
**About Platform Engineering**
------------------------------


Platform Engineering (platformengineering.org) is home to the world's largest community of platform engineers. Through **PlatformCon**, one of the world's largest conferences dedicated to platform engineering, we bring together more than 50,000 engineers, technology leaders, and decision\-makers every year to share ideas, showcase innovation, and shape the future of internal developer platforms.


Alongside our events, we run a university, a newsletter read by hundreds of thousands of engineers, a growing YouTube channel, and **Weave Intelligence**, our research arm: the analyst practice behind the State of Platform Engineering report, market guides on the platform engineering reference architecture, and a growing set of data products on how the agentic enterprise is actually being built.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for a **Head of Research \& Editorial** to lead Weave Intelligence and own what we say about the industry.


This is the role that owns Platform Engineering's intellectual agenda. Everything we publish across every channel starts with a thesis about where platform engineering, internal developer platforms and agentic software development are going. Today that thesis lives in the heads of our founders. You will make it a practice: a research agenda, an editorial calendar, a standard for what counts as evidence, and a team that turns it into reports, guides, articles, courses and video that the market reads first.


You'll be a named analyst, not a manager of analysts. You will publish under your own byline, take briefings from vendors, sit on our analyst desk at PlatformCon and at KubeCon, re:Invent and Google Cloud Next, and represent Weave in the press. We want you to become one of the voices the industry associates with platform engineering.


You'll also lead the content team that already exists and works: a content operations lead who runs the engine and manages our designers, a narratives and quality lead who holds the bar on every piece, and a video producer who is building our channel. The production engine already exists. Your job is to decide where it points, raise the intellectual and editorial bar, and spend meaningful time doing the research and writing yourself

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the house thesis on platform engineering, PE\+\+ and the agentic enterprise, and keep it ahead of the market.
* Run a quarterly theme calendar that every report, article, webinar, course and video hangs off, and make sure content, events and sales are telling the same story.
* Set the split between net\-new thought leadership backed by our own data and rapid\-response analysis of what the market is discussing, and decide which topics deserve which.
* Lead the Weave Intelligence analyst practice: research agenda, methodology standards, editorial ownership of the State of Platform Engineering and State of AI \& Platform Engineering reports, market guides, and the vendor briefings program.
* Apply and defend our firewall: sponsors buy distribution and association, never conclusions; methodology is published before results; sponsored and syndicated work is always labeled.
* Publish regularly under your own name, and take the analyst chair at our events and at the industry majors we attend.
* Take vendor and enterprise briefings, and turn them into a structured view of the vendor landscape that feeds our reference architecture and our research.
* Lead and develop the content team: a content PM, a narratives and QA lead, a video producer, and through them our brand designers.
* Build relationships with other media houses, analyst firms and independent voices for co\-published research, syndication and joint formats.
* Work with our founders on their public positioning, so that the strongest ideas in the company reach the stage and the page.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 6\+ years in roles where your job was to understand a technology market and say something about it that held up: industry analyst, editor or lead writer at a technical publication, content or product marketing lead who shaped a category, or developer advocacy lead with a strategic remit.
* Real depth in platform engineering, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure or the adoption of AI in software development. You can hold your own with a staff engineer and a CTO in the same conversation.
* A body of published work under your own name, and a view on where the industry is going that you can defend with evidence.
* Narrative judgment: you know the difference between a topic and a thesis, and between something that is true and something that is worth saying now.
* Editorial rigor. You have run methodology, sourcing and fact\-checking on work where being wrong had consequences.
* Experience leading a small team of writers, researchers or producers, and making them better rather than louder.
* Comfort in public: on stage, on camera, in a briefing room with a vendor's leadership team.
* Operating discipline: calendars, standards and a cadence that ships.
* Exceptional written and spoken English
* Willingness to travel a few times per year for events and offsites.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience inside an analyst firm, or on the receiving end of one as a vendor.
* A track record of building something recognized as a source: a report people cite, a newsletter people forward, a format people copy.
* Familiarity with survey design and quantitative research methods.
* Existing relationships across the cloud native and developer tooling ecosystem.
* Hands\-on engineering or platform background earlier in your career.
* A practical view on where AI helps and hurts research and editorial work.
* Experience working in a startup or scale\-up, and with remote, globally distributed teams.

**Why join us?**
----------------


Most analyst jobs ask you to describe a market someone else built. This one asks you to shape one. Platform engineering is a discipline that our community defined, and the agentic enterprise is being defined right now. You'd be doing that work with direct access to the people building the world's most interesting internal developer platforms, a community of hundreds of thousands who already trust us, and a team that can turn an idea into a report, a course, a stage talk and a video in weeks.


There is no legacy research franchise to protect and no house style to inherit. If you want a role where your judgment about what matters becomes what the industry reads, this is that role.

title: Head of Revenue Operations & Systems
description:
**About Platform Engineering**
------------------------------


Platform Engineering (platformengineering.org) is home to the world's largest community of platform engineers. Through PlatformCon, one of the world's largest conferences dedicated to platform engineering, we bring together more than 50,000 engineers, technology leaders, and decision\-makers every year. Alongside our events, we run a university, a newsletter read by hundreds of thousands of engineers, a growing YouTube channel, and Weave Intelligence, our research arm.

**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a Head of Revenue Operations \& Systems to own operations end to end: our growth\-ops and CRM data layer, the tool stack, event \& ticketing infrastructure, and performance\-marketing data, the systems and processes that let the rest of the company scale. Today, growth ops and internal tooling run on a mix of point\-to\-point integrations and manual fixes that have carried us this far but won't carry us through the next stage. We are already improving parts of this, you will be picking up that momentum and driving it the rest of the way, not starting from a blank slate.


This is a management role from day one. Two people already work in ops, one on revenue ops and one on tooling and custom software, and they will report to you from the start. You will be hands\-on yourself too: building pipelines and workflows directly, not just directing others to. You will join the Platform Engineering Masters leadership team, reporting to Luca, Managing Director of Platform Engineering Masters, alongside peers like the head of revenue and the head of growth.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Replace the current patchwork of Zapier point\-to\-point integrations with a proper operational data layer, so that fixing one connection doesn't mean detective work across a dozen fragile Zaps.
* Own enrichment, deduplication, and lead scoring in our CRM (HubSpot), currently unowned and blocking the marketing team from running effective campaigns.
* Give non\-technical team members self\-service access to their own data and segments, instead of routing every query through engineering.
* Connect ad spend to actual outcomes: get click and conversion data from our ad managers (LinkedIn, Google, Meta) flowing into HubSpot so campaign performance can be measured and fed back into targeting.
* Own our tool stack: build and maintain a registry of every tool in use (technical owner, business owner), lead the retirement of Airtable, and run tool\-selection decisions as a cross\-functional process, not a unilateral ops call.
* Stabilize ticketing and webinar operations ahead of high\-volume periods, our two biggest scale risks right now.
* Manage and grow the ops team: one person on revenue ops and one on tooling and custom software report to you from day one, and you will assess where further hiring is needed.
* Run operations reporting to a predictable calendar, feeding into the company's quarterly budgeting process.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Hands\-on engineering skills: you design and build data pipelines and workflows yourself, in SQL and code, not just through no\-code tools or by directing someone else to.
* Experience building performance marketing / ad\-tech systems: conversion tracking, click\-ID matching (LinkedIn, Google, Meta), attribution pipelines, and getting that data to actually land in a CRM correctly.
* Experience with CRM systems (HubSpot or equivalent) at a technical level: custom objects, workflows, API integrations, not just day\-to\-day admin use.
* Solid data modeling and architecture skills: comfortable designing a schema in Postgres/Supabase and deciding what belongs in a warehouse versus in the CRM itself.
* A track record of making tooling decisions that account for the whole team's needs, not just what's easiest to build.
* People management experience. You will be managing two people from your first week.
* Comfortable picking up a system that's already partway improved and driving it forward, rather than needing a blank slate to start from.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with no\-code/low\-code automation tools (n8n, Zapier), and knowing when to replace them with something more robust.

description:

* Manage and optimize custom data products for clients.
* Enhance our data stack and tools for scalability, reliability, and performance.

We are seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer — Data Modeling \& Visualization to strengthen the Data Team’s semantic modeling, metrics, and dashboarding capabilities.


With access to vast data — thousands of catalogs, millions of products, and billions of entries scraped from e\-commerce websites — you’ll help transform complex data into reliable models, clear metrics, and useful dashboards for internal and customer\-facing data products.


This role owns the Data Team’s semantic and visualization layer: business\-facing data models, metric definitions, dashboards, validation rules, and documentation. You will work closely with the Product Manager, who owns Product\-side framing, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and business acceptance. Your role is to translate Product and business needs into reliable models, clear KPIs, useful dashboards, and maintainable data products.


This is a senior technical role at the intersection of analytics engineering, data modeling, and data visualization. It is not a Product Manager role or a pure Data Engineering role. It is also not focused on ad hoc reporting: requests should be turned into reusable, maintainable data assets whenever they create recurring value.


Your key responsibilities:

* Own the semantic and visualization layer of Lengow’s internal and customer\-facing data products.
* Define and document KPIs, dimensions, facts, grains, filters, assumptions, and business rules.
* Design reusable analytical models and semantic layers across dashboards and data products.
* Build and improve dashboards in Looker Studio that are clear, useful, performant, and decision\-oriented.
* Transform Product and business requirements into modeled datasets, dashboard specifications, validation rules, and documentation.
* Write advanced SQL transformations and contribute to dbt workflows.
* Collaborate with Senior Data Engineers on upstream data quality, data contracts, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Challenge unclear metric definitions, incomplete acceptance criteria, misleading visualizations, and one\-off requests that should become reusable data products.
* Communicate assumptions, limitations, edge cases, feasibility, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


Recruitment Process* Pre\-interview: Chat with Alexandre, Head of People (30').
* Team interview: Meet Sebastien (VP Data) and team members (60').
* Final interview: Present a technical case to Sebastien and Olivier (Chief Product and Technology Officer) (60').

  

**Requirements**  

We’re looking for a senior data professional who combines technical rigor, strong data modeling skills, visualization expertise, and business understanding.


You should be able to understand a business question, challenge vague definitions, design the right analytical model, and deliver a dashboard or data product that can be trusted over time.


Here’s what you bring to the table:

* Experience: 5\+ years in analytics engineering, data visualization engineering, BI engineering, data engineering, or a similar data role.

Click\&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the world, from a day trip to a week\-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.


**The role**

You’ll lead four Senior Product Managers, each owning their own squad. You’ll help them make better decisions, challenge their plans, connect the dots across squads, and make sure we’re collectively focused on the problems that matter most.


You’ll act as the VP Product’s key counterpart on the core business, with significant autonomy and responsibility for its product direction.


You’ll also work closely with the senior leadership team alongside the VP Product, giving you strong exposure to company\-level decisions and priorities.

* **Strategy \& Execution**  

You turn strategy into clear priorities and align teams when priorities conflict.

You improve how the Product team operates, structuring key processes and cross\-team initiatives without adding unnecessary complexity.
* **Business \& Judgment**  

You understand the business, challenge senior stakeholders, and make sound decisions with imperfect information.
* **Team Development**  

You challenge and coach experienced PMs, helping them grow in scope and impact.

* You are fluent in English.
* You have significant Product experience in a mature product organization.
* You have managed experienced PMs / Senior PMs across multiple squads.
* You’re comfortable working directly with senior leadership on business and product decisions.
* You combine strategic thinking with a hands\-on, business\-oriented approach.


**The hiring journey**

* Interview with the Product team,
* Management interview with a case study to assess your skills and alignment with our values with our VP product and CPTO.

* Lunch vouchers (Cobee);
* Gym partnerships (Wellhub);
* PNB Boat licence offered and exclusive discounts on your next boat trips;
* Breakfast every Tuesday morning;
* A welcoming office in Barcelona, next to the centrally located Cathedral and just a 20\-minute walk from the sea;
* Team\-building activities.

* Personal and professional development opportunities in a fast\-growing company.

If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit the "apply to this job" button.

The Baselga Cancer Research Scholars Program, initiated in 2020, is a 2\-year immersive education and research program for early\-career Oncologists who are inspired by science and by how clinical development has the potential to transform patient care. Our Oncology strategy is built with one goal in mind – pushing the boundaries of science to deliver life\-changing medicines to patients. We have a passion for discovery and a broad pipeline of next\-generation medicines, and together with a focus on execution excellence, we aim to expand treatment options and improve outcomes for patients with solid and haematological cancers. 1\) **Clinical Study Assignment:** You will join a clinical study team and build experience as a medical leader in clinical development which could be in Early Clinical Development, Late Clinical Development, or one year in each. * Establishing and approving scientific methods for design and implementation of applicable clinical protocols, data collection systems, and final reports

* Collaborating with pre\-clinical and translational sciences, and senior management in assessing requirements for emerging products
* Participating in the selection and management activities of CROs

* Planning and managing investigator meetings, advisory boards and other scientific committees

2\) **Rotational program:** During the course of your program, you will be involved in 3\-6 month long rotations across various groups to gain a better understanding of the cross\-functional departments. This could include:


* Patient safety
* Clinical operations
* Regulatory affairs
* Biostatistics
* Medical affairs
* Translational medicine or precision medicine

3\) **Longitudinal Research Project:** You will have opportunity to lead an innovative research project of your choosing for the duration of the 2\-year program, which may be an area of special interest to you and AstraZeneca, or alternatively focus on one or more of the rotational functions. You will be able to harness rich internal datasets and expertise, aiming to deliver a research project at the end of the Program which will be presented to key internal stakeholders, at a key scientific meeting and published in a peer\-reviewed journal.

description:
AL1 busca para empresa Internacional del sector farma en etapa de expansión con alto nivel de crecimiento sostenido, un **Group Financial Reporting \& Compliance Specialist.**

Se unirá al equipo financiero internacional en plena expansión y ocupará un puesto de nueva creación donde dará forma y desarrollará la función de Cumplimiento e Información Financiera del Grupo.

Reportando directamente al Director Financiero (CFO), desempeñará un papel clave en el fortalecimiento de la gobernanza financiera de las operaciones internacionales (4 sedes, incluida España) y colaborará con un equipo financiero de gran experiencia. Durante el primer año, recibirá mentoría estructurada y asumirá progresivamente la responsabilidad de proyectos estratégicos.

Es una excelente oportunidad para un profesional de las finanzas ambicioso que busque impulsar su carrera hacia un puesto directivo o de alto nivel.

**Funciones principales**

Información financiera del Grupo

* Coordinar la preparación de los estados financieros legales (estatutarios) del Grupo y sus filiales.
* Apoyar el proceso anual de consolidación del Grupo y la elaboración de informes trimestrales para el Consejo de Administración.
* Garantizar el cumplimiento puntual de las obligaciones de presentación de información financiera legal en las distintas jurisdicciones.

Cumplimiento fiscal del Grupo

* Coordinar el cumplimiento fiscal periódico del Grupo (impuesto de sociedades, IVA, IRPF, declaraciones informativas).
* Apoyar el proceso de cierre fiscal anual y la documentación de precios de transferencia.
* Aplicar las directrices del BOICAC/ICAC y gestionar la respuesta a inspecciones fiscales.
* Gestionar los beneficios fiscales por I\+D (Art. 35 LIS) y los informes justificativos correspondientes.
* Coordinar la presupuestación, el seguimiento y la justificación de subvenciones para proyectos de I\+D financiados con fondos públicos.
* Actuar como enlace con organismos como CDTI, MICIU, AEAT y auditores externos.
* Apoyar la solicitud de programas de financiación nacionales y europeos (CDTI, Horizon Europe, PERTE, CIEN, NEOTEC).

CAPEX, activos intangibles y partidas del balance

* Gestionar la capitalización de activos fijos y amortizaciones (transición desde el área de Tesorería prevista para 2026\).
* Documentar y preparar la justificación de activos intangibles (especialmente en I\+D).
* Negociar rappels comerciales y revisar las pólizas de seguro de la empresa.

Auditoría externa y control interno

* Coordinar las auditorías anuales con auditores externos en las distintas jurisdicciones.
* Desarrollar y fortalecer los procedimientos de control interno y la matriz de controles (segregación de funciones/SoD, conciliaciones, autorizaciones).

Mejora de procedimientos y políticas

* Revisar los procedimientos en las distintas sedes y proponer mejoras.
* Mantener actualizadas las políticas contables y la documentación de NetSuite.
* Cumplimentar encuestas oficiales (INE, Banco de España) y atender los requisitos normativos.

Se ofrece

* Salario más bonificación.
* Horario flexible.
* Modalidad de trabajo híbrida (6 días al mes).
* 23 días de vacaciones anuales.
* Desarrollo profesional totalmente financiado, incluyendo formación técnica, certificaciones y cursos de idiomas.
* Mentoría directa por parte del CFO durante el primer año.
* Clara proyección de carrera hacia puestos de liderazgo financiero de alto nivel.
* Exposición a operaciones internacionales en diversas jurisdicciones europeas.
* Oportunidad de construir y dar forma a un área financiera de nueva creación.
* Entorno de trabajo colaborativo, internacional e impulsado por la innovación.

**Requisitos**

Formación

* Grado en Contabilidad, Finanzas, Administración de Empresas, Economía o afín.
* Se valorará Máster en Auditoría, Fiscalidad, Finanzas o Cumplimiento Normativo (Compliance).
* Se valorarán certificaciones profesionales como ACCA, ROAC (en curso), CIA o similares.

Experiencia

* 3 a 5 años de experiencia en auditoría externa y/o contabilidad corporativa.
* Experiencia en la preparación de estados financieros legales/estatutarios.
* Experiencia en el apoyo a auditorías externas.
* Conocimiento de la normativa contable y fiscal española.
* Se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia en entornos multinacionales.
* La experiencia en precios de transferencia o subvenciones de I\+D será una ventaja, aunque no es imprescindible; ofrecemos apoyo para el aprendizaje en estas áreas.
* Idiomas: Español fluido / Inglés a nivel profesional (C1 o superior). Se valorará el conocimiento de alemán o italiano, aunque no es obligatorio.
* Este puesto requiere disponibilidad para viajar a nuestras sedes.

Fitch Ratings is currently seeking a Director based out of our London office.
  
  

As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing supplementary credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. About the Team
  
  

Based in London and reporting to the EMEA head of Investor development, this role is part of the Global Investor Development team, in the Fitch Ratings’ Business \& Relationship Management (BRM) organization.
  
Fitch’s Investor Development team aims at positioning Fitch Ratings as the agency of choice with investors in both established and new markets and sectors. Through a wide range of outreach activities and campaigns, it promotes the agency’s research, thought leadership, ratings and capabilities among key market participants and educates on criteria, rating assumptions and case studies.
  
Ultimately the goal of the team is to embed Fitch ratings and support analytics in investor workflows, by driving deeper engagement, providing timely and actionable service levels, offering improved products, and removing barriers to adoption and usage.
  
It also acts as the voice of the investor community within Fitch Ratings, providing critical feedback on rating performance, criteria, analytical interactions and content.
  
The team offers a high\-visibility role with direct interaction with large institutional investors and industry groups and a collaborative team environment with exposure to dynamic, fast\-paced industry trends.
  
  

**How You’ll Make an Impact:**  

**You will be responsible for:**  

Building and maintaining relationships with corporate and project finance investors.
  
Strengthening Fitch’s brand presence and embedding Fitch ratings into investor workflows, helping to shift market perceptions that may favor incumbent rating agencies and supporting broader acceptance of Fitch ratings across asset classes.
  
Developing outreach strategies for buy\-side, sell\-side analysts, investor associations, and industry groups.
  
Managing, deepening, and expanding Fitch’s relationships with fixed income investment professionals across a portfolio of key institutional investors.
  
Organizing meetings with analysts, presenting Fitch’s capabilities, educating investors on criteria and rating assumptions, and demonstrating use cases for ratings.
  
Leading broader outreach and visibility initiatives (conferences, roadshows, webinars, roundtables, focused groups, content distribution, thought leadership publications, surveys) in partnership with BRM, Marketing, and Events teams.
  
Developing partnerships with sell\-side research, investor associations and industry groups leveraging Fitch’s content and thought leadership.
  
Designing and driving a program of virtual and in\-person events and campaigns to increase transparency of credit views and rating assumptions and showcase rating capabilities and broader thought leadership, in collaboration with BRM which drives origination priorities and the Marketing team which executes on events and campaigns.
  
Preparing and delivering external messaging that highlights the factors differentiating Fitch and its published ratings and research from competitors.
  
Identifying and helping to address remaining barriers to Fitch’s adoption in domestic capital markets, including investment guidelines, indices, and market platforms.
  
Serving as the primary point of contact for analytical groups on content ideation, market feedback, and investor data analysis, while proactively recommending topics for research and data products based on investor feedback.
  
Gathering and communicating insights on domestic capital markets, financial regulation, and policy developments that influence the use of CRA content and services.
  
Identifying and promoting business opportunities for Fitch Solutions and Fitch Learning.
  
  

**You May be a Good Fit if:**  

6\-8 years sell\-side or buy\-side experience in international fixed income capital market is required to perform this role successfully
  
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain long\-term relationships
  
Excellent written communication skills and ability to create strategic messaging
  
Highly motivated and self\-driven with organisational and time\-management skills
  
Degree educated or equivalent work experience
  
  

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**  

Existing contacts and relationships with large European investors is beneficial
  
Genuine proficiency in Salesforce and SharePoint is a plus.
  
Strong interpersonal skills is what makes the difference.
  
  

**Why Choose Fitch:**  

**Hybrid Work Environment:** 3 days a week in office required
  
**A Culture of Learning \& Mobility:** Dedicated training, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
  
**Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long\-term goals
  
**Promoting Health \& Wellbeing:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
  
**Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family\-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
  
**Inclusive Work Environment:** A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
  
**Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community
  
  

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day, supporting smarter decision\-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day\-to\-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI\-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.
  
  

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward\-looking credit opinions. description:

Contract type Full time
Job ID R\-259736
  
**Why choose AstraZeneca Spain?**
---------------------------------


AstraZeneca Spain is a rising force in our global business. Boasting vibrant universities and business schools, the Barcelona ecosystem is a place where scientists can thrive. Or join us in Madrid and shape our growth in our BUs (Respiratory, Oncology \& CVRM ), and a range of Corporate functions. Additionally, you can find sales roles throughout the country. **Who do we look for?**

Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca Spain, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. Alongside technical expertise, colleagues have the resilience, energy and collaborative mindset to change lanes, work with different teams and start projects from scratch.


Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting\-edge technology. Whether you join us in Madrid or Barcelona, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.


**Success Profile**
-------------------


Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth\-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.


### **Diverse collaborators**


This is a speak\-up culture that values collaboration. You’ll proactively bring your unique perspectives, experiences and skills to the table and seek the same from others. With our international team composition and the need for fast\-paced collaboration, you’ll always be building new connections with colleagues.


### **Cutting\-edge innovators**


When you join us, you’ll be part of a team that embraces digital technology and data to transform the way we work and the work we do. Every day, you’ll help make history, empowered to ignite your creativity and build something enduring.


### **Resilient trailblazers**


Here, the answers aren’t always available. So, you’ll need to bring a fearless, self\-starter mindset to navigate uncharted territories. You’ll harness your ceaseless energy to discover and make the necessary connections with colleagues to shape the future and achieve maximum impact.


### **Agile movers**


Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground\-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-259736 **Date posted** 09/09/2026
**Location**: Barcelona \- Spain or Cambridge \- UK (3 days in\-office requirement)


**About AstraZeneca and AISI**


At AstraZeneca, technology and science meet to change what is possible for patients. We are building a connected, end\-to\-end Enterprise AI engine — uniting data foundations, AI technology, process reinvention, and business\-facing AI to accelerate results across the whole value chain. Success depends on being exceptional connectors: you will actively leverage existing capabilities, celebrate and promote reuse, export breakthrough ideas across geographies and functions, and obsess over scaling impact rather than building in isolation.


AI Science \& Innovation (AISI) sits at the centre of AstraZeneca's R\&D AI transformation. Our remit is to build, buy, and deliver the AI models and agents that change pipeline outcomes across discovery, translational science, biomarkers, and clinical development.


Within AISI, the Clinical AI teams are building world\-class AI capability to accelerate the design, conduct, and analysis of clinical trials across our BioPharmaceuticals pipelines — spanning both early and late phase programmes. We partner closely with clinical development, regulatory, and biometrics teams to bring better treatments to patients faster, while adhering to the highest evidentiary standards.


**The Opportunity**


Bringing new treatments to patients demands scientific excellence at every stage of development. In the Clinical AI team, we focus on one of the most data\-rich and decision\-intensive parts of that journey: clinical development. Trial design, patient selection, dose optimisation, biomarker strategy, and safety evaluation each represent genuine opportunities where AI and machine learning can add rigour, speed, and precision — not as a replacement for clinical and statistical expertise, but as a powerful complement to it. We hold ourselves to measurable standards of improvement, and we build methods that can be evaluated, reproduced, and trusted in regulatory settings.


You will work across the enterprise to define and deliver on AstraZeneca's most pressing clinical development questions — leading cross\-functional teams spanning the key BioPharmaceuticals disease areas of cardiovascular, renal, metabolic disease, respiratory, immunology and cell\-therapy. You and the team will develop reusable methods and enterprise\-scale approaches that measurably advance the late\-stage drug pipeline. This is a high\-visibility opportunity to shape how AstraZeneca does AI for BioPharmaceuticals clinical development — from methodology standards to external scientific influence.


AI for clinical development is a field in motion. Foundation models, agentic systems, and causal AI are advancing rapidly, and the regulatory and methodological frameworks around them are evolving in parallel. As a Director, Data Scientist, you will define and drive the AI methodology agenda for one or more programmes within Clinical AI, leading by scientific influence and matrix coordination rather than through a formal hierarchy. You will be the scientific authority that study teams, biometrics, and regulatory colleagues turn to — and AstraZeneca's voice externally at the critical moment when the rules of the road for AI in clinical trials are being written.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Define and drive the AI methodology roadmap for assigned Clinical AI programmes, spanning early and late phase clinical development, and aligning AI/ML priorities with clinical and business objectives.
* Lead, by matrix influence and scientific authority, the delivery of the most complex and high\-stakes AI projects — from problem definition and methodology selection through validation, regulatory alignment, and scaled adoption across the enterprise.
* Develop and govern reusable, enterprise\-grade AI methods and evaluation frameworks for clinical trial settings, including innovative trial design support, dose optimisation, biomarker discovery, digital twins, predictive and prognostic modelling, and safety and efficacy signal detection.
* Champion data\-centric AI practices at programme level: govern the acquisition, curation, and quality control of datasets for model training, post\-training, benchmarking, and evaluation across clinical and regulatory settings.
* Partner with Clinical Development, Biometrics, Regulatory, and Study Teams to embed AI strategy and validated solutions into study design and decision\-making at programme level.
* Shape the AI evidence component for regulatory submission packages; act as the scientific and methodological voice in regulatory engagements involving AI/ML methods or innovative trial designs (FDA, EMA, MHRA).
* Evaluate and champion cutting\-edge AI methodologies — including foundation models, agentic AI systems, generative patient models, multimodal learning, Bayesian inference, causal inference, and model calibration and domain adaptation — proposing fit\-for\-purpose approaches with robust evaluation criteria and risk assessment.
* Establish and maintain external collaborations with academic institutions, technology partners, and industry consortia to access novel capabilities and advance the scientific agenda.
* Represent AstraZeneca at scientific conferences, standards bodies, and peer\-reviewed venues; contribute first\- or last\-author publications in leading ML and clinical AI journals.
* Serve as a technical mentor and thought partner for Associate Directors and Senior Data Scientists within the Clinical AI team; promote scientific rigour, reuse, and a culture of learning in public.
* Contribute to the broader AISI AI for Clinical Development strategy, including cross\-functional ways of working, tooling governance, and methodology standards.

**Essential Requirements**


* PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Biomedical Informatics, Computational Biology, or a closely related quantitative discipline — with a strong, hands\-on computational track record.
* 4–8 years of post\-PhD experience in AI and machine learning method development, with demonstrated and sustained impact in clinical, biomedical, or drug development settings (e.g. models delivered, first\-author publications, patents, SaMD filings, open\-source projects).
* Deep experience, knowledge, and understanding of one or more fields of biology, with hands\-on experience working with biological data such as molecular (DNA, RNA, protein), imaging (radiology, microscopy), or clinical text (EHR, clinical notes).
* Deep expertise in modern AI methodologies, including one or more of: foundation model training and fine\-tuning; Bayesian inference; temporal and longitudinal modelling; multimodal integration; model calibration and domain adaptation; data\-centric AI; model interpretability; model post\-training and alignment.
* Exceptional software engineering skills: Python, deep learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch), frontier coding agent frameworks, modern LLM tooling, and cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Demonstrated experience translating AI methods into applications that inform clinical and/or biomedical decisions, including prospective evaluation or contribution to submission\-relevant evidence.
* Track record of driving scientific influence across cross\-functional communities — ML, clinical, biostatistics, regulatory — without relying on formal authority.
* Peer\-reviewed publications in clinical AI, computational drug development, or leading ML venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, Nature Medicine, Lancet Digital Health).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to translate technical findings for clinical, regulatory, and executive audiences.

**Desirable Skills and Experience**


* Direct industry experience in early or late phase BioPharmaceuticals clinical development, including clinical trial design, biomarker discovery, companion diagnostics, dosing, safety, endpoints, or regulatory processes.
* Direct experience contributing to FDA, EMA, PMDA, or MHRA submissions involving AI/ML methods or innovative trial designs.
* Prior regulatory engagement on AI methodology, complex innovative trial design, or AI/ML qualification opinions.
* Experience with MLOps and LLMOps at scale, including CI/CD pipelines and enterprise deployment.
* Open\-source contributions, workshop organisation, or standards\-body participation.
* Knowledge of computing hardware and its impact on model training and inference at scale.
* Experience in a complex global organisation spanning multiple sites and therapy areas.
* Strong proficiency in augmenting — but not supplanting — daily knowledge work with agentic AI tools.
* Proactively up\-to\-date with the latest AI research; tries out new tools and methods of interest without waiting to be directed.
* Team\-oriented mindset: does what is best for the team and the programme, not just the individual deliverable.
* Ability to deliver high\-quality, high\-impact contributions independently and at pace.
* Comfort with ambiguity and an instinct to learn in public, prototype early, and fail forward.
* Deep, up\-to\-date knowledge of the ML literature and active connections with the ML community.

**Why AstraZeneca?**


Here, technology and science meet to change what is possible for patients. You will join a company investing boldly in AI and data to become truly data\-led, where unexpected teams come together to address problems that have never been solved before. When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we ignite bold thinking with the power to inspire life\-changing medicines.


The playbook for AI in clinical development will be written in the next two to three years. You will help write it — with an outsized voice at regulatory agencies, scientific consortia, and external partners during the narrow window when the rules of the road for AI in pivotal evidence are being defined. That is the reason to come.


We hire for learning agility and technical excellence. The strongest candidates here learn fast, are comfortable with ambiguity, prototype early, fail forward, and partner credibly across communities. We balance the expectation of being in the office — on average at least three days per week — while respecting individual flexibility.


**So, What's Next?**


Are you ready to set the AI methodology agenda for BioPharma clinical development at one of the world's leading biopharmaceutical companies? Submit your CV and cover letter and let us explore how your expertise can help AstraZeneca harness AI to deliver life\-changing medicines to the patients who need them most.

Darkroom is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a Manager, Social to lead day\-to\-day creative execution for Darkroom's social programs — both paid social advertising and organic content \- across a portfolio of client accounts. You're comfortable diving into the feed and the ad account alike, giving tactical, platform\-native feedback on statics, hooks, pacing, captions, and edit structure for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram. You're likely a Creative Strategist, Social Strategist, or Video Editor by trade, with hands\-on experience shipping content that performs, not just looks good.


You'll work on our Performance Creative service — our AI\-powered creative engagement for paid and organic social — helping clients increase the diversity and volume of their creative program (upwards of 50\+ new assets per month) while keeping every piece grounded in what's actually driving hooks, watch time, and conversion.


You'll work daily alongside Designers, Editors, and Creative Strategists to keep the social and paid social creative pipeline moving — briefing assets, giving feedback, and translating client goals and platform data into concepts that ship on time and drive results.

***This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).***

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day\-to\-day creative execution for paid social and organic social programs across a portfolio of client accounts
* Brief and direct Designers and Editors on statics, motion, short\-form video, carousels, and Stories, giving clear, actionable feedback on hooks, pacing, and edit structure
* Copywriting: Own creative copy for US\-based clients, flexing in tone of voice according to platform and purpose, threading the needle when clients ask you to “punch up the copy
* Own the testing and content calendar cadence — what ships, in what order, against what hypothesis or content pillar

title: Senior Direct-Response Video Editor, DTC Performance Ads
description:
**About Us**


HarZa is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves over 400,000 customers who trust us with their health, and we are now launching and scaling new portfolio brands. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to over 150 people across 15\+ countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do. Paid media is our growth engine, and creative volume is what makes it scale.

**The Role**


You will be the editing engine of a performance pod: a small team built around a creative strategist, a media buyer, and a copywriter, shipping direct\-response ads for claims\-led health and wellness brands. This is not a brand content role and not an organic social role. Every asset you cut exists to convert on paid traffic, and your work is measured by how it performs, not only by how it looks.


The creative challenge is specific: our products solve problems (chronic pain, mobility, wellbeing) whose results are not visually obvious. Your edits build belief through mechanism explanation, testimonials, UGC structures, advertorials, and VSL\-style long form, always with awareness that we operate in a compliance\-sensitive category. You will produce both short\-form ads (15 to 60 seconds) and long\-form direct\-response formats (2 to 6 minutes), and a large part of your week is iterating winners: new hooks, new openings, cutdowns, and format variations of ads that are already scaling.


This is a high\-volume seat and we say so openly. The target output is at least one long\-form ad of around 5 minutes plus 2 to 3 short\-form videos per working day, which comes to roughly 15 to 20 delivered assets per week including iterations. If that rhythm sounds extreme, this is not the right role. If it sounds like the environment you already work in, we should talk.

**What You Will Own**


Direct\-response editing at volume. Editing short\-form and long\-form paid ads from strategist scripts and briefs, shipping platform\-native formats for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, and sustaining the daily delivery target of one long\-form plus 2 to 3 short\-form videos without sacrificing the craft details that drive performance: hooks, pacing, captions, sound design, and pattern interrupts.


Winner iteration and creative testing. Producing hook variations, cutdowns, re\-orders, and format swaps of winning ads as a first\-class deliverable. Feeding the testing loop the pod runs every week and turning performance feedback into the next round of edits quickly.


Claims\-led storytelling. Building belief for outcomes the viewer cannot see: visualizing mechanisms, structuring testimonial and UGC narratives, editing advertorial and VSL long form that holds attention for minutes, and handling claims with compliance awareness.


Pod collaboration and documentation. Working async\-first inside the pod with your strategist and media buyer, keeping Asana as the single source of truth for briefs, versions, and delivery status, and turning feedback into revised cuts without friction or ego.

 **Requirements**  

Proven experience editing paid direct\-response ads for DTC or ecommerce brands, where your videos ran on real media budgets and you saw the numbers. Fluency in both short\-form ad formats and long\-form DR (VSLs, advertorials, 2\+ minute belief\-building videos). A demonstrated high\-volume rhythm: you have sustained daily ad output in a testing environment, not one polished piece per week. Working knowledge of the metrics that judge your work (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA or ROAS) and a track record of letting data change your edits. Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or other claims\-sensitive verticals is a strong plus. Full professional proficiency with a modern editing stack, reliable remote setup, and the self\-management to thrive in an async\-first, output\-measured company.

 **Benefits**  

A fully remote position at a high\-growth DTC operator launching new brands. Real ownership inside a performance pod where your work directly drives scale. Paid time off, wellness stipend, company\-funded computer allowance after tenure milestone, monthly bonus structure, birthday gift card, and in\-country meetup allowance. A culture that rewards output, speed, and mastery of craft.

**We are looking for a Senior Marketing Artist with professional experience in the video game industry to join our international team working on Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2\.**



We are looking for a strong visual artist who can take real ownership of how Space Engineers is presented across marketing channels. You will turn in\-game content, screenshots, 3D assets, and ideas into high\-quality promotional visuals, while also actively helping define what our marketing materials should look like, how they should be structured, and where the visual quality can be pushed further.



You will work across a wide range of marketing and promotional materials \- from key visuals, store assets and campaign graphics to screenshots, banners, logos, splash screens, social media content, and other 2D artwork.



This is not a purely execution\-focused role. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities independently, challenge existing approaches when needed, propose stronger visual solutions, and help establish and evolve a consistent marketing art direction for Space Engineers.



You should combine a strong artistic eye with speed, versatility, and practical execution \- someone who can explore multiple directions quickly, make sound visual decisions, work with feedback, understand the purpose behind each asset, and consistently deliver polished results.



We expect you to act as a proactive visual partner to the team, not simply wait for briefs \- spotting what is missing, proposing what should be created, and helping raise the overall standard of our marketing presentation.


**While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely within Europe (CET \+/\- 2 hour)**



If you enjoy challenging work, seek autonomy, thrive on impact and responsibility, and want to work in a friendly environment with an inspiring international team, then come and join us!


**Required profile**
--------------------


* **6\+ years of professional experience as a Marketing Artist, 2D Artist, or Graphic Designer in the video game industry, specifically working on PC and/or console games.**
* Basic knowledge of or hands\-on experience with motion graphics and animation tools such as Adobe After Effects or similar software.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating high\-quality video game marketing and promotional artwork
* Experience creating and defining brand identities from the ground up, as well as evolving established visual identities across multiple marketing channels and asset types.
* Proven experience creating assets such as:
* + key visuals and campaign artwork
	+ promotional and store screenshots
	+ banners and social media assets
	+ splash screens
	+ logos and branding elements
	+ promotional compositions based on in\-game or 3D content
* Strong skills in Adobe Photoshop
* Strong skills in Adobe Illustrator
* Excellent understanding of composition, typography, color, lighting and visual hierarchy


**Experience creating assets for Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and other gaming platforms**


* Experience working with 3D assets or game engines to prepare promotional compositions and screenshots
* Knowledge of Blender, Unreal Engine, Unity or similar 3D tools
* Strong photo manipulation, image editing and post\-processing skills
* Ability to take existing in\-game content and transform it into compelling promotional visuals
* Ability to adapt to an established visual identity while also proposing new creative directions
* Ability to receive feedback, make changes quickly and iterate efficiently
* Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to balance quality and delivery speed
* Proactive, self\-driven mindset and ability to work independently
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Shares and upholds our High Standards


DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS, PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WHO MEET THE KEY REQUIREMENTS OF THE ROLE AND ARE SELECTED FOR THE NEXT STAGE WILL BE CONTACTED.


### **Nice to have**


* Experience with motion graphics or video editing
* Familiarity with Figma
* UI/UX or in\-game UI experience
* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation or technically oriented games

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Report to the Executive Producer
* Help define, maintain, and evolve the visual brand identity of Space Engineers across marketing materials, platforms, and campaigns.
* Create high\-quality marketing and promotional artwork for Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2
* Develop compelling visual concepts based on in\-game content, screenshots, 3D assets and existing game art
* Create a wide range of graphical materials, including:
* + key visuals
	+ promotional screenshots and beauty shots
	+ store and platform assets
	+ banners
	+ social media graphics
	+ splash screens
	+ logos and branding elements
	+ campaign visuals
	+ event and presentation materials
	+ other 2D promotional artwork
* Capture, compose and post\-process in\-game imagery to achieve strong promotional quality
* Adapt key visuals into multiple formats, resolutions and platform requirements while maintaining consistency and quality
* Collaborate with artists, marketing, production and other disciplines to understand the purpose and audience of each asset
* Explore multiple visual directions quickly before committing to final polish
* Maintain consistency with the established artistic direction and identity of Space Engineers
* Take technical and production constraints into account when proposing concepts and solutions
* Incorporate feedback efficiently and bring assets to a high\-quality final state
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, templates and production efficiency, particularly for recurring marketing assets

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Strong visual judgment** – understand what makes an image compelling, readable and effective
* **Speed, clarity and ownership** – we expect results, not status updates
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, take feedback well and be willing to discard an idea when a better one emerges
* **Purpose\-driven design** – understand what an asset needs to communicate rather than simply making it look attractive
* **Versatility** – comfortably switch between different types of marketing and 2D tasks
* **Direct communication and execution** – no politics, no hiding behind blockers, no red tape

**What you'll find at Keen Software House:**
--------------------------------------------


**Impact**


* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
* Join an international team tackling hard problems


**How we work:**


* Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
* Low bureaucracy, fast decisions


**Time off \& wellbeing**


* 25 days of annual leave.
* Flexible sick leave.


**Workspace**


* Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague \- quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs
  


**Community**


* Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)


DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS, PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WHO MEET THE KEY REQUIREMENTS OF THE ROLE AND ARE SELECTED FOR THE NEXT STAGE WILL BE CONTACTED.

title: AV Scriptwriter
description:
At Superside, we're looking for an **AV Scriptwriter** who can take a video brief from the initial idea through to a production\-ready script. Projects range from 15\-second social and performance content to five\-minute brand/explainer films, across motion graphics, live action, stock\-led video, and UGC. You'll need to understand how words, visuals, pacing, and sound work together, and be confident writing dialogue, voiceover, and on\-screen copy that reads naturally out loud.



### **What you’ll do**


* Concept and script AV content across formats, from short\-form social cuts to longer branded films.
* Given a brief, develop two or three distinct creative directions, each with a clear sense of how it would work as a video, supported by references and a potential title approach.
* Take a chosen direction through to a strong, production\-ready AV script, including dialogue, voiceover and on\-screen copy.
* Build a hook that works, structure a clear narrative, and shift naturally between different brands, audiences, tones and platforms.
* Collaborate with Superside's creative teams to align scripts with visual direction and brand guidelines, and refine based on feedback.
### **What you’ll bring**


* Proven AV scriptwriting experience, ideally from an agency background, not primarily general copywriting.
* A portfolio of AV concepts and scripts, rather than mainly websites, blogs or general marketing copy.
* Excellent command of English and a strong sense of pacing, tone and structure in scriptwriting.
* Strong collaboration skills and openness to iteration with creative directors, designers and producers.
* Interest in or familiarity with AI tools for creative ideation or drafting is a plus.
**Why Join us?**  

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are. **Remote\-first. Customer\-led.**
Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.**Global team, local impact.**
Join a community of 60\+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.**High performance, low ego.**
Work in a fast\-paced, high\-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.**Impact meets opportunity.**
We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.**Grow fast. Lead well.**
You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry. **About Superside**  

Superside is the leading AI\-powered creative company that quickly and cost\-effectively enhances in\-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension
of in\-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance.
Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60\+ countries and 13 timezones.  

Learn more at superside.com **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  

We’re an equal\-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. description:
Rithum™ is the world's most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e\-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimise operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.



Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimised consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

  


**Overview**

As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you lead the design and execution of scalable technical solutions during late\-stage sales and complex onboarding initiatives. Acting as a trusted technical advisor, you take ownership of high\-impact client projects, mentor team members, and drive process improvements that elevate client success outcomes. In this senior role, you bridge technical discovery with delivery, ensuring long\-term value and satisfaction across strategic accounts.



All team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision\-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, and compliance.

  


**Responsibilities**



Solution Design \& Technical Discovery


* Lead technical discovery and solution design during late\-stage sales engagements for strategic clients
* Develop complex implementation plans and ensure seamless handoffs to delivery and support teams


Implementation \& Client Enablement


* Own the technical implementation and optimization of high\-impact client projects, customizing solutions to meet unique business requirements
* Serve as the primary technical contact for advanced issues related to software, product data feeds, API integrations, and FTP
* Provide expert\-level platform training and consultation to client stakeholders


Collaboration, Mentorship \& Scale


* Partner with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Client Success to ensure client needs are met and technical challenges are addressed
* Mentor and coach junior Client success engineers, supporting knowledge sharing and technical skill development
* Drive cross\-functional initiatives that improve internal processes, workflows, and client engagement practices
* Develop technical enablement resources (e.g., webinars, videos, documentation) to support onboarding and education at scale
* Use AI as a default for recurring deliverables — implementation planning, client documentation, troubleshooting research, and enablement content — and share the prompts and workflows that work with your immediate team


Client Advocacy \& Communication


* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Represent the voice of the client in product feedback loops, collaborating with Product Management on feature evolution
* Take ownership of high\-risk client situations, ensuring proactive intervention and resolution

  


**Qualifications**

Minimum Qualifications


* 3\+ years of experience in a client\-facing technical role within SaaS, with a focus on onboarding or solution engineering for enterprise\-level clients
* Fluent in both written and spoken English
* Deep experience with product data feed formats (XML, TXT, CSV, JSON) and FTP protocols
* Advanced expertise in REST and SOAP API integrations and troubleshooting
* Strong working knowledge of Excel and HTML
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex client projects simultaneously
* Excellent problem\-solving, time management, and prioritization skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills for technical and non\-technical audiences
* Proven ability to document processes and create technical enablement materials
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to evolving priorities
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to improve productivity through research, communication, analysis, documentation, automation, workflow optimization, and decision\-making


Preferred Qualifications


* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
* 5\+ years of experience in a client\-facing technical role within SaaS, with a focus on onboarding or solution engineering for enterprise\-level clients
* Additional language proficiency is a plus
* Experience working with enterprise clients and/or within the e\-commerce industry
* Familiarity with remote\-based training tools
* Project Management experience or certification (e.g., PMP, Agile)
* Demonstrated success in developing online technical training content
* A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work independently and lead initiatives
* Excellent problem\-solving, time management, and prioritization skills

title: Manager - Pricing Strategy (ESI)
description:
**THE POSITION**


Based in Barcelona, Spain, this role will report to the VP Pricing Strategy and work closely alongside the Senior Manager, Pricing Strategy, also based in Barcelona, providing analytical, reporting, and operational support for key pricing initiatives. This is a highly hands\-on role for a pricing professional who enjoys translating complex and imperfect data into actionable business insights.


The Manager of Pricing Strategy will work closely with the Senior Manager, leveraging large datasets to generate actionable insights and support recurring reporting and performance measurement activities through data preparation, analysis, and reporting that enable data\-driven decision making. This role will work cross\-functionally with Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, Product, Marketing, Strategy, and Business Intelligence teams to support the ongoing evolution of ESI pricing strategy.


The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with advanced analytical skills and a passion for transforming complex data into actionable recommendations.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


The Manager of Pricing Strategy will provide analytical, reporting, and project support to the Senior Manager across pricing analytics, performance measurement, and strategic initiatives within ESI, including:


* Build and maintain pricing datasets by integrating information from multiple data sources.
* Perform detailed data validation, cleansing, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities to ensure analytical accuracy.
* Investigate inconsistencies in pricing, customer, product, contract, and sales data and develop solutions to improve data integrity.
* Support the development, maintenance, and enhancement of analytical models to evaluate pricing performance, discounting practices, promotions, customer behavior, and market opportunities.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify pricing trends, opportunities, and business risks.
* Support the development, maintenance, and enhancement of dashboards, recurring reporting and performance metrics, used by leadership to monitor business performance.
* Generate recurring and ad hoc analyses, reports, and insights for senior leadership presentations and business reviews.

title: Senior Product Manager - Life Sciences Meetings Management (Europe/US - Remote)
description:
### **Mission \- Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you**



SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM\-connected, high\-quality experiences across in\-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: the Live HCP Engagement Platform that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn live events into a company's most effective engagement channel.



Pharma companies use event platforms as registration forms while request, approval, budget, HCP registration, transfer of value (ToV), and reporting run in Excel and at agencies. We are building **Onomi 360**, the life\-sciences strategic meetings management (SMM) product, to replace the incumbent event platform in that space. First accounts already run their meeting requests and approvals in Onomi 360; the demand is validated and the trajectory is exciting.



Your focus will be **MeetingsEQ**, the SMM layer of Onomi 360: one front door for every request, approval and budget as configuration, unified HCP identity, per\-attendee ToV allocation, and engagement and spend flowing back into the CRM without re\-keying. The customer's CRM and master data stay where they are; the event platform behind the meetings program is where we play. AI\-assisted development is how we work, and you will have real freedom to use it.



This position is the ideal role for a hands\-on product leader from the life\-sciences meetings, compliance, or HCP\-data world who would rather ship and test than talk about the problem, and who wants to own one product end to end and see the process they once operated replaced with a modern, AI\-first workflow.



As a Senior Product Manager, Onomi 360, you will be reporting to the VP Product. Your time will be spent on:


* \[35%] **Defining the detailed product.** Turn customer workbooks, operating procedures, RFP requirements, and our capability map into roadmap priorities and build\-ready specifications.
* \[30%] **Shipping.** Work daily with design and engineering in the Onomi 360 codebase: thin production slices, prototypes, scope calls, validation in the running product. Daily AI\-based prototyping and customer validation.
* \[25%] **Customers and partners.** Work with meetings operations, compliance, medical affairs, finance, agencies, and the customer's data team. Define how Onomi 360 works with Veeva, Salesforce, Snowflake, and consent, and own the venue\-sourcing and fair\-market\-value partner integrations.
* \[10%] **Product truth.** Keep what we claim, what we demo, and what we ship documented, clear and moving in the right direction.

### **Objectives \- The problems you will solve**


**In your first month, you will:**


* Take over the first customer's move from their meeting request form to Onomi 360: spec, build, history migration, customer session.
* Get set up with AI\-based toolkit and the Onomi 360 codebase, and use both in your daily work.
* Meet the early access customers (design partners) for Onomi 360\.


**After 3 months, you will have:**


* The first customer live on meeting request and approvals in Onomi 360, measured against their baseline.
* The roadmap priorities for the next two quarters defined, and the first priorities specified to build depth with engineering.
* A clean separation everyone uses: aspirational (slides), forward\-looking (prototype\-based demo), and committed (roadmap and backlog).


**After 6 months, you will have:**


* The full end\-to\-end MeetingsEQ product specified and engineering\-reviewed, request through approval, budget, HCP registration, ToV, and reporting.
* One customer replacing Excel with the Onomi 360 ToV module, and the first live account expanded from request and approval into budget, ToV, or venue sourcing.


**After 12 months, you will have:**


* One customer closing a full ToV reporting cycle in Onomi 360 instead of Excel.
* Three accounts running request to closure in production, and the org\-wide calendar or HCP engagement view used outside compliance.
* Onomi 360 winning the meetings\-management scope in RFPs.

### **What you need to be great at**


* **Life\-sciences meetings, compliance, or transparency operations.** You have built or operated workflows spanning approval, budgeting, ToV, and closure, and you know what EFPIA and Sunshine disclosure mean in practice.
* **HCP data and integration fluency.** Identity across Veeva, Salesforce, OneKey, and NPI; match rates; what a data team expects from a write\-back.
* **Domain\-to\-product translation.** A messy operating process becomes states, rules, configuration, permissions, and audit events, with regulation separated from customer policy.
* **Sequencing.** The smallest production slice that proves the model without hiding the hard architectural or compliance question.
* **Bias to execute.** You ship, prototype, and put things in front of users in days, not spend weeks describing the problem. You drive decisions to a close and pull others along.
* **Precise writing and direct communication.** Specs detailed enough to build and review, plain words, disagreement in the open.
* **Technical and AI fluency.** You work in Claude Code or OpenAI Codex, you understand code, data flows, and architecture well enough to challenge an engineering design. You know the software development lifecycle deeply, from RFC and specification through review, release, and support. AI takes you from evidence to a testable artifact in hours.

### **What we want to hear about**


* **Life\-sciences meetings and transfer of value.** Tell us about a meetings or transfer\-of\-value process you built or ran end to end, from request through approval, budget, HCP registration, and disclosure. Where did it break, and what did you change? This is the process Onomi 360 replaces, and we want someone who has lived it.


* **From operating process to product.** Tell us about a messy process you turned into a product: which rules you made fixed, which you made configurable, what you integrated, and what you left manual. That translation is the heart of this role.


* **Shipping fast.** Tell us about the last thing you shipped or prototyped within two weeks of first hearing the problem. What did you skip, and what did users do with it? Here you put working software in front of pharma design partners every few weeks, not slides.


* **Building with AI.** Tell us about something you built yourself with Claude Code or another AI tool that changed a product decision, and what it taught you about the code or the architecture underneath. AI\-assisted development is how we build, and you will have real freedom to use it.



Fluent English (written and spoken). Remote, based in Europe or in the US Eastern or Central time zones, with about 10\-20 % travel to design partners and industry events.


*SpotMe recruits, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, parental status, or veteran status.*
