title: Head of General Counsel
description:
**Europcar Mobility Group**

At **Europcar Mobility Group** , our purpose is to help to change the way you move. We are guided by our core values: *We are happy to help* , *We embrace change* , *We take responsibility* , *We act with respect* and *We move as one* . Our culture is built on valuing the contribution and diversity of our team where every individual is treated with dignity and respect. Acting with respect is at the heart of everything we do, and we are fully committed to creating a workplace where differences are celebrated and everyone feels empowered to contribute their unique perspectives.


**Job Description**

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. Legal Strategy \& Business Partnership**

* Act as the primary trusted legal adviser to Iberian senior management and all operational departments including Finance, Operations, Fleet, Customer Service, HR, and Commercial.
* Provide proactive, risk\-calibrated legal guidance that supports business objectives while protecting the Company's interests.
* Anticipate legal risks arising from business operations, market developments, and regulatory changes; recommend and implement preventive legal frameworks.
* Support senior management in strategic decisions including business development, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.
Align Iberian legal strategy with Group\-level directives while adapting to the specific legal environment of Spain and Portugal.  
* 

  

**2\. Compliance, Data Protection \& Consumer Law**

* Design, implement, and maintain a robust compliance programme for the Iberian perimeter, aligned with Group Compliance standards and applicable Spanish and Portuguese legislation.
* Manage all matters relating to GDPR / RGPD and the LOPDGDD, acting as Local DPO or coordinating with the Group DPO; handle data subject rights requests, supervisory authority interactions (AEPD / CNPD), data processing agreements, and GDPR\-related internal procedures.
* Manage consumer protection compliance across both brands, including coordination with consumer associations, OMIC, and relevant regulatory bodies in Spain and Portugal.
* Ensure compliance with sector\-specific regulations governing vehicle rental, including concession terms at airports and railway stations, ITV obligations, insurance requirements, and fleet\-related regulatory frameworks.
* Oversee the Ethics and Compliance function locally, including management of the Canal Ético (whistleblowing channel) in accordance with Group policy and Ley 2/2023\.
Monitor legislative and regulatory developments in Spain and Portugal relevant to the Group's activities; assess impact and advise accordingly.  
* 

  

**3\. Litigation \& Dispute Resolution**

* Manage all civil, criminal, administrative, and regulatory proceedings involving Europcar and Goldcar entities in the Iberian perimeter, including coordination with external law firms.
* Supervise the preparation of legal submissions and pleadings; maintain oversight of litigation strategy, timelines, and exposure assessments.
* Manage pre\-litigation disputes, including consumer complaints, insurance claims, and counterparty demands, in coordination with relevant operational areas.
Maintain an up\-to\-date litigation register; provide regular reporting on exposure, provisions, and case status to the CFO and Group General Counsel.  
* 

  

**4\. Commercial Contracts \& Public Procurement**

* Provide legal advice on all material contracts including fleet acquisition and financing agreements, concession contracts with airport operators (AENA, ANA, private operators) and railway station operators (Adif, IP), commercial agreements with travel agencies, brokers and corporates, supplier and technology contracts, and insurance policies.
* Lead or support legal aspects of tender processes and public procurement, including preparation, review, and submission of bids for airport and railway station concessions in Spain and Portugal, for both Europcar and Goldcar brands.
* Review and advise on the Company's standard terms and conditions (B2C and B2B), ensuring alignment with consumer protection legislation and sector\-specific regulations.
Advise on negotiations with counterparties; coordinate contract management with internal stakeholders to ensure legal review and sign\-off on significant commitments.  
* 

  

**5\. Corporate Governance \& Secretariat**

* Manage corporate housekeeping for Iberian legal entities, including board minutes, shareholder resolutions, powers of attorney, notarial acts, and registry filings in Spain and Portugal.
* Act as or support the Company Secretary function for relevant Iberian entities.
Ensure proper maintenance of corporate records and statutory registers; liaise with notaries, the Registro Mercantil, and public registries as required.  
* 

  

**6\. Team Leadership \& External Counsel Management**

* Lead, develop, and support one Legal Specialist Iberia, ensuring effective coverage of day\-to\-day legal needs and appropriate prioritisation of workload.
* Select, instruct, and manage external law firms for specialist matters (litigation, employment, regulatory, real estate, etc.), ensuring quality, cost\-efficiency, and alignment with legal strategy.
* Foster legal awareness across the business; deliver training and guidance to internal stakeholders on relevant legal topics.
Specific focus on expertise and experience in the management of external law firms in Portugal  
* 

  

**7\. Group Interface \& International Coordination**

* Serve as the primary legal contact between the Iberian business and the Group General Counsel's office; ensure timely reporting and escalation of material legal matters.
* Implement Group legal policies and guidelines within the Iberian perimeter, including in the areas of data protection, competition law, anti\-corruption, and contract standards.
* Cooperate with legal counterparts in other Group jurisdictions on cross\-border matters and shared projects.
Support the adaptation of Group\-level legal frameworks and governance standards into Iberian operations as corporate integration progresses.  
* 

  

**REQUIRED PROFILE**

**Academic Qualifications**

* Law degree required.
* Master's degree in Business Law, EU Law, or an MBA — strongly preferred.
* Bar admission (Colegio de Abogados) — required.
Additional qualifications in Data Protection (CIPP/E, CIPM or equivalent) or Compliance (ICA, CAMS or equivalent) — valued.  
* 

  

**Professional Experience**

* Minimum 10\-15 years of legal experience, combining private practice (leading law firm) and/or in\-house roles in a complex, multi\-jurisdictional business environment.
* Demonstrated expertise in at least three of the following: commercial contracts and public procurement / concessions; GDPR and consumer law; regulatory compliance and ethics; corporate governance; dispute resolution and litigation management; fleet, mobility, logistics, or transport\-sector legal work.
* Track record of managing external counsel, controlling legal spend, and reporting to senior management on legal risk.
* Prior experience as a Head of Legal or equivalent senior in\-house role in an international company — highly valued.
* Experience in the vehicle rental, mobility, travel, hospitality, or regulated consumer services sectors — a strong plus.
Familiarity with public tender processes and airport or railway concession frameworks in Spain and/or Portugal — a strong plus.  
* 

  

**Technical \& Legal Knowledge**

* Deep knowledge of Spanish and Portuguese commercial, corporate, and contract law.
* Strong command of GDPR / RGPD and the LOPDGDD, including current AEPD / CNPD enforcement practice.
* Solid understanding of consumer protection law in Spain and Portugal, including sector\-specific regulations applicable to vehicle rental.
* Working knowledge of Spanish public procurement law (Ley 9/2017 LCSP) and concession frameworks applicable to transport infrastructure.
* Familiarity with criminal compliance frameworks (Art. 31bis Codigo Penal) and whistleblowing legislation (Ley 2/2023\).
Proficiency with legal databases (Westlaw, Aranzadi, etc.) and standard legal management tools.  
* 

  

**Languages**

* Spanish — native or full professional proficiency (C2\).
* English — full professional proficiency (C1 minimum); primary language for Group\-level communication and documentation.
Portuguese — professional working proficiency strongly valued, given direct responsibility for Portuguese operations.  
* 

  

**Competencies \& Personal Attributes**

* Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen; provides pragmatic, business\-oriented advice beyond purely technical legal analysis.
* High degree of autonomy and personal accountability; able to lead the legal function with limited resources and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; credible with senior management, Group functions, and external parties.
* Strong leadership and people management skills; committed to developing the team and building legal awareness across the organisation.
* Resilient, solutions\-focused, and comfortable operating in an environment of organisational change and complexity.
* Highest standards of professional ethics, integrity, and confidentiality.
Ability to identify, quantify, and communicate legal and regulatory risk clearly to non\-legal audiences, including C\-level stakeholders and Group governance bodies.  
* 

  

We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender reassignment, nationality, sexual orientation, age, disability status, religion, or any other dimension of diversity. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and fostering an environment of equity and inclusion, where respect for one another is essential. If you need any accommodations or assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know. Together, through mutual respect, we can create a more equitable and inclusive future.


**Europcar Mobility Group** is a global mobility player, with 75 years of mobility services expertise and a leading position in Europe. *“We help to change the way you move”* is what we stand for and brings us together.


We offer to individuals and businesses a wide range of car and van rental services, be it for a few hours, a few days, a week, a month or more, on\-demand or on subscription, relying on a fleet of more than 250\.000 vehicles, equipped with the latest engines including an increasing share of electric vehicles.


Our brands address differentiated needs, use cases and expectations: Europcar® \- a global leader of car rental and light commercial vehicle rental, with a premium positioning, Goldcar® \- a frontrunner at providing low\-cost car rental services in Europe, and Fox\-Rent\-A\-Car®, one of the main players in the car rental market in the US, with a "value for money" positioning.


Customers’ satisfaction is at the heart of the Group’s ambition and that of our more than 8,000 employees, everywhere we deliver our mobility solutions, thanks to a strong network in over 130 countries.


More info at: www.europcar\-mobility\-group.com

description:
Job Description \#body.unify div.unify\-button\-container .unify\-apply\-now: focus, \#body.unify div.unify\-button\-container .unify\-apply\-\#body.unify div.unify\-button\-container .unify\-apply\-now: focus, \#body.unify div.unify\-button\-container .unify\-apply\-
  
Senior Data Analyst
  
**Posting Start Date:** 9/10/26
  
Alcântara, PRT, 1300‑001, \| Gentofte, DNK, 2820,
  
  

Senior Data Analyst – SAP Reporting \& Stakeholder Alignment
  
  

**Location:** Copenhagen, Denmark or Lisbon, Portugal
  
**Working hours:** Full\-time
  
**Work model:** Hybrid
  
**Contract type:** Permanent
  
  

Are you passionate about turning business questions into meaningful data solutions? Do you enjoy working with stakeholders, solving complex data challenges, and transforming data into insights that drive better decisions? Then you might be the person we are looking for.
  
  

As our new Senior Data Analyst , you will join the Data \& Insights team and report directly to the Head of Data \& Insights . In this role, you will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and SAP data, ensuring reporting requirements are clearly defined, translated into actionable data solutions, and delivered with accuracy and impact.
  
  

You will work closely with Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, and Data Engineering teams to support data\-driven decision\-making while improving reporting processes and data quality across the organization. This is a great opportunity to influence business decisions, collaborate across functions, and help shape the future of data and analytics at STG.
  
  

What your day will look like
  
  

**In this role, you will typically focus on:**  

Partner directly with business stakeholders — Finance leadership, Sales/Commercial, Supply Chain/Operations — to understand their reporting and data needs, and translate them into concrete data requirements.
  
Work closely with data engineers to scope, request, and validate data pulled from SAP, acting as the translation layer between business language and technical/data specifications.
  
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, validate, and consolidate data for recurring and ad hoc reporting.
  
Build and maintain Excel\-based models, trackers, and reports that stakeholders rely on for decision\-making.
  
Consolidate data into stakeholder\-ready reporting, and supporting data checks.
  
Act as the go\-to person for scoping ambiguous stakeholder requests — clarifying what's actually needed, managing expectations, and pushing back constructively when a request isn't well\-defined or feasible.
  
Identify data quality issues at the source and work with SAP module owners and data engineers to resolve them.
  
Document data definitions, sources, and logic so reporting stays consistent and auditable month over month.
  
Continuously look for ways to streamline the process rather than repeating manual work each cycle.
  
  

What you'll bring
  
  

5\+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar data\-facing role, ideally in a retail or consumer business.
  
Strong SQL skills — comfortable writing and troubleshooting complex queries independently.
  
Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data modeling; Power Query is a plus).
  
Familiarity with SAP data structures, particularly FI (Finance) and SD (Sales \& Distribution).
  
Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), or willingness to learn it, is a plus.
  
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Business, Economics, Finance, Data/Statistics, Engineering, or related).
  
Proven experience gathering requirements from business stakeholders and translating them into technical/data specifications.
  
Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align multiple stakeholders (including Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, and IT/data engineering) with sometimes competing priorities, and communicate trade\-offs clearly.
  
Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity and turning it into a structured plan.
  
  

Working at STG \& What to Expect
  
  

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye . We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.
  
  

At STG you'll find more than a role. You'll find opportunities to grow, learn from talented colleagues, and contribute to initiatives that help drive business performance across a global organization.
  
  

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 45\.000 to 50\.000 DKK/Monthly , corresponding to the level of the position, expected experience, and responsibilities.
  
  

**Incentives and Benefits:** The salary package may include short\-term and/or long\-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.
  
  

Ready to be part of something bigger?
  
  

Apply now and discover much more.
  
  

Our recruitment process
  
  

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:
  
  

Recruiter screen
  
Interview with the hiring team
  
Final interview with key stakeholders
  
  

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Head of Product Operations (Core)
description:
### **Atolls is the world's largest community\-driven shopping platform, active in 20\+ markets.**



We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re\-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.



Our 1,000\+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

### **About This Role:**



We are looking for a **Head of Product Operations** (m/f/d) to join our Product team in Munich, Madrid, London or Paris with a hybrid work setup. In this role, you will lead and improve the operations that are directly linked to our products. Your work will directly impact our operational integrity notably by enhancing fraud detection, streamlining customer support processes, or managing cash projections. All of which are critical to delivering a trustworthy and seamless experience for our users.



This dedicated product operations position was triggered by the launch of new offer types within our product, and the scope of the role will expand as we innovate with our product.



Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.


### **Our Benefits:**



At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:


* A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
* A supportive and open\-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
* 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
* A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
* Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
* Mental health coaching to support your well\-being.
* Regular global and local get\-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
* The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
* A cloud\-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.


* *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.*

### **Responsibilities:**



In this role, you will:


* Drive the entire fraud management and detection across all our product types and at payment process level
* Streamline customer support workflows
* Oversee the maintenance of our coupon auto apply and app to app operations
* Partner with finance to ensure we have enough cash on all our providers' account
* Work cross\-functionally with Product and other teams to translate business needs into scalable operational solutions and continuously improve the performance of our rewards products.


The role is bound to increase in scope. We expect you to champion the use of AI and automation to generate operational insights and drive improvements.

  

### **Your Profile:**



We're looking for someone with


* 3 \- 5 years of experience in strategy consulting, mergers and acquisitions, or operations in tech
* A Master degree from a Tier 1 University
* **Strategic \& Analytical Skills:** Strong problem\-solving and analytical capabilities, with the ability to break down complex business problems, identify opportunities, and develop scalable solutions.
* **Operational Excellence:** Proven ability to design, standardize, and optimize processes across complex or rapidly evolving products and organizations.
* **Leadership \& Collaboration:** A strong leadership track record
* **Mindset:** A proactive and persistent mindset, adaptability in a dynamic environment, and a strong interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve operational efficiency and decision\-making.
* **Language requirements:** Fluent in English and any other European languages is a plus.


### **Our hiring process:**


* **TA Call**: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.


* **Technical Round**: Focus on the technical aspects of the role *(Through a Live Case)*, and meet your potential manager.


* **Final Round**: Meet other Atollians ️  

*It varies from 1 to 3 interviews*



* *Some processes might slightly change according to needs*


#### **Ready to apply?**



Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to **up to three.** This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.


**We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.**  

* *Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.*

*\#LI\-PZ*



At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.



As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. **Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.**  

Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner.



The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.

title: Head of Enterprise Engineering Excellence
description:
**We are looking for a Head of Enterprise Engineering Excellence to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital \& Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey—a space where we continuously invest, evolve, and create world\-class capabilities.**

 **Position Snapshot**

* Location: Nespresso Hub, Barcelona. Spain.
* Type of Contract: Permanent.
* Type of work: Hybrid
* Work Language: Fluent Business English

 **The Role**

*As the* ***Head of Enterprise Engineering Excellence****, you will shape and lead the engineering foundations that power Nespresso’s global digital ecosystem. Reporting to the Global Head of IT, you will lead a large, high\-performing organization spanning infrastructure, platform engineering, and engineering enablement.*

*You will be instrumental in accelerating Nespresso’s digital transformation—enabling teams to build, deploy, and scale products faster, more securely, and with greater impact. This is a highly visible leadership role where you will define engineering strategy, modernize ways of working, and influence outcomes at enterprise scale.*

* Lead a **global organization of 200\+ engineers**, building high\-performing teams and leadership capability
* Accelerate modernization through **DevSecOps, cloud, automation, SRE, platform engineering, and AI**

* + Partner with senior stakeholders to **translate strategy into tangible business outcomes**
	+ Manage budgets, vendors, and cost optimization while maximizing value delivery

* 15\+ years of experience in senior engineering or technology leadership roles in complex enterprise environments
* Proven track record leading large, globally distributed engineering organizations (200\+ scale)
* Deep expertise across cloud (Azure preferred), infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, and modern architectures
* Strong experience with cloud\-native, microservices, APIs, CI/CD, and automation
* Strategic mindset with the ability to connect technology decisions to business impact
* Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Proven ability to drive transformation, culture change, and operational excellence

* Experience in consumer\-facing or global brand environments with high performance expectations
* Background in platform\-led or product\-based operating models
* Strong exposure to AI\-driven engineering or emerging technologies

 **We Offer You:**


We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.

* **Recreation activities** such as yoga, Zumba, etc. and a wide range of volunteering activities.

 **The Hiring Process:**

* **Your Application**: Submit your application and Talent Acquisition will review it (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international).
* **Interviews**: Engage in four stages of interviews (Talent Acquisition, Hiring Manager, Leadership, and Stakeholder Interview).
* **Feedback**: After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.
* **Job Offer**: Successful candidates will receive a formal offer.
* **Onboarding**: Prepare your onboarding journey and welcome you on your first day at Nespresso!

 **About Nespresso**

Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined how millions experience coffee. Today, we are equally driven by innovation, sustainability, and digital excellence—working towards carbon neutrality and building world\-class digital experiences from our Barcelona Hub.

*We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.*


People are at the heart of our success – all 14,000 of them. We actively cultivate diversity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. We celebrate individuality, believing that your authenticity and uniqueness can help us to grow and thrive together


Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.

**Join Nestlé \#beaforceforgood**

title: Product Director - Brokerage
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

As a Product Director for Brokerage at J.P. Morgan Personal Investing, you will lead a team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end\-to\-end product life cycle. You are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality products that exceed customer expectations.


Our Product team is at the heart of this venture, focused on getting smart ideas into the hands of our customers. We're looking for leaders who have a curious mindset, thrive in collaborative squads, and are passionate about building investment products. By their nature, our people are also solution\-oriented, commercially savvy and have a head for fintech. * Oversees product development, testing, and release management, ensuring high standards of quality and reliability.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**


* 10\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area within financial services or technology
* Proven track record of successfully building and managing wealth management products, and familiarity with brokerage and/or mutual funds end\-to\-end lifecycle
* Proven ability to lead product life cycle activities including discovery, ideation, strategic development, requirements definition, and value management
* Experience with software delivery best practices, working with technical product requirements and mapping of dependencies, design of minimum viable products, working with multi\-country requirements
* Ability to explain technical issues in a clear way to the business and other stakeholders
* Ability to analyse and incorporate user needs, business needs, and technical constraints/opportunities into the product development process
* Be the glue among departments and create shared understanding by translating ideas and concepts into technical or layman's terms
* Experience developing investment products across different European jurisdictions

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**


* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, finance or highly qualitative degree

* Demonstrated prior experience navigating and working in matrix and complex organizations, collaborating effectively across teams and functions

We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.  

  

The Digital team is dedicated to creating innovative, industry\-leading products and experiences that help customers access, share and control their financial data so they can make smart decisions with their money. Teams enable innovation while adhering to the firm's data sharing principles of security, customer control and convenience, and privacy.

title: Senior Associate Director, MIM Program - Business School
description:

Are you interested in joining a dynamic and international team of professionals to transform education? IE University's **Master** **in Management Program, Business School** is looking for a **Senior Associate Director** to join its team!  

The Master in Management Program (MIM) is one of IE Business School's flagship programs. It is a full\-time, 15\-month program, which can be pursued in English or Bilingual. The program is geared toward recent graduates looking for an innovative, internationally acclaimed master's program in management. It enrolls approximately 650 students per year, in two intakes (September and January), with up to 65 nationalities per intake.


The Senior Associate Director is a senior individual contributor within the program management team, reporting to the Executive Director of the Master in Management Program. Alongside the standard MIM, this role takes end\-to\-end ownership of the Master in Management and Strategy (MIMStrat), and acts as a reference point for the wider team on program design, policy and complex student and faculty situations.

**Why IE University?**


Every story begins with a purpose, and ours has always been about people. Founded in 1973, IE University has continuously raised the bar to drive positive change through education. We believe education is more than a path to professional success; it is a catalyst for personal transformation and meaningful impact.

  

At IE University, we place people and their potential at the center of everything we do, empowering individuals to become extraordinary. We encourage bold thinking and foster a culture where innovation, curiosity, and courage lead to real\-world impact. Together, we create an environment where talent thrives, and ideas shape the future.

 **Our mission**


We support students in developing impact skills to live and lead with positive impact. This ignites a ripple effect: We transform people, who then transform others, systems, society, and, ultimately, our world.

  



**Our Purpose**


To foster positive change.

  



**Values**

* Cultivate the humanistic approach.
* Empower your entrepreneurial spirit
* Cherish the diversity of people, mind, and experience
* Drive innovation with a proactive mindset


We are looking for a person to join a full\-time position in **Madrid \- María de Molina.**

Responsibilities:
**Your role as a Senior Associate Director will involve:**  

* End\-to\-end ownership of MIMStrat: academic calendar, student journey, faculty coordination and continuous improvement of the program, working closely with the Executive Director and the Vice Dean.

title: Head, Jobs, Growth and Structural Transformation [Open to Tier 0, 1 & 2 applicants]
description:
**Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:


* **Tier 0** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* **Tier 1** : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated** : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.  



**Background**

UNDP is the knowledge frontier organization for sustainable development in the UN Development System and serves as the integrator for collective action to realize the 2030 Agenda and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). UNDP’s policy work carried out at HQ, Regional and Country Office levels, forms a contiguous spectrum of deep local knowledge to cutting\-edge global perspectives and advocacy.


The Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) has the responsibility for developing all relevant policy and guidance to support the results of UNDP’s Strategic Plan. BPPS’s staff provides technical advice to Country Offices; advocates for UNDP corporate messages, represents UNDP at multi\-stakeholder fora including public\-private dialogues, government and civil society dialogues, and engages in UN inter\-agency coordination in specific thematic areas. BPPS works closely with UNDP’s Crisis Bureau (CB) to support emergency and crisis response. BPPS ensures that issues of risk are fully integrated into UNDP’s development programmes. BPPS assists UNDP and partners to achieve higher quality development results through an integrated approach that links results\-based management and performance monitoring with more effective and new ways of working. BPPS supports UNDP and partners to be more innovative, knowledge and data driven including in its programme support efforts.


UNDP’s Strategic Plan 2026–2029 positions prosperity for all as one of four strategic objectives, alongside effective governance, crisis resilience and a healthy planet. The Strategic Plan frames UNDP’s contribution around integrated development solutions that support countries to advance human development in a fast\-changing world, powered by three accelerators: digital and AI transformation, gender equality and sustainable finance. Within this framework, prosperity is understood as more than income growth. It is linked to expanded opportunities, decent jobs and livelihoods, access to productive assets, human capital, social protection, essential services, protection from shocks, and the removal of structural barriers that prevent people from participating fully in economic and social life.


Within BPPS, the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub advances UNDP’s integrated prosperity agenda by supporting countries to move from poverty to prosperity through expanded opportunities, enhanced capabilities, stronger systems, and more resilient development pathways. The Hub is organized around three mutually reinforcing pillars / service lines: 1\) Multi\-dimensional Poverty, Inequalities and Capabilities; (2\) Jobs, Growth, and Structural Transformation; and (3\) HIV, Health and Inclusion.


**Duties and Responsibilities**

Based in Madrid, the Head, Jobs, Growth and Transformation will lead the Hub’s second service line, providing senior\-level policy leadership, technical guidance and strategic positioning for UNDP’s work on jobs, livelihoods, inclusive growth and structural transformation. The Head will support the development and delivery of an integrated offer that helps countries translate economic transformation, private sector development and investment into concrete employment and livelihood outcomes.


This service line responds to increasing country demand for support on the systemic enablers of job\-rich development, including productivity growth, trade, industrial and sectoral policy, MSME competitiveness, value\-chain development, skills systems, local economic development, and transitions from informal to formal work. It will help countries identify and address barriers within labour markets and enterprise ecosystems, while supporting emerging opportunities associated with green, blue, digital and AI\-driven transitions, including jobs of the future. Across this work, particular attention will be given to women, young people, informal workers, MSMEs and groups facing structural barriers to economic participation.


The incumbent provides leadership, policy direction and strategic positioning for UNDP’s work on Jobs, Growth and Structural Transformation, and represents UNDP in the wider jobs, livelihoods and inclusive growth community of practice, including with the UN system, international financial institutions, bilateral partners, external experts, private sector actors, employers’ and workers’ organizations, and other relevant stakeholders.


The incumbent facilitates and coordinates implementation support to the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub’s second service line. The incumbent ensures that UNDP’s offer on jobs, livelihoods and structural transformation is informed by country demand, experience from the ground, and broader policy debates and analytical advances on job\-rich growth, productive transformation, MSME development, skills, informality, trade, investment, green and digital transitions, and inclusive economic opportunity. To this end, the Head provides substantive leadership in the relevant technical areas and leverages capacities across the Hub, Regional Bureaux, Regional Hubs, Country Offices and the broader Global Policy Network.


UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to respond to evolving business needs and to harness synergies across interventions in pursuit of its strategic goals. This approach reflects the interconnected nature of development challenges, which require multidisciplinary teams and integrated, systemic responses. Therefore, the incumbent is expected to work across issues, units, functions, teams and projects — collaborating horizontally across the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub and with other parts of UNDP, including governance, crisis, planet, gender, digital transformation and sustainable finance — to enhance coherence, quality and impact.


Under the guidance and direct supervision of the Director, Prosperity and Wellbeing, the Head is responsible for the following duties and responsibilities:


1\) Substantive leadership and quality assurance of policy advice on jobs, growth and structural transformation:


* Provide substantive leadership in the analysis of drivers, opportunities and constraints for job\-rich, inclusive and sustainable economic transformation, with a focus on employment, livelihoods, productivity, MSME development, skills, informality, trade, investment and structural transformation.
* Lead the development of relevant, timely and innovation\-focused knowledge products, policy analysis, tools and guidance on jobs, growth and structural transformation, in close collaboration with relevant teams across BPPS and the organization.
* Ensure that UNDP’s policy advice on jobs and livelihoods is informed by country experience, high\-quality quantitative and qualitative data, economic and labour market analysis, and the latest global policy debates and evidence.
* Develop and present cutting\-edge policy options to governments and other development actors on employment\-intensive growth, productive transformation, private sector development, enterprise ecosystems, skills systems, local economic development, and green, blue, digital and AI\-related transitions.
* Lead intersectoral policy dialogue on jobs, livelihoods and inclusive growth with governments, UN system partners, international financial institutions, donors, civil society, employers’ and workers’ organizations, academia and the private sector.
* Ensure quality assurance of policy and programme outputs related to the service line, including global, regional and country\-level initiatives.

2\) Provide high\-quality, timely and responsive technical and policy advice on prosperity and sustainable finance to Country Offices in the region:


* Provide substantive, timely, high\-quality and multidisciplinary policy and programme advisory services to Regional Bureaux, Regional Hubs and Country Offices in response to country demand, including through analysis, policy options, programme design, implementation support and quality assurance.
* Advice and support countries to design integrated approaches that connect national growth strategies, private sector development, investment, trade, skills and enterprise development with concrete employment and livelihood outcomes.
* Advise on labour market diagnostics, jobs strategies, MSME competitiveness, value\-chain development, informal\-to\-formal transitions, skills development, local economic development, and employment opportunities linked to green, blue, digital and AI\-driven transitions.
* Identify new areas of engagement and opportunities for innovation, scaling and portfolio development to position UNDP as a relevant actor in line with emerging country demand.
* Leverage internal and external expertise, including from the Economist Network, Regional Hubs, specialized technical teams, UN system partners, IFIs, academia and the private sector.
* Ensure coherence and alignment of jobs\-related policy and programme support with the broader work of the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub and other BPPS teams, including on poverty, inequalities, capabilities, health, social protection, care systems, governance, crisis, planet, gender, digital transformation and sustainable finance.

3\) Coordinate and advise on the implementation of programme and policy objectives:


* Provide coordination and substantive support for the implementation of global programmes, initiatives and workstreams related to jobs, growth and structural transformation.
* Lead or support the development of global, regional and multi\-country offers, strategies, concept notes, project documents and resource mobilization proposals in areas under the service line.
* Support global processes, strategies and action plans in line with UNDP’s integrator function and its role in advancing the SDGs.
* Promote portfolio approaches that connect jobs and livelihoods with wider development objectives, including poverty reduction, inclusion, resilience, climate action, digital transformation, sustainable finance and local economic development.
* Support results\-based management, monitoring, reporting and learning for relevant initiatives, including the development of indicators and measurement approaches for employment, livelihoods and enterprise\-related outcomes.
* Contribute to internal planning, budgeting, reporting and performance management processes for the service line.

4\) Facilitate knowledge management, innovation, and community of practice networking:


* Set forth an operational platform for continuous data, analysis, documentation and codification of results and lessons learned on jobs, livelihoods and structural transformation for UNDP globally.
* Develop and deliver guidance material, tools, training and capacity development support for UNDP staff on jobs, livelihoods, inclusive growth and structural transformation.
* Promote the use of innovative approaches, data systems, digital tools, AI\-enabled analytics, foresight, systems thinking and portfolio methods to strengthen UNDP’s policy and programme support.
* Identify, document and disseminate promising practices from Country Offices and partners, including on employment\-intensive growth, MSMEs, skills, value chains, local economic development, informal\-to\-formal transitions and jobs of the future.
* Coordinate and strengthen communities of practice across Regional Bureaux, Regional Hubs and Country Offices.
* Build networks with academic and research institutions, think tanks, UN agencies, IFIs, bilateral partners and other expert organizations to enrich UNDP’s policy and programme offer.

5\) Representation, advocacy, and partner engagement for effective policy positioning:


* Represent UNDP in high\-profile areas, interagency coordination forums and external policy dialogues on jobs, livelihoods, inclusive growth and structural transformation.
* Advocate core UNDP messages and positions on job\-rich, inclusive and sustainable development, including the centrality of decent jobs and livelihoods to poverty\-to\-prosperity transitions.
* Promote South\-South and triangular cooperation by facilitating exchanges, peer learning and sharing of country experience where relevant.
* Foster strategic partnerships with UN system partners, IFIs, regional development banks, bilateral donors, foundations, civil society, academia, employers’ and workers’ organizations, and the private sector.
* Lead or contribute to resource mobilization efforts in line with BPPS priorities and corporate guidelines, including with traditional and emerging partners.
* Collaborate closely with BPPS teams, Regional Bureaux, the Economist Network, the Human Development Report Office, the Sustainable Finance Hub, the Digital Office and other relevant parts of UNDP to inform the strategic direction of UNDP’s policy advisory support.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization **.**

Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities: Specialists, Analyst, as well as consultants or other personnel assigned to the Jobs, Growth and Structural Transformation service line.


**Competencies**

Core:


* Achieve Results: LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact.
* Think Innovatively: LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems.
* Learn Continuously: LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences.
* Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands.
* Act with Determination: LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results.
* Engage and Partner: LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter\-agency collaboration.
* Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity.

People Management:


UNDP People Management Competencies can be found in the dedicated site .


Cross Functional and Technical:


* Business Direction \& Strategy \- Strategic Thinking: Develop effective strategies and prioritised plans in line with UNDP’s mission and objectives, based on the systemic analysis of challenges, opportunities and potential risks; link the general vision to reality on the ground to create tangible targeted solutions; learn from a variety of sources to anticipate and effectively respond to both current and future trends; demonstrate foresight.
* Business Direction \& Strategy \- Systems Thinking: Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system.
* Business Management \- Portfolio Management: Ability to select, prioritise and control the organization's programmes and projects in line with its strategic objectives and capacity. Ability to balance the implementation of change initiatives with regular activities for optimal return on investment. Knowledge and understanding of key principles of project, programme, and portfolio management.
* Business Management \- Working with Evidence and Data: Ability to inspect, cleanse, transform and model data with the goal of discovering useful information, informing conclusions and supporting decision\-making.
* 2030 Agenda: Prosperity \- Prosperity: Jobs, MSMEs, supply chains.

**Required Skills and Experience**

Education:


* Advanced university degree (master's degree or equivalent) in Economics, Development Economics, Statistics, Business/Public Administration, Public Finance, Finance, or related field is required. or
* A first\-level university degree (bachelor's degree or equivalent) in the areas stated above, in combination with an additional two years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Experience:


* A minimum of 10 years (with master's degree) or 12 years (with bachelor's degree) of relevant experience in either public sector (national or multilateral, including UN), or private (academia, non\-governmental sector, corporate), with a demonstrated increasing level of responsibility in the relevant technical areas of jobs, livelihoods, inclusive growth, structural transformation, private sector development, MSME development, skills, labour markets, and/or economic advisory services is required.
* Demonstrated experience providing high\-level policy and programme advice on jobs, livelihoods, inclusive growth, labour markets, private sector development, MSME competitiveness, skills systems, local economic development, value\-chain development, and/or structural transformation is required.
* Experience in leading or supporting national development planning, employment strategies, growth diagnostics, labour market analysis, private sector development strategies, or sectoral/territorial development approaches, with demonstrated technical skills in policy analysis and partnership building with the World Bank, is required.
* Demonstrated experience in developing, quality assuring and applying tools, methodologies, diagnostics or policy options to support countries in designing and implementing strategies that link growth, productivity, investment and private sector development with employment and livelihood outcomes is required.
* Experience working on one or more of the following areas is required: informal\-to\-formal transitions; youth employment; women’s economic participation; MSME development; trade and value chains; skills for the future; green, blue, digital or AI\-related jobs and transitions; local economic development; or employment and livelihoods in crisis or transition contexts.
* Demonstrated experience leading and coordinating complex multidisciplinary policy or programme initiatives at scale, at global, regional and/or multi\-country level, related to jobs, inclusive growth, economic transformation, private sector development, labour markets or related areas, including providing strategic and technical direction, ensuring coherence across technical workstreams, and providing quality assurance and/or technical guidance across countries or regions is an asset.
* Proven leadership and people management experience in the UN System or another multilateral, development, public or comparable organization, including experience leading diverse technical teams and/or networks across countries, regions and institutional boundaries is desired.
* Demonstrated experience engaging with and advising senior government counterparts and other high\-level decision\-makers, and translating technical analysis into strategic policy options, programmes or investment priorities related to jobs, inclusive growth and economic transformation is desired.
* Demonstrated experience building and managing strategic partnerships and mobilizing institutional, technical and/or financial support from a range of partners, including governments, UN entities, international and regional financial institutions, bilateral partners, private sector actors, civil society and/or academia is desired.

Language:

Knowledge of another UN language is desirable.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Infrastructure decisions made at concept and design stages lock in decades of maintenance costs and operational risks. Programs that treat infrastructure operations and maintenance as a downstream concern inherit systems that are more costly to operate and fail more often.


The ideal candidate brings senior, hands\-on experience across the full lifecycle of high\-speed and conventional rail infrastructure: planning, design, construction, testing and commissioning, and long\-term operation and maintenance. Prior experience acting as technical authority or shadow operator, representing Infrastructure O\&M interests inside design and construction decisions.

* Direct experience defining maintenance strategy and OPEX models for rail infrastructure and systems.
* International project experience, across multiple rail markets and multidisciplinary teams.

* Experience acting as technical authority or shadow operator representing infrastructure O\&M during design and construction.

AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.

Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. With 136 manufacturing plants and offices in 23 countries, Antolin has achieved this strong industry presence through 75 years of working with our customers in order to develop a complete cycle of component manufacturing, from their conception and design, through the development and validation stages, to their industrialisation and sequenced delivery.
  
  

We are working hard on spearheading the transformation that the automotive industry is currently experiencing with regard to vehicle interiors by collaborating with our customers. We do so in order to develop more sustainable and technologically advanced vehicles that are also adapted to the new needs and requirements of their passengers.
  
  

As part of this transformation, Antolin is committed to a sustainable business model that focuses on and creates value for all its stakeholders, including its customers, employees, investors, suppliers, and society as a whole.
  
  

Mission
  
  

Ensure effective environmental management across the organization by maintaining and strengthening the ISO 14001 Environmental Management System. Collaborate with key business functions to implement sustainability procedures and standards. Support continuous improvement, high‑quality environmental data governance, and accurate sustainability reporting, contributing to the company’s decarbonization strategy and overall sustainability objectives under the guidance of the Climate Change \& Circular Economy Manager. Assist the Innovation\& Sustainability Director in his mission and functions.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Maintain and continuously improve the ISO 14001 and ISO 50001 Environmental \& Energy Management Systems across all Antolin Group companies.
  
Manage the Environmental Management System (SGA) at Headquarters, including waste, water, noise, environmental compliance, training, awareness activities, and environmental assessments.
  
Act as the main contact for environmental and energy certification bodies, coordinating multisite certifications and external audits.
  
Coordinate and conduct internal environmental and energy audits, ensuring corrective actions are implemented and followed up.
  
Consolidate and ensure the quality of environmental reporting from all plants, supporting KPI tracking, data governance, and reporting tools.
  
Support the calculation and improvement of the company's carbon footprint and greenhouse gas (GHG) inventories.
  
Prepare and support ESG reporting for management, the Board, and external stakeholders, including CDP, SAQ, EcoVadis, and the Annual Integrated Report.
  
Support the implementation and monitoring of the Sustainable Business Strategy and sustainability roadmap.
  
Provide environmental and sustainability guidance to different corporate departments.
  
Identify and monitor sustainability\-related risks, opportunities, and controls.
  
Monitor ESG regulations and stakeholder requirements to ensure compliance and strong sustainability performance.
  
Support sustainability training and awareness initiatives across the organization.
  
Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Sustainability Department.
  
Represent the company in sustainability forums and external events.
  
Participate in and develop additional sustainability\-related projects.
  
  

What We Are Looking For
  
  

Professional Training (FP) and/or a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in environmental science, Environmental Engineering, or a related field.
  
Desirable experience of 2 years in environmental management in industry
  
Experience related to environmental sustainability
  
International experience (preferably)
  
Effective collaboration and cross‑functional teamwork. Clear and structured communication skills
  
Sound decision‑making and prioritization abilities. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
  
Proactivity and initiative in managing sustainability topics. Resolutive and goal‑oriented mindset
  
Professional English level (minimum B2\).
  
  

**What can we offer you:**  

You will be part of a highly engaged multinational with international career opportunities.
  
We offer you a learning journey adapted to your professional experience.
  
You will work on international projects for world\- renowned companies in Automotive sector.
  
You can find an Open Environment to learn new technologies.
  
We can offer you a competitive salary, benefits and valuable OEM discounts.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any of these protected characteristics. description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of corporate open innovation? Do you want your strategies to end in deployment rather than in a final presentation?

  

We are looking for an **Innovation Strategist** to help companies and governments define, design, and implement cutting\-edge open innovation strategies and formats. The role is based in Valencia, Spain, with a genuinely global mandate and significant travel. You will work in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and international environment, leading open innovation projects at the forefront of technology and creativity.

 **WHO WE ARE:**



Plug and Play is the world's largest open innovation platform, with 60\+ locations worldwide. We support leading corporations with their innovation efforts by strategizing innovation and connecting them with break\-through startups to drive joint innovation and strategic growth. Our mission is to bring Silicon Valley's innovation mindset to companies and governments worldwide.

 **WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**



We are looking for a proactive and creative team member to shape and execute open innovation strategies for our corporate and public\-sector partners. This role combines consulting, research, and service design to enhance innovation methodologies, optimize processes, and deliver impactful projects. You'll lead and contribute to workshops, strategy development, and execution, ensuring real\-world impact for our clients.

  

Open innovation is our operating model: you will work across corporates, governments, and startups at the same time, and the same platform that writes the strategy also sources the startups and takes the solution through to deployment inside the client organization. Our definition of success is not a pilot. It is a solution in operation, at scale.

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**1\. Strategy \& Execution**


* Develop and implement open innovation strategies tailored to corporate and government challenges and objectives.
* Optimize innovation processes, integrating best practices in corporate innovation, venture clienting, venture building, and open innovation.

  


**2\. Workshop Facilitation \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Design and lead workshops to drive ideation, strategy formulation, and open innovation roadmaps.
* Collaborate with corporate teams, executives, startups, and external partners to ensure seamless execution and measurable impact.

  


**3\. Research \& Insights**


* Analyze emerging trends, market insights, and disruptive technologies to inform open innovation strategies.
* Provide thought leadership by translating research into actionable recommendations.

  


**4\. Business Development \& Growth**


* Identify opportunities to expand open innovation initiatives and craft innovation\-driven proposals.
* Support business development efforts by contributing insights, strategy recommendations, and proposal writing.

  


**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:**


* 3\+ years of experience in open innovation, innovation consulting, corporate innovation, product development, digital transformation, or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience facilitating ideation sessions, design sprints, or co\-creation workshops with senior stakeholders.Practical command of Design Thinking, Lean Startup, and Agile methodologies applied to real projects.
* Strong ability to translate research insights into actionable strategies and solutions.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, including presentations that carry an argument to an executive audience.
* Entrepreneurial mindset: self\-motivated, proactive, and results\-driven.
* A genuine team player. Our team is fast\-moving: we share client work, cover for each other across time zones, and expect people to pull in the same direction rather than optimize for their own project. Lone wolves are not a fit here.
* Fluency in English, and readiness to travel frequently for global client engagements.
* Experience working with startups as solution providers, such as scouting, assessment, or venture clienting, is a plus.
* Public sector or government innovation experience (procurement, national innovation programmes, EU funding instruments) is a plus.
* Working fluency with AI tools for research, synthesis, and production is a plus.
* Additional languages, particularly Spanish, German, French, or Arabic, are a plus.

  



A completed University Degree (Master's level preferred) is an advantage, and a strong analytical or technical background, such as engineering, natural sciences, design, business, or economics, will serve you well in front of deep\-tech and government stakeholders.

 **WHY JOIN US?**


* Work in a dynamic, global open innovation environment at the intersection of startups, corporates, and governments.
* Collaborate with future\-oriented corporations and pioneering governments across EMEA, Asia, and the Americas.
* Based in Valencia, one of Europe's most liveable cities.
* A clear development path
* Be part of a fast\-growing, energetic team with flat hierarchies, short decision paths, and a genuinely collaborative culture

Send your CV and a short note telling us why you'd be brilliant in this role.

title: Strategic Partner Manager
description:
### **About Us**



Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.



We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.


### **About the Team**



The Global Partnerships team lies at the heart of Twitch. Our team is dedicated to serving streamers in our Twitch Partner Program from around the world. Our partner managers are custodians of meaningful and enduring relationships with our Partners. Our operations managers lead the execution and efficiency of critical processes used to support the Partner experience. Our program managers design and implement initiatives that acknowledge and enable Partner success. Collectively, we shape and evolve the Partner Program with meticulous care. Every decision is guided by the diverse needs of our streamers, who are the essence of Twitch's success.


### **About the Role**



The Strategic Partner Manager (SPM) supports the ongoing success of creators across the Twitch Partner program and plays a vital role in bringing new creators into the ecosystem. This role spans Creator Recruitment, Account Management, and Community Engagement, requiring a balance of analytical thinking and relationship management skills.



The role will work from Madrid, Spain and report into the Director of Global Spanish Partnerships.


### **You Will:**


**Creator Recruitment**


* Identify, evaluate, and reach out to high\-potential creators who are new to Twitch or transitioning to livestreaming
* Guide creators through structured onboarding covering analytics, audience development, channel setup, and monetization fundamentals, support.
* Conduct stream reviews and support test\-streaming to ensure smooth creator starts
* Maintain visibility in emerging creator communities across platforms (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, etc.


**Partner Touchpoints \& Account Management**


* Serve as primary point of contact for a portfolio of Twitch Partners
* Provide timely, high\-quality support and guidance on Twitch products, policies, and best practices
* Maintain accurate documentation of creator interactions and portfolio data in Salesforce
* Collect and log partner feedback to inform product development and messaging
* Community Management \& Events (15% of time)
* Support planning and execution of IRL events to deepen creator relationships
* Maintain active presence in Partner community spaces (e.g., Discord)
* Represent Twitch at creator community moments as a brand ambassador
* Document creator insights and event outcomes


**Administrative \& Strategic Tasks**


* Generate and maintain reports on creator performance and engagement
* Analyze data to identify trends and opportunities within creator portfolio
* Participate in cross\-functional meetings and initiatives

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Please note: This job is advertised for Luxembourg but can be located in any of our EU sites or offices.  

  

We are seeking a Senior Analyst to own the analytical backbone across multiple high\-impact domains within EU Inbound Supply Chain. This is not a single\-metric reporting role you will design scalable data architectures, build production\-grade analytics systems, and drive strategic decisions through data, working across both real\-time streaming and batch processing to get the team the right data at the right time.  

  

The ideal candidate pairs deep technical expertise in data engineering and analytics with the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and turn ambiguous business problems into measurable solutions. You're equally comfortable building scalable pipelines on AWS services over terabytes of data, architecting a real\-time monitoring solution, presenting to senior leadership, or prototyping GenAI tools to scale analytical capacity.  

  

What makes this role unique:  

\- Context\-switching is the job \- one week you're decomposing a delivery\-accuracy variance across the EU network; the next you're building a real\-time Inbound Management pipeline; the week after you're prototyping a GenAI tool that auto\-generates root\-cause narratives for business reviews.  

\- Federated stakeholder model \- you'll work across Engineering, Science, Transportation, Planning, Finance, and Operations. Aligning on definitions and building shared analytical frameworks matters as much as writing the code.  

\- GenAI as a force multiplier \- you won't just use AI tools, you'll build them: agentic deep\-dives, automated narrative generation, and intelligent alerting that scale analysis across inbound speed, DEA, and transportation optimization.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and own end\-to\-end data architectures spanning real\-time streaming (Kinesis, Flink) and batch processing (EMR, Redshift, Athena), selecting the right paradigm for the latency, volume, and criticality at hand.
* Build production\-grade, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines processing multi\-TB datasets daily across Redshift, Athena, S3, and DynamoDB with data\-quality checks, monitoring, and alerting.
* Architect real\-time analytics for operational monitoring: live visibility into inbound flows, delivery accuracy, dock congestion, and network disruptions.
* Own metric frameworks and reporting: design KPIs, build automated dashboards (QuickSight), support WBR/MBR narratives, and own the “why” through root\-cause analysis when metrics move.
* Develop GenAI\-driven tooling and agentic workflows that automate reporting narratives and root\-cause analysis, reducing time\-to\-insight from days to minutes.
* Drive deep\-dive investigations across complex, multi\-source datasets tracing issues to specific products, warehouses, or routes, then quantifying network\-wide impact with statistical methods.

  

A day in the life  

You'll have exposure to the full data\-product lifecycle — from defining metrics to designing architectures, building pipelines, and delivering insights to senior leadership. A typical week might include:  

* Designing pipelines that unify real\-time event streams (shipment scans, trailer movements, inventory updates) and batch sources (forecasts, historical performance) into a single analytical layer.
* Writing advanced SQL across multiple sources to investigate why delivery promises were missed from the customer order through placement, transportation, and fulfillment.
* Building Python\-based automation for anomaly detection, statistical modeling, and reporting.
* Iterating on GenAI\-powered tools and presenting data\-driven recommendations, with clear quantification of customer and cost impact, to senior leadership.
* Triaging emerging operational issues from real\-time dashboards and providing data\-backed context.

The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon’s EU fulfillment network and ROW. We work at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved, and delivered reducing costs while improving customer experience. * Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, computer science, economics, engineering, or operations research.
* Experience in analytics, data engineering, or business intelligence at a large\-scale enterprise, including data\-warehouse architecture, data modeling, and ETL/ELT pipeline design.
* Advanced SQL and programming (Python or equivalent) to extract, transform, and clean large (multi\-TB) datasets, plus scripting for pipeline automation and scheduling.
* Experience with both real\-time streaming (e.g., Kinesis, Kafka, Flink) and batch processing (e.g., EMR, Hive) systems, and with data\-visualization tools (QuickSight, Tableau, or similar).
* Experience translating operational problems into analytical solutions and communicating results to senior leadership (Director/VP) with clear business\-impact quantification.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master's degree in statistics, data science, computer science, operations research, or an equivalent quantitative field.
* Experience with AWS services including S3, Redshift, Athena, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda, Glue, Step Functions, SageMaker, and DynamoDB.

This mission is vital to keeping existing satellites safe and to provide critical information to organizations launching new satellites in the future. This optical sensor is employed at three (3\) different locations around the world (White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico; Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory; and Maui, Hawaii) and helps track the objects in deep space orbit (altitude of 10,000 to 45,000 km).

**The Person**


Tallwave seeks out individuals who are a cut above. Their exceptional skill, diverse perspectives, obsession for winning together, and relentless pursuit of continuous self\-improvement, both professionally and personally, give them an innate ability to lead, innovate, and inspire. They have well\-honed philosophies and points of view in their areas of expertise, they think unconventionally, and their endless curiosity pushes them to constantly explore, learn, improve, and try new things.

**The Job**  

You work inside a large Fortune 500 enterprise client and fix the one thing slowing its delivery down. You diagnose, you advise, and you build.


You diagnose. You run the workshops, interview the people inside the bottleneck, and map how work actually moves. You separate the loud complaint from the constraint that sets the pace. You name it, quantify it, and write a hypothesis that can fail.


You advise. You turn what you found into a clear case for the sponsor and help them decide what to fix first and what to leave alone. You frame the next problem before the client asks. You hold the standard in the room when the client wants to skip to a tool.


You build. You put a first working version of the AI tool inside the real workflow, on real data and real tasks, using AI coding agents. You own the prompts, the agent flow, and the first read on whether the output is good enough to test. Then you sit with users until it is used.


You work in a pod of three with an Engagement Lead and a Platform Engineer. You are the person where the work meets the client.


Our clients are large, mature, process\-heavy, and risk\-aware. They know delivery is stuck. They have been pitched AI for two years. They want someone to show up, understand their work better than they expected, and put something useful in their hands within weeks. That is the job.


This is an early\-career role with a clear path. You start in the field under a Lead. The good version of you leads an engagement within eighteen months.

**What You Do**
===============

* Design and run workshops. Diagnosis sessions, interviews, and process mapping with the people inside the bottleneck. You plan the session, run the wall, and write the synthesis.
* Name the constraint. Separate what annoys people from what slows the flow. Write a hypothesis with a mechanism, a metric, and a clock, so it can fail.
* Prototype with agents. Build working tool slices with AI coding agents on real data and real tasks, inside the real workflow. Own the prompts, the agent flow, and the first read of output quality.
* Get it used. Sit with users, watch them work, and fix what blocks adoption. Usage in live work is the result you own.
* Read the signal. Track whether the hypothesis holds. Say so plainly when it does not, and propose the pivot.
* Present. Turn what you found and built into decision\-ready material for sponsors, and present it yourself.
* Hold the client room with the Lead. Earn the trust of the operators and the sponsor, and keep the work moving through slow organizations.

* Fearless in the room. You are comfortable asking a director why a process exists, and comfortable being wrong out loud.
