title: Senior Couture Pattern Maker & Sample Maker ( freelance )
description:
Senior Couture Pattern Maker \& Sample Maker

We are looking for a freelancer highly experienced and technically skilled Senior Couture Pattern Maker \& Sample Maker to join our fashion atelier.

The ideal candidate must be able to take a design from concept or sketch through the full garment\-development process, including pattern making, draping, fabric cutting, garment construction, fitting, alterations, and couture\-level finishing.

This role requires someone with strong technical knowledge, excellent craftsmanship, and the ability to work independently on complex womenswear and couture pieces.

Key Responsibilities

\* Interpret fashion sketches, reference images, and creative direction and translate them into technically feasible garments.

\* Create accurate patterns from sketches, measurements, existing garments, or draped toile.

\* Draping directly on the mannequin to develop silhouettes, volume, gathers, pleats, asymmetric shapes, and flowing designs.

\* Prepare toiles and prototypes for fitting and development.

\* Cut fabrics accurately, including delicate and luxury materials such as silk, chiffon, organza, satin, lace, tulle, crepe, and other couture fabrics.

\* Construct complete garments from first sample through final piece.

\* Perform both machine sewing and high\-quality hand sewing.

\* Apply couture finishing techniques, including invisible hems, hand finishing, internal finishing, delicate closures, and clean seam construction.

\* Understand garment structure, balance, fit, proportion, and movement.

\* Conduct fittings and make necessary pattern and garment adjustments.

\* Develop solutions for internal garment support, boning, lining, interfacing, corsetry, and structured areas when required.

\* Work carefully with complex draping, bias\-cut garments, layered fabrics, and intricate silhouettes.

\* Ensure every garment meets a very high standard of craftsmanship, fit, and finishing.

\* Recommend appropriate construction methods based on the design and selected fabric.

\* Minimize fabric waste while maintaining accurate cutting and quality.

\* Maintain organized patterns, samples, and garment\-development records.

\* Work closely with the Creative Director to develop and refine each design while maintaining the original creative vision.

Required Experience \& Skills

\* Strong professional experience in couture, bridal, eveningwear, luxury womenswear, or high\-end bespoke fashion.

\* Advanced pattern\-making skills.

\* Advanced draping skills.

\* Excellent fabric\-cutting ability.

\* Excellent machine\-sewing and hand\-sewing skills.

\* Strong understanding of garment construction and couture finishing.

\* Ability to work with delicate, expensive, and difficult fabrics.

\* Strong knowledge of women’s garment fitting and alterations.

\* Ability to understand a sketch and independently determine how the garment should be constructed.

\* Experience creating samples and prototypes from the development stage through the final garment.

\* Excellent attention to detail and precision.

\* Strong problem\-solving skills when translating creative designs into wearable garments.

\* Ability to work independently and manage several designs during collection development.

Preferred

\* Experience working in a couture atelier, bridal house, luxury fashion house, or bespoke studio.

\* Experience with evening gowns, draped dresses, corsetry, and complex silhouettes.

\* Knowledge of embroidery, embellishment, fabric manipulation, and hand\-applied details is an advantage.

\* Experience developing garments from original designer sketches rather than only following existing patterns.

What We Are Looking For

We are specifically looking for someone who is not limited to one technical area. The candidate should be capable of managing the complete garment\-development process:

Sketch → Draping / Pattern Making → Toile → Fitting → Pattern Correction → Cutting → Sewing → Couture Finishing → Final Garment

The right candidate should combine technical expertise with an understanding of design, proportion, movement, and luxury craftsmanship.

Pay: AED500\.00 \- AED5,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dubai (Dubai)

title: Principal Business Analyst, Fraud
description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting\-edge technology, we're enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?


We're looking for a Principal Business Analyst, Fraud to design and test the defenses that stop fraudulent applications, reporting to the Director, Fraud.


**The impact you'll make:**



Right now, someone is filling out an application for their first credit card, hoping it's the start of something they can build on. Fraudsters have learned to mimic that same hope on paper. A thin credit file and a stolen identity can look nearly identical on the surface, and the line between them shifts as fraud tactics evolve. You'll build and test the logic that draws that line, making sure the real applicant gets a fair, fast answer, and the fraudster doesn't get a credit card.



Mission Lane is still young, but we've landed in an exciting, stable stretch of maturation. We're still building but we've already got a solid foundation. There's never been a better time to learn and grow right along with us.


**As Principal Business Analyst, Fraud, you will:**


* Dig into application data to independently identify emerging fraud patterns and surface vulnerabilities before they scale.
* Design, build, and run A/B and Champion/Challenger tests to develop new real\-time defenses against fraudulent applications.
* Balance risk and customer experience by translating test results into thoughtful, data\-backed recommendations.
* Build and maintain dashboards that track defense performance against coverage, applicant friction and abandonment, and losses.
* Partner with Operations, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to continuously sharpen fraud detection capabilities.
* Mentor less experienced analysts on the team as they build their own fraud analytics judgment.


**You'll thrive in this role if:**


* You're comfortable working on an undefined problem. Application fraud data rarely comes with a clean hypothesis attached, and you enjoy framing the question as much as answering it.
* You know how to tell the story behind your analysis, not just report the numbers.
* You take ownership of your conclusions and can defend them under scrutiny, while always staying open to being wrong.


**Minimum qualifications:**


* 2\+ years of experience in a highly analytical role (e.g., risk, business analytics, data science), with the majority of that experience spent working directly with data rather than individual case decisioning.
* Experience conducting analytical work with credit cards or other consumer lending products.
* Hands\-on experience designing and executing A/B or Champion/Challenger testing within an application or risk funnel.
* Proven ability to independently frame an ambiguous question, form a hypothesis, analyze the data, and defend the answer with stakeholders.
* Strong familiarity with SQL, Python, or other tools for data analysis.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Mathematics, or a similar quantitative field with a record of strong academic performance.
* Ability to travel \~4\-6\+ times per year for high quality in person collaboration.


**Preferred qualifications:**


* Direct experience in Fraud Strategy and Analytics.
* Expertise in SQL and Python.
* Experience helping scale a business in a fast\-paced startup environment.


**Compensation:**  

Annual full\-time starting base salary range: $118,000\-$135,000\.



This role is eligible for additional compensation in the forms of participation in our annual incentive and equity programs.



Pay is based on factors such as work experience, education, certification(s), training, skills, and competencies related to the role. Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote\-first work environment.

  

**About Mission Lane:**



Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose\-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.



It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn't have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less\-than\-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn't do.



In partnership with our sponsor banks, we offer credit cards under the Mission Lane brand name, with better, clearer terms, and a more refined customer experience than the alternatives available to people working hard to improve their credit. To date, over four million consumers have chosen Mission Lane, earning high customer ratings on Credit Karma for its market segment and industry leading Net Promoter scores.



Mission Lane has cumulatively raised over $600 million of equity from leading investors, including Invus Opportunities, QED Investors, LL Funds, funds affiliated with Oaktree Capital Management, and other leading investors.



**Our commitment to a workplace built on respect and dignity is guided by our core value of Unity. We believe that everyone plays a vital role in our shared purpose, and we actively cultivate an environment where all individuals have the opportunity to do their best work. By fostering a culture of empathy and collaboration, we create a strong sense of belonging and support for every team member.**



Mission Lane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status.



Mission Lane provides reasonable accommodations to applicants who need them for medical or religious reasons, as required by law. Applicants can initiate an accommodation request by contacting peopleexperience@missionlane.com.



Mission Lane is not sponsoring new applicant employment authorization and please, no third\-party recruiters.



**Application Integrity:**



Our cardholders trust us with their financial well\-being, and this trust starts with the integrity of the people on our team. We're looking for team members who share our dedication to transparency and truth. Please verify that the information in your application is accurate and complete.


*Providing any information to Mission Lane that is not completely truthful at any point during the application or hiring process may result in removal from the hiring process, disqualification from future opportunities, withdrawal of an offer or other sanctions for candidates and, in addition for employees, disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.*

title: Director - Milk Quality and Care
description:
**Director, Milk Quality \& Care**

**About the Company:**


At Horizon Organic, we’re growing a culture of passionate people driven to do good for the horizon we all share. We’re building the tomorrow we want to see. Every single day.


Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your skills are valued, and your contributions make a real difference. We offer diverse opportunities for career growth and development. Embark on a rewarding journey with us in shaping the future of organic dairy!


Two generations of families—and counting—have grown up on Horizon Organic® milk. From the start, as the leading organic milk producer in the U.S., Horizon has been committed to delivering innovative, nourishing dairy that growing families can rely on. In 2023, Horizon Organic became a brand of Platinum Equity. Today, Horizon works with more than 500 farmers across the U.S. to bring high\-quality, certified organic milk to consumers. For more information on Horizon’s full portfolio of organic dairy products, visit Horizon.com.

 **About the Job:**


We are currently looking to hire a full\-time **Director, Milk Quality \& Care**.


The Director, Milk Quality \& Care will ensure that our farms and producers meet or exceed the standards on farm set by our Horizon Family Brands Quality and Food Safety Milk Team throughout the supply chain.


The Director, Milk Quality \& Care will be responsible for managing the Milk Quality Team and supporting their needs and development. He/she will work cross\-functionally to develop and set HFB’s standards on farms and at the factory gate. This includes but is not limited to ensuring compliance with all company’s certification requirements, tracking and trending KPIs, providing updates to the Horizon Leadership Team, on farm quality notifications and troubleshooting, providing support in times of outbreaks, supporting integration transitions, systems evaluations and recommendations, etc. This role will also be responsible for managing the Cream suppliers and other related items.


The Director, Milk Quality \& Care will collaborate closely with the Milk Procurement team to approve and maintain farms, resolve quality issues and resolve quality non\-conformances. He/she will support his/her direct reports in this endeavor, as well. He/she will work with the Milk Hauling team to ensure all standards are met from pick up to delivery of milk and cream. The successful candidate will become a trusted member of a team dedicated to driving meaningful improvement in quality and animal welfare across our network of farms. Work hours will be spent completing or assigning tasks critical for team functioning including submitting and tracking invoices, tracking on\-farm milk quality data, and strategic planning and continuous improvement. He/she may also develop and support pilot projects exploring new methods to monitor or evaluate animal welfare and milk quality on organic dairy farms.


This position is part of the QFS Leadership Team and reports directly to the Head of Quality and Food Safety.

*The role can be remote with a preference to be based in Broomfield, CO/hybrid.* *The base compensation range for this position is $145,000 \- $170,000 commensurate with experience*.

**About You:**

**Education and Experience:**

* Advanced Degree in Animal Science, Food Science, Biology, Chemistry, or related agriculture field

* 5\-10 years of experience in the Dairy Industry
 **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Ability to Successfully lead and develop a team
* Ability to work well cross\-functionally
* Experience with Raw milk and cream test methods and relevance
* Working knowledge of microbiology in the milk and dairy context
* Grade A regulatory, technical, and scientific knowledge of dairy processes and equipment

* Strong quality and analytical skills
* Strong project management/organizational skills
* Success in problem solving and critical thinking
* Anticipates and is pro\-active
* Enjoys developing and delivering educational materials
* Passion for excellence
* Strong communication and motivational skills
* Self\-motivated with the ability to function with some autonomy
* Passionate about milk quality and animal welfare
* Working knowledge of the Pasteurized Milk Ordinance preferred
* Aligns with Horizon Organic Dairy’s culture, behaviors, and attitudes
* Travel required up to 25% or as required by project success and schedule

 *Preferred:** Lead Auditor Certification
* FARM Certification
* Experience on farm

title: Director, Brand & Integrated Marketing
description:
The Director of Brand \& Integrated Marketing will own MeUndies’ overall brand strategy and translate it into a cohesive marketing calendar, compelling campaigns, culturally relevant content, and consistent execution across every customer touchpoint. This leader will oversee the Brand and Social teams while owning integrated campaign planning, product\-launch briefing, content strategy, influencer and affiliate strategy, licensing marketing, and brand partnerships. This is not a role for someone who only develops high\-level strategy or manages agencies. We are looking for a hands\-on leader who can set the vision, write a strong brief, lead teams through execution, make decisions quickly, and measure what worked.
   

  

 This role will work closely with Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, Wholesale, and Licensing to ensure the entire organization is working from one clear brand and commercial calendar.
   

  

****Please note that this is a hybrid position of 4 days/week in our Los Angeles office.****
**What You'll Do**
* Brand Strategy and Positioning
* Own and evolve the MeUndies brand strategy, positioning, voice, visual identity, and cultural point of view.
* Ensure the brand remains distinctive, relevant, emotionally resonant, and consistent across DTC, retail, wholesale, and licensed products.
* Translate company and commercial priorities into clear customer\-facing narratives.
* Maintain and evolve brand guidelines while ensuring teams and external partners apply them consistently.
* Protect long\-term brand equity while helping the company achieve near\-term revenue goals.


 Integrated Marketing Calendar
   

  

* Own the master MeUndies marketing calendar across product launches, promotions, seasonal moments, collaborations, licensing, retail, and cultural opportunities.
* Create one source of truth connecting Brand, Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, and Wholesale.
* Lead cross\-functional planning meetings and ensure teams understand the objective, audience, message, deliverables, owners, deadlines, and success metrics for every major initiative.
* Identify calendar conflicts, missed opportunities, and resource constraints early.


 Campaigns and Product Launches
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end go\-to\-market process for major campaigns, product launches, collaborations, and licensed collections.
* Develop sharp, actionable briefs grounded in customer insight, business goals, channel needs, and a clear creative proposition.
* Ensure briefs include the audience, insight, objective, positioning, key message, deliverables, channel strategy, timing, budget, and measurement plan.
* Partner with Creative to develop concepts that are both brand\-building and commercially effective.
* Maintain launch readiness and hold cross\-functional teams accountable to deadlines and deliverables.


 Content and Social Strategy
   

  

* Own the integrated content strategy across organic social, campaigns, editorial, community, creators, partnerships, and emerging channels.
* Lead the Social team and establish clear channel roles, content pillars, publishing cadence, and platform\-specific strategies.
* Build a content engine that allows MeUndies to respond quickly to cultural moments without losing brand consistency.
* Balance polished campaign content with creator\-led, community\-driven, educational, entertaining, and conversion\-oriented content.
* Establish a disciplined testing and learning process for formats, messages, talent, and platforms.


 Influencer, Creator, and Affiliate Strategy
   

  

* Own the strategy for influencers, creators, ambassadors, affiliates, and other external brand advocates.
* Develop a clear approach to seeding, paid partnerships, long\-term creator relationships, performance affiliates, and brand ambassadors.
* Build programs that generate both culturally relevant content and measurable customer acquisition.
* Partner with Growth to define channel economics, attribution, testing budgets, and performance expectations.
* Identify creators and partners who authentically represent the MeUndies customer and brand values.


 Licensing, Collaborations, and Partnerships
   

  

* Lead the marketing strategy for entertainment licenses, collaborations, and strategic brand partnerships.
* Partner with Product, Merchandising, Creative, Legal, and licensors from concept through launch.
* Develop a balanced licensing calendar that can drive customer acquisition and revenue without overwhelming the core MeUndies brand.
* Identify new collaboration and partnership opportunities that expand cultural relevance, audience reach, and commercial potential.
* Ensure all licensed marketing meets partner requirements while still feeling unmistakably MeUndies.


 Consumer Insights and Cultural Relevance
   

  

* Build a strong understanding of the MeUndies customer through research, social listening, reviews, community feedback, competitive analysis, and performance data.
* Translate customer and cultural insights into actionable campaign, product, and content opportunities.
* Track cultural shifts, category trends, emerging platforms, and competitor activity.
* Serve as the internal voice of the customer and help teams understand what is changing in the market.


 Brand Communications and Community
   

  

* Partner with internal and external resources on PR, earned media, founder communications, events, and brand reputation.
* Develop strategies that deepen customer participation, advocacy, and community.
* Identify opportunities for experiential marketing, events, pop\-ups, and earned cultural moments.
* Help shape how MeUndies responds to sensitive cultural, customer, or reputational issues.


 Measurement and Hindsights
   

  

* Establish clear success metrics before every campaign and launch.
* Lead formal post\-launch hindsights that assess creative performance, channel performance, customer response, operational execution, and commercial results.
* Turn findings into specific changes for future campaigns instead of simply reporting results.
* Develop a brand\-health measurement framework covering awareness, consideration, sentiment, engagement, customer growth, and brand relevance.
* Partner with Growth and Finance to understand incrementality, return on marketing investment, and the relationship between brand activity and revenue.


 Leadership and Operations
   

  

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable the Brand and Social teams.
* Build clear workflows, decision rights, timelines, and standards for excellent execution.
* Manage relevant agencies, freelancers, creators, production partners, and brand budgets.
* Prioritize resources across competing initiatives and maintain a high bar for quality, speed, and accountability.
* Present strategies, plans, results, and recommendations to senior leadership.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* MeUndies operates from one clear and reliable integrated marketing calendar.
* Every major launch begins with a strong brief, launches on time, and concludes with a useful hindsight.
* The brand has a more recognizable and culturally relevant point of view.
* Social and content become more consistent, responsive, and commercially effective.
* Influencer and affiliate programs have clear strategies, economics, and measurement.
* Licensing and collaborations support both revenue growth and long\-term brand equity.
* Cross\-functional teams have clearer priorities, ownership, and deadlines.
* Brand investment is measured with the same discipline as performance marketing.


**What You Have**
* 8–12\+ years of brand, integrated marketing, or consumer marketing experience, ideally within a modern DTC, apparel, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brand.
* Experience leading brand strategy and integrated campaigns across multiple channels.
* Demonstrated success building marketing calendars and launching products, collaborations, or licensed collections.
* Strong understanding of organic social, creators, influencers, affiliates, partnerships, and content development.
* Ability to connect brand\-building activity with commercial performance.
* Excellent briefing, storytelling, presentation, and written communication skills.
* Strong understanding of consumer insights, cultural trends, and modern customer behavior.
* Experience managing teams, agencies, budgets, and complex cross\-functional projects.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with high expectations and limited bureaucracy.
* Willingness to work at both the strategic and executional levels.


**The base salary range for this full\-time position is $125,000\-$150,000\. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the base salary range provided in this posting does not include any bonus, equity, or benefits you may be eligible for.**
****WHY WORK AT MEUNDIES?****
****It's more than a job.****
 We have focused on building a team of people who emulate our core values. We look for people who stay balanced, go further, build relationships, champion differences, and are humble. At MeUndies, we continue to maintain a stellar brand by working collaboratively and encouraging growth with learning opportunities. There is no such thing as a small achievement here \- we celebrate it all!
   

  

****We look at the necessities.****
 We offer competitive salary packages, including targeted annual bonuses, generous parental leave, a 401k, fantastic health benefits, open time off, and more.
   

  

****We have an office you’ll enjoy going to.****
 We work in our office Monday \- Thursday. Friday is a remote/work\-from\-home day. We’re set up to support comfortable working \- hot desks, lounge, and casual seating areas, a Mother’s Room, an on\-site gym \& shower, and a kitchen that makes you feel like you’ve never left home. We’re dog\-friendly, so your furry coworker can join you anytime.
   

  

****We don’t forget the most important things.****
 We want MeUndies to be a place where you feel safe and comfortable, and we encourage our employees to hold us accountable for keeping it that way. We encourage open communication and a People Ops team that is ready to help. When you work at MeUndies, we take your needs as an employee (and a person) seriously. Our doors are always welcome to feedback and suggestions!
   

  

****Plus those special extra things.****
 We also know how important it is to connect with your team members outside of everyday work. We offer catered lunches every in\-office day, holiday parties, off\-sites, happy hours, and an annual retreat. You’ll also get a sweet employee discount to rebuild your underwear drawer with our top\-notch prints.

In addition, MeUndies will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable federal, state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.**

### **Description \& Requirements**

Job Description
AESC is seeking a senior service leader to build and operate the U.S. service organization for its growing battery energy storage system (BESS) business. This leader will own the installed\-base customer experience and the safe, reliable, and profitable delivery of commissioning support, long\-term service agreements (LTSAs), field service, warranty, remote support, spare parts, and lifecycle performance.


The role spans the full post\-sale lifecycle, from design\-for\-serviceability and commissioning readiness through commercial operation, planned and corrective maintenance, major incident response, upgrades, warranty closeout, and contract renewal. It requires a hands\-on builder who can establish a geographically distributed team and partner network while serving as the senior escalation point for customers and internal executives.

**Core mandate:** Build a safety\-first, scalable U.S. BESS service platform that protects customers, maximizes fleet availability, fulfills contractual commitments, converts field learning into product improvement, and develops service into a durable source of revenue and margin.**About AESC**
==============


AESC is a global battery technology company developing and manufacturing high\-performance batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage systems. AESC reports more than 100 GWh of shipped capacity for battery energy systems across more than 60 countries. The U.S. BESS Service Lead will help translate AESC's technology and manufacturing capabilities into dependable, long\-term operating outcomes for North American customers.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Service strategy and organization.** Define the U.S. service operating model, organization, regional coverage, make\-versus\-buy strategy, headcount plan, partner network, systems, procedures, and multi\-year capability roadmap. Recruit, develop, and retain commissioning, field service, technical support, performance, and service\-operations talent.
* **Safety leadership.** Own the service safety culture and field execution standards. Establish governance for LOTO, energized work, switching, arc\-flash controls, permit\-to\-work, job hazard analysis, emergency response, stop\-work authority, contractor safety, incident reporting, and lessons learned.
* **Commissioning\-to\-service transition.** Establish service\-readiness gates, handover criteria, punch\-list closure, documentation, training, asset registration, baseline performance, warranty activation, spare\-parts readiness, and customer acceptance requirements before commercial operation.
* **Field service and fleet reliability.** Lead preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance across utility\-scale BESS assets. Plan outages, deploy resources, supervise service partners, standardize work execution, and continuously improve system availability, capacity, reliability, first\-time fix rate, and mean time to repair.
* **Technical escalation and incident management.** Direct 24/7 escalation coverage for critical events. Lead structured troubleshooting, containment, root\-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action (CAPA), management of change, recovery plans, executive communications, and closure of repeat\-failure mechanisms.
* **Remote operations and performance.** Build remote monitoring, alarm triage, fleet analytics, condition\-based maintenance, performance reporting, and case\-management capabilities. Use BMS, PCS, EMS/SCADA, controls, communications, thermal management, and fire\-system data to identify risk and improve lifecycle performance.
* **Warranty, spares, and supplier recovery.** Own warranty administration, claims, RMA/return processes, failure evidence, cost recovery, field campaigns, spare\-parts forecasting, regional inventory, repair strategy, obsolescence planning, and supplier/OEM escalation.
* **LTSA and commercial performance.** Ensure compliance with SLAs, availability and capacity guarantees, response times, reporting obligations, maintenance scope, and liquidated\-damages exposure. Own the regional service budget/cost center and, as assigned, service P\&L, pricing inputs, lifecycle cost models, change orders, renewals, and service growth.
* **Customer leadership.** Serve as the executive service owner for strategic customers. Establish governance, performance reviews, escalation protocols, transparent communications, recovery plans, and a consistent experience that supports satisfaction, retention, references, and repeat business.
* **Quality and product feedback.** Partner with Engineering, Product, Quality, Project Delivery, Supply Chain, Software, Sales, Finance, and Legal to improve serviceability, reliability, documentation, training, warranty terms, contract assumptions, and future product design based on field evidence.
* **Operating discipline.** Implement CMMS and case\-management workflows, asset hierarchy, work orders, controlled procedures, skills certification, service bulletins, audit routines, KPI dashboards, financial controls, data quality, and executive reporting.

Qualifications
* **Experience.** 10\+ years of progressively responsible experience in BESS, electric utility generation, renewable power, power conversion, critical power, industrial field service, or adjacent high\-voltage asset operations, including at least 5 years leading service or O\&M teams.
* **BESS lifecycle depth.** Direct leadership experience with utility\-scale BESS commissioning, post\-COD support, preventive and corrective maintenance, warranty, root\-cause investigations, and long\-term service delivery.
* **Distributed operations.** Proven success building or leading a geographically dispersed field organization and managing third\-party service providers across multiple sites and jurisdictions.
* **Technical credibility.** Working knowledge of battery racks/containers, BMS, PCS/inverters, medium\-voltage equipment, transformers, switchgear, protection, EMS/SCADA, PLCs, communications, HVAC/thermal management, fire detection/suppression, and grid\-interface functions.
* **Safety and compliance.** Demonstrated leadership of operational safety programs and working familiarity with applicable OSHA requirements, NFPA 70E, NEC, NFPA 855, LOTO, arc\-flash, electrical switching, emergency response, and relevant U.S. codes and standards.
* **Commercial accountability.** Experience managing service budgets, forecasts, cost centers or P\&L; interpreting LTSAs, warranties, SLAs, performance guarantees, and LD exposure; and negotiating or administering third\-party service contracts.
* **Customer and crisis leadership.** Ability to lead complex technical escalations and communicate calmly and credibly with site teams, asset owners, utilities, insurers, authorities having jurisdiction, and senior executives.
* **Business systems.** Experience with CMMS/EAM, ERP, financial reporting, case\-management, document\-control, and fleet\-performance systems; disciplined use of data and structured problem\-solving methods.
* **Education and mobility.** Bachelor's degree in electrical, mechanical, controls, energy systems, or another relevant engineering/technical discipline, or equivalent experience; valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 50%, including urgent field response when necessary.
**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* 15\+ years of relevant experience and 7\+ years leading multi\-site service, O\&M, commissioning, or asset\-performance organizations.
* Experience supporting a large utility\-scale BESS fleet under availability, capacity, response\-time, or performance guarantees.
* Experience with LFP battery systems, containerized BESS, grid\-forming or advanced inverter controls, and U.S. utility interconnection/commissioning requirements.

**Performance Measures**
========================

* Safety: leading indicators, training/certification completion, audit closure, recordable incidents, high\-potential events, and contractor performance.
* Fleet: availability, capacity/performance guarantee attainment, alarm recurrence, forced outage hours, MTTR, first\-time fix rate, and preventive\-maintenance compliance.
* Customer: SLA response, escalation aging, reporting timeliness, acceptance/closure rate, satisfaction, references, renewals, and repeat business.
* Quality and warranty: repeat failures, RCA/CAPA cycle time and effectiveness, warranty cost, supplier recovery, field campaign completion, and technical\-document quality.
* Financial and operational: service revenue and gross margin, cost per site/MWh, budget accuracy, overtime and travel efficiency, spare\-parts availability/turns, backlog, and workforce utilization.
**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* **First 90 days.** Assess the installed base, contracts, open issues, safety risks, team capability, partners, spares, systems, and customer commitments; establish escalation governance and a prioritized U.S. service roadmap.
* **Within 12 months.** Implement standard service\-readiness, maintenance, incident, warranty, spares, training, CMMS, customer\-reporting, and KPI processes; close critical capability gaps; improve response and fleet performance; and produce a credible service budget and staffing plan.
* **Within 24 months.** Operate a scalable regional service platform with strong safety and customer outcomes, predictable LTSA execution, improving fleet reliability, disciplined warranty recovery, and a clear path to sustainable service revenue and margin.

=====================


Director is appropriate for a proven regional service leader who can build and operate the U.S. function with significant executive exposure. Senior Director is appropriate when the candidate brings broader North American portfolio ownership, substantial service P\&L responsibility, a record of building multi\-layer organizations, and repeated executive leadership through major fleet events and strategic customer relationships.
